findings.todokanai: But that would mean openly rejecting Takeya's invitation.

findings.highlight: what I'd be seeing again are memories pertaining to a certain someone
findings.evidenceJa: いや、これから集めるであろう“あいつ”のことを。
findings.explanation: Correcting himself from the previous sentence, Haruki thinks of the attention 'she'—Kazusa—will surely go on gathering from audiences in the future. The English instead says he would see memories about her again, replacing a forward-looking image of Kazusa's career with retrospective recollection.
findings.japanese: いや、これから集めるであろう“あいつ”のことを。
findings.todokanai: No, what I'd be seeing again are memories pertaining to a certain someone.

findings.highlight: I have no right to even remember the name "Touma"
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜との決着をつけないまま、“冬馬”という姓を引きずるのは。
findings.explanation: Haruki decides to stop dragging the name Touma behind him while his relationship with Setsuna remains unresolved. The English invents a moral prohibition—that he has no right even to remember the name—turning his decision to stop pursuing a connection into self-punishing memory erasure.
findings.japanese:
雪菜との決着をつけないまま、
“冬馬”という姓を引きずるのは。
findings.todokanai: I have no right to even remember the name "Touma" when I can't even have proper closure with Setsuna.

findings.highlight: "Well, I won't go if you won't tell me where you are."
findings.evidenceJa: 「じゃあ、駄目な方向で」
findings.explanation: Haruki jokingly says 'then let's make it no'; the English invents a condition about Takeya refusing to disclose his location.
findings.japanese: 「じゃあ、駄目な方向で」
findings.todokanai: "Well, I won't go if you won't tell me where you are."

findings.highlight: "You could've just said so to begin with, you know. You always get caught up in pointless conversation."
findings.evidenceJa:
「最初からそう言やいいんだよ。
余計な気、使いやがって」
findings.explanation: Haruki accuses Takeya of unnecessary consideration; the English accuses him of pointless conversation.
findings.japanese:
「最初からそう言やいいんだよ。
余計な気、使いやがって」
findings.todokanai: "You could've just said so to begin with, you know. You always get caught up in pointless conversation."

findings.highlight: just as Haruki makes his decision to be with her
findings.evidenceJa: 春希が雪菜に向かい合おうとした途端
findings.explanation: Io says Setsuna rejected Haruki at the moment he finally tried to face her honestly. The English upgrades that attempt at direct engagement into a decision to be with her, asserting a settled relationship commitment stronger than the Japanese.
findings.japanese:
「なのに、春希が雪菜に向かい合おうとした途端、
そんなわかりきってたこと持ち出して
春希の手をはねのけるって、一体どういう了見だよ！」
findings.todokanai: "But just as Haruki makes his decision to be with her, Setsuna brings up something so obvious and slaps Haruki's hand aside? What the hell is she thinking!?"

findings.highlight: Make Haruki admit that it was his fault!
findings.evidenceJa: 責めろよ！　春希の非を認めてやれよ！
findings.explanation: Io says Setsuna should have blamed Haruki and acknowledged his fault for him, giving him the condemnation he needed. The English says Setsuna should force Haruki himself to admit fault, reversing the person who must perform the acknowledgment and undermining Io's central argument.
findings.japanese:
「ギリギリになって大爆発するくらいなら
最初から弾けろよ！
責めろよ！　春希の非を認めてやれよ！」
findings.todokanai: "If she's just going to explode at the end, then she might as well point it out from the very beginning! Yell at him! Make Haruki admit that it was his fault!"

findings.highlight: Io didn't mention anything specific, and even Takeya didn't admit it openly
findings.evidenceJa: 依緒に言われるまでもなく、武也に同意されるまでもなく、俺の罪は、俺が一番よく知ってる。
findings.explanation: Haruki says that, without needing Io to tell him or Takeya to agree, he knows his own sins best. The English falsely states that Io was nonspecific and Takeya did not openly admit the truth, contradicting the explicit accusations and agreement immediately before it.
findings.japanese:
依緒に言われるまでもなく、
武也に同意されるまでもなく、
俺の罪は、俺が一番よく知ってる。
findings.todokanai: Io didn't mention anything specific, and even Takeya didn't admit it openly, but I'm the one most aware of all the sins I've committed.

findings.highlight: "It took her way too much time… In all the time she took moping around like that, Haruki never once forgot about Touma."
findings.evidenceJa:
「かかりすぎなんだよ…
そうやって雪菜がモタモタしてる間、
春希はずっと、冬馬のこと忘れられなかったんだから」
findings.explanation: Io says Setsuna dawdled; the English says she moped around.
findings.japanese:
「かかりすぎなんだよ…
そうやって雪菜がモタモタしてる間、
春希はずっと、冬馬のこと忘れられなかったんだから」
findings.todokanai: "It took her way too much time… In all the time she took moping around like that, Haruki never once forgot about Touma."

findings.highlight: That's what's forced them into this situation where they can't move on or go back, either
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜が引きずるから。引きずったまま、引きずってないふりなんかするから！
findings.explanation: Io says Setsuna keeps dragging the past with her while pretending she is not dragging it at all. The English replaces Setsuna's specific repression and pretense with a generic shared inability to move forward or back, deleting the behavior Io is condemning.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜が引きずるから。
引きずったまま、引きずってないふりなんかするから！」
findings.todokanai: "It's because Setsuna refused to let go. That's what's forced them into this situation where they can't move on or go back, either!"

findings.highlight: Maybe you were just too dense to realize it?
findings.evidenceJa: ボケんのも大概にしろよ？
findings.explanation: After Io absurdly claims she has never dumped anyone, Takeya tells her to stop playing the fool or carrying the joke too far. The English instead speculates that Io was too dense to realize she had rejected people, changing a direct angry rebuke into a diagnosis of obliviousness.
findings.japanese: 「………ボケんのも大概にしろよ？」
findings.todokanai: "…Maybe you were just too dense to realize it?"

findings.highlight: The crowd's excitement floods my surroundings as it drowns out the sound of the New Year's bell meant for the first night of the year, bringing me the slightest bit of discomfort.
findings.evidenceJa:
除夜の鐘を掻き消すような興奮が俺の周囲に蔓延して、
ほんの少しだけ居心地の悪さを感じたけれど。
findings.explanation: The joy of concertgoers drowns out the year-end temple bell; the English calls it a bell meant for the first night of the year.
findings.japanese:
除夜の鐘を掻き消すような興奮が俺の周囲に蔓延して、
ほんの少しだけ居心地の悪さを感じたけれど。
findings.todokanai: The crowd's excitement floods my surroundings as it drowns out the sound of the New Year's bell meant for the first night of the year, bringing me the slightest bit of discomfort.

findings.highlight: "Being in Japan is what makes it special. We don't often get a chance to come back like this, so I want to try heating up a pot of it the old-fashioned way."
findings.evidenceJa:
「日本でってのが重要なのよ。
せっかく帰国してるんだから、
こう、お銚子で熱燗とかさぁ」
findings.explanation: Youko wants hot sake served from a small sake flask; the English says she wants to heat a pot in an old-fashioned way.
findings.japanese:
「日本でってのが重要なのよ。
せっかく帰国してるんだから、
こう、お銚子で熱燗とかさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Being in Japan is what makes it special. We don't often get a chance to come back like this, so I want to try heating up a pot of it the old-fashioned way."

findings.highlight: I was on the floor until just a moment ago
findings.evidenceJa: 実はさっきまでずっと下がりっぱなしだったんだよね
findings.explanation: Io says that despite drinking, her energy or mood had remained down until moments ago. The English puts her literally on the floor, inventing a physical position and missing the contrast between her earlier low spirits and her suddenly manic greeting.
findings.japanese:
「あ～、確かにさっきまで飲んでたんだけどさぁ、
実はさっきまでずっと下がりっぱなしだったんだよね」
findings.todokanai: "Aaaah, well yeah, I was drinking until just a little while ago. To be honest, I was on the floor until just a moment ago."

findings.highlight: Now all that's left is for you two to say it to each other, right?
findings.evidenceJa: あけましておめでとう、武也、依緒。…お前らにだけ挨拶まだだったよな？
findings.explanation: Haruki greets Takeya and Io and jokes that they were the only people he had not yet wished a happy new year. The English instead tells them that they still need to greet each other, changing his cheeky recovery after the confession and disrupting their immediate mock assault on him.
findings.japanese:
「あけましておめでとう、武也、依緒。
…お前らにだけ挨拶まだだったよな？」
findings.todokanai: "Happy New Year, Takeya, Io. …Now all that's left is for you two to say it to each other, right?"

findings.highlight: she's such a waste on you
findings.evidenceJa: ほんとお前、ホント勿体ぶりやがって！
findings.explanation: Takeya complains that Haruki dragged out the revelation and made them wait in suspense. The English invents a judgment that Setsuna is wasted on Haruki, changing both the referent and the reason for Takeya's exasperation.
findings.japanese:
「くっそ、今日は朝まで付き合えよ？
ほんとお前、ホント勿体ぶりやがって！」
findings.todokanai: "Screw it all, we'll be drinking until morning now, got it? Man, she's such a waste on you!"

findings.highlight: …If anything, they're probably enjoying the sight of us, who were in a quarrel just a moment ago, get along.
findings.evidenceJa:
…さっきまで喧嘩してたはずの俺たちの、
あまりに仲良しな光景にあてられつつも。
findings.explanation: Bystanders may be overwhelmed or put off by the trio's excessively close display; the English says they are probably enjoying it.
findings.japanese:
…さっきまで喧嘩してたはずの俺たちの、
あまりに仲良しな光景にあてられつつも。
findings.todokanai: …If anything, they're probably enjoying the sight of us, who were in a quarrel just a moment ago, get along.

findings.highlight: the reliable ones who supported me, to the not-so-reliable ones who supported me, and to those who supported me even when asked not to
findings.evidenceJa: 頼もしく自分を支えてくれる人に。頼んでもいないのに支えようとする人に。嫌だと言っても支えられようとする人に。
findings.explanation: The source distinguishes a reliable person who supports Haruki, someone who tries to support him unasked, and someone who tries to be supported by him despite saying she does not want it. The English calls the second group unreliable without basis and turns the third passive relationship into yet another person actively supporting Haruki, flattening the carefully varied network of dependence.
findings.japanese:
頼もしく自分を支えてくれる人に。
頼んでもいないのに支えようとする人に。
嫌だと言っても支えられようとする人に。
findings.todokanai: Here's to the reliable ones who supported me, to the not-so-reliable ones who supported me, and to those who supported me even when asked not to.

findings.highlight: And to the one most beloved person who stayed by my side, despite all the grief I put her through…
findings.evidenceJa:
そして、いつも近くにいたのに、
ずっと、悲しませてばかりだった大切な人に…
findings.explanation: Setsuna is Haruki's important person; the English adds the superlative 'most beloved.'
findings.japanese:
そして、いつも近くにいたのに、
ずっと、悲しませてばかりだった大切な人に…
findings.todokanai: And to the one most beloved person who stayed by my side, despite all the grief I put her through…

findings.highlight: I hope it'll be a great year indeed
findings.evidenceJa: 願わくは、今年“から”はいい年でありますように。
findings.explanation: The marked から means Haruki hopes that from this year onward things will finally be good, explicitly contrasting the future with the years of damage behind them. The English drops 'from' and its typographic emphasis, reducing the closing turn to an ordinary new-year wish.
findings.japanese:
願わくは、今年“から”は
いい年でありますように。
findings.todokanai: And I hope it'll be a great year indeed.

findings.highlight: during winter break
findings.evidenceJa: 冬休みが空けた頃
findings.explanation: Setsuna's message arrives around the time winter break has ended, not during winter break. The translation shifts the renewed contact to the wrong side of the break.
findings.japanese:
冬休みが空けた頃、
雪菜から、メールが届いた。
findings.todokanai: On a certain day during winter break, Setsuna sent me a text.

findings.highlight: two weeks before final exams were over
findings.evidenceJa: 期末試験の終わった二週間前だった
findings.explanation: The invitation came two weeks earlier, after final exams had ended. The translation reverses the relative time and places it before the exams were over.
findings.japanese:
そんな中途半端な俺たちに業を煮やしたのか、
武也と依緒がスキー旅行の誘いをかけてきたのは、
期末試験の終わった二週間前だった。
findings.todokanai: Takeya and Io ended up inviting us to a skiing trip two weeks before final exams were over, probably because they've lost their patience after watching us not make any progress.

findings.highlight: Whenever you'd like is okay, got it?
findings.evidenceJa: いつならＯＫなんだよ？
findings.explanation: Takeya asks Haruki when he would be available. The translation turns that question into Takeya granting open-ended availability, reversing who must supply the date.
findings.japanese:
「いつならＯＫなんだよ？
もうすぐ３月だぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "Whenever you'd like is okay, got it? And it's almost March, you know?"

findings.highlight: "It feels like a situation where total newbies went on a blind date and somehow ended up alone with each other, then made a big fuss inside the car!"
findings.evidenceJa:
「まるで合コン初心者同士の二人が
いつの間にかツーショットになっていたような展開に、
車内騒然としております」
findings.explanation: The source says the car is in an uproar at the development resembling two blind-date novices ending up alone, while the English makes the imagined novices cause a fuss inside the car.
findings.japanese:
「まるで合コン初心者同士の二人が
いつの間にかツーショットになっていたような展開に、
車内騒然としております」
findings.todokanai: "It feels like a situation where total newbies went on a blind date and somehow ended up alone with each other, then made a big fuss inside the car!"

findings.highlight: "I… was hoping that you would help out a little, at least…"
findings.evidenceJa: 「俺、お前だけは運転手に数えてたんだけど…」
findings.explanation: Takeya specifically says he had counted Haruki as a driver, while the translation only says he hoped Haruki would help out.
findings.japanese: 「俺、お前だけは運転手に数えてたんだけど…」
findings.todokanai: "I… was hoping that you would help out a little, at least…"

findings.highlight: The snow piles up outside the window, slowly becoming thicker.
findings.evidenceJa:
車窓の外に降る雪は、
少しずつ、その密度を増していく。
findings.explanation: Falling snow grows denser, while the translation describes accumulated snow becoming thicker.
findings.japanese:
車窓の外に降る雪は、
少しずつ、その密度を増していく。
findings.todokanai: The snow piles up outside the window, slowly becoming thicker.

findings.highlight: "Ahh, is that right…? I guess I've been treating everyone pretty terribly. Sorry, it's just that I had a lot going on…"
findings.evidenceJa:
「ああ、そっか…俺、付き合い悪かったよな。
ごめん、ここしばらくはちょっと…」
findings.explanation: 付き合い悪い characterizes Haruki as unavailable or unsociable, while the translation says he has been treating everyone terribly.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、そっか…俺、付き合い悪かったよな。
ごめん、ここしばらくはちょっと…」
findings.todokanai: "Ahh, is that right…? I guess I've been treating everyone pretty terribly. Sorry, it's just that I had a lot going on…"

findings.highlight: But I meant what I said.
findings.evidenceJa: でも、言っちゃったのは本当のことなの
findings.explanation: Setsuna says it is true that she said the breakup words, not that she truly meant them. The translation converts an admission of the utterance into a claim of sincere intent, changing her motive in the rejection.
findings.japanese:
「でも、言っちゃったのは本当のことなの。
なのに、なのにさ…
どうして春希くんは、そんなわたしを好きだなんて…」
findings.todokanai: "But I meant what I said. So why…? How could Haruki-kun still possibly love me…?"

findings.highlight: will never be able to forget about Kazusa
findings.evidenceJa: 春希くんは決してかずさのことを忘れなかった
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Haruki did not forget Kazusa. The translation changes this observed past fact into a permanent future inability, adding fatalism and altering the basis of Setsuna's conclusion.
findings.japanese:
「ううん、幻想だった。
春希くんは決してかずさのことを忘れなかった」
findings.todokanai: "No, it's a delusion for sure. Haruki-kun will never be able to forget about Kazusa."

findings.highlight: I still love you, Setsuna!
findings.evidenceJa: 『やっぱり雪菜が大好きだ！』って
findings.explanation: Io quotes Haruki declaring to Io and Takeya that he loves Setsuna; Setsuna is not present. The translation turns the third-person declaration about her into direct address, falsely placing her as the addressee of the New Year's confession.
findings.japanese:
「除夜の鐘を聞きながら、俺たちの目の前でいきなり
『やっぱり雪菜が大好きだ！』って告白したくせに」
findings.todokanai: "Even though during the toll of the bell on New Year's Eve, you said, 'I still love you, Setsuna!' right in front of us."

findings.highlight: the way I'm saying this doesn't seem very friendly
findings.evidenceJa: 表現的にはとても味方してるように聞こえないけど
findings.explanation: Haruki observes that the way his two friends are expressing themselves does not sound supportive. The translation makes the issue Haruki's own manner of speaking, assigning the register judgment to the wrong speakers.
findings.japanese:
表現的にはとても味方してるように聞こえないけど、
今はそういうことを云々する場じゃない。
findings.todokanai: Though the way I'm saying this doesn't seem very friendly, now is not the time to pick on such details.

findings.highlight: "Besides… I'm the only one who can convince Setsuna right now."
findings.evidenceJa:
「それにさ…
今、雪菜を口説いていいのは俺だけだ」
findings.explanation: 口説く is woo or court romantically, while the translation uses the weaker 'convince.'
findings.japanese:
「それにさ…
今、雪菜を口説いていいのは俺だけだ」
findings.todokanai: "Besides… I'm the only one who can convince Setsuna right now."

findings.highlight: we're out of booze
findings.evidenceJa: 酒も回り
findings.explanation: The alcohol has taken effect as the night advances; it has not run out. The translation replaces growing intoxication with depleted supplies.
findings.japanese: 二時を回り、酒も回り…
findings.todokanai: It's past 2 o'clock, and we're out of booze…

findings.highlight: After spring break
findings.evidenceJa: 春休みに入ったら
findings.explanation: Takeya proposes going once spring break begins, meaning during the break. The translation schedules the outing after spring break.
findings.japanese:
「春休みに入ったらさ、
四人でどこか遊びに行かないか？」
findings.todokanai: "After spring break, how about the four of us go somewhere to hang out?"

findings.highlight: someone here would probably hate it
findings.evidenceJa: ここにいない誰かは嫌がるかもしれない
findings.explanation: Io jokes that someone not present—Setsuna—may dislike skiing. The translation says the person is here, breaking the absent-person reference.
findings.japanese:
「あ～、いいねぇ。
あたしスキーがいいな。
ここにいない誰かは嫌がるかもしれないけど」
findings.todokanai: "Aah, sounds good. I'd like to go skiing. But I imagine someone here would probably hate it."

findings.highlight: the club that was falling apart
findings.evidenceJa: メンバーにもなれないのに同好会にしがみついてた
findings.explanation: Haruki recalls clinging to the club even though he could not become a member. The translation invents a club falling apart and deletes his outsider status, which is the self-deprecating point of the recollection.
findings.japanese:
ギターを始めたのも、
作詞なんてものに興味を持ったのも、
メンバーにもなれないのに同好会にしがみついてたのも。
findings.todokanai: Back when I first started playing the guitar, or when I took an interest in writing lyrics, or when I held on and refused to let go of the club that was falling apart.

findings.highlight: it's very common for guys who take up the guitar to have a very simple and pure intention
findings.evidenceJa: 男の子がギターを始める、純粋な衝動に駆られて
findings.explanation: Haruki says that this time he is driven by the pure impulse that makes a boy take up guitar. The translation turns his renewed personal motive into a detached generalization about what is common for boys.
findings.japanese:
昔みたいに、ひねくれた理由じゃない。
男の子がギターを始める、
純粋な衝動に駆られて。
findings.todokanai: But it's not for that defiant reason from the past. In fact, it's very common for guys who take up the guitar to have a very simple and pure intention.

findings.highlight: economics department
findings.evidenceJa: 商学部
findings.explanation: 商学部 is the faculty or department of commerce/business, not economics. This is the first statement of Shouko's claimed academic affiliation.
findings.japanese:
「う～ん、商学部ってもともと学生多いしねぇ。
学生課に聞いてみたらどうかな？」
findings.todokanai: "Hmm, we have a lot of students in the economics department. Maybe you could try asking at the Student Affairs office?"

findings.highlight: she's just not here
findings.evidenceJa: だったらいないに決まってるじゃない
findings.explanation: After Student Affairs reports that no one by that name exists, the reply concludes that the person does not exist there. 'Not here' instead suggests a temporary absence and weakens the clue that Shouko supplied a false identity.
findings.japanese: 「だったらいないに決まってるじゃない」
findings.todokanai: "Then that just means she's just not here, doesn't it?"

findings.highlight: economics department student
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに商学部だって
findings.explanation: The dialogue repeats commerce/business as Shouko's claimed faculty. Rendering it as economics repeats the same false concrete affiliation.
findings.japanese: 「でも…確かに商学部だって、本人が…」
findings.todokanai: "Still… she told me she was an economics department student herself…"

findings.highlight: Now that the thesis review was finished, the professors and upperclassmen all returned to the bustling Ogishima lab, making thesis recital their next goal.
findings.evidenceJa:
論文レビューも終わり、教授も先輩たちも戻り、
卒論発表会に向けてにわかに活気を取り戻した荻島研。
findings.explanation: A thesis presentation is called a recital.
findings.japanese:
論文レビューも終わり、教授も先輩たちも戻り、
卒論発表会に向けてにわかに活気を取り戻した荻島研。
findings.todokanai: Now that the thesis review was finished, the professors and upperclassmen all returned to the bustling Ogishima lab, making thesis recital their next goal.

findings.highlight: "No matter how hard you try to cheer me on, I'll still feel pain when my feelings are hurt."
findings.evidenceJa:
「あまり意気に感じてくれても、
心苦しいっちゃぁ心苦しいんだけどね」
findings.explanation: 意気に感じる and 心苦しい are rendered as being cheered on and feeling hurt, flattening gratitude and guilty discomfort.
findings.japanese:
「あまり意気に感じてくれても、
心苦しいっちゃぁ心苦しいんだけどね」
findings.todokanai: "No matter how hard you try to cheer me on, I'll still feel pain when my feelings are hurt."

findings.highlight: university is just a place for me where I need to get enough credits to graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 大学ってのは、単位を取って卒業するだけの場所じゃない
findings.explanation: Io says university is not merely a place to earn credits and graduate. The translation omits the negation and asserts precisely the position she is rejecting.
findings.japanese:
「あたしにとって大学ってのは、
単位を取って卒業するだけの場所じゃないってこと」
findings.todokanai: "The way I see it, university is just a place for me where I need to get enough credits to graduate."

findings.highlight: a host on a TV show
findings.evidenceJa: 局アナになってみせる
findings.explanation: Tomo intends to become a staff announcer for a broadcasting network or station. A TV-show host is a different occupation and changes the career goal for which she sought the pageant title.
findings.japanese:
「あんなものはただの足がかりに過ぎないの。
卒業したら局アナになってみせるんだから。
そのためにミス峰城取ったんだし」
findings.todokanai: "That's just a stepping stone. I want to become a host on a TV show after I graduate. That's why I fought for the title of Miss Houjou."

findings.highlight: doesn't even deserve pity
findings.evidenceJa: 蹴落とす価値もない
findings.explanation: Io says this woman is not even worth knocking down or defeating as a rival. The translation replaces competitive contempt with a judgment about whether she deserves pity.
findings.japanese:
「ふざけんじゃないわよ！
こんな女、蹴落とす価値もないじゃない！
どこまでも人のこと馬鹿にして…っ！」
findings.todokanai: "Don't screw around with me! A woman like you doesn't even deserve pity! Just how long do you plan to make a fool of me…!?"

findings.highlight: I don't ever want to stand in such a bright place again
findings.evidenceJa: もう二度と、あんな光の当たる場所には立てない
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she can no longer stand in that brightly lit place because it is too dazzling for her current self. The translation turns emotional incapacity and unworthiness into a voluntary preference not to return.
findings.japanese:
「もう二度と、
あんな光の当たる場所には立てない。
…今のわたしには、眩しすぎるから」
findings.todokanai: "I don't ever want to stand in such a bright place again… It's simply too blindingly bright for someone like me now."

findings.highlight: I find myself bowing very politely
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にだけは礼儀正しく深々と頭を下げた
findings.explanation: Koharu bows deeply and politely to Haruki. The translation makes Haruki perform the bow, reversing the actor in their first interaction.
findings.japanese: 何故だか俺にだけは礼儀正しく深々と頭を下げた。
findings.todokanai: I don't know why, but I find myself bowing very politely.

findings.highlight: I could clearly imagine the restaurant closing down
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が辞めると言った日の、終業後の様子が目に浮かんできた
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines what happened after work on the day he said he would quit. The translation invents the restaurant itself closing down, a materially different event.
findings.japanese:
なんとなく、俺が辞めると言った日の、
終業後の様子が目に浮かんできたような気がする…
findings.todokanai: For one reason or another, on the day I've decided to quit, I could clearly imagine the restaurant closing down…

findings.highlight: After it had failed on me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺のときもその手口だったし
findings.explanation: Haruki says the same tearful-pleading tactic had been used on him, with the context implying it worked. The translation explicitly says it failed, reversing the joke about an effective tactic being reused.
findings.japanese:
責任感の強い杉浦相手には、
きっと泣き落としが効果的な戦法だったんだろう。
…俺のときもその手口だったし。
findings.todokanai: Since Sugiura is so responsible, tearful pleading must have proved an effective strategy on her… After it had failed on me, that is.

findings.highlight: Congratulations on graduating
findings.evidenceJa: 合格おめでとう
findings.explanation: Haruki congratulates Sugiura on being accepted or passing the selection to receive his notes and role. The translation turns that local approval into graduation.
findings.japanese:
「そういう奴だから安心して託せるんだよ。
杉浦、合格おめでとう」
findings.todokanai: "I'll leave you my notes exactly because you're this type of person. Congratulations on graduating, Sugiura."

findings.highlight: "Come on, try saying it. Say that you hate people like me more than anything. …I've been waiting for you to say that for some time now."
findings.evidenceJa:
「ほら、言ってみなよ。
あんたなんか大嫌いだって。
…さっきからずっとその言葉を待ってるんだけどなぁ」
findings.explanation: Koharu's request to say 'I hate you' becomes 'I hate people like you,' broadening a direct rejection into a type judgment.
findings.japanese:
「ほら、言ってみなよ。
あんたなんか大嫌いだって。
…さっきからずっとその言葉を待ってるんだけどなぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Come on, try saying it. Say that you hate people like me more than anything. …I've been waiting for you to say that for some time now."

findings.highlight: one of the people who encouraged me strikes me with a glare, perhaps not hearing all that I just said
findings.evidenceJa: 励ましてくれた人の方をちらりと見たけど、どうやら本人には伝わっていないようだった
findings.explanation: Haruki glances toward the person who encouraged him, but she apparently does not realize that he means her. The translation invents her glaring and not hearing, reversing the gaze and deleting the missed recognition.
findings.japanese:
…と、励ましてくれた人の方をちらりと見たけど、
どうやら本人には伝わっていないようだった。
findings.todokanai: …And one of the people who encouraged me strikes me with a glare, perhaps not hearing all that I just said.

findings.highlight: I used up my savings and had to bow my head before my mother to ask for money
findings.evidenceJa: 貯金を切り崩してでも、母親に頭下げてでも
findings.explanation: Haruki says he must prioritize the matter even if that means dipping into savings or bowing to his mother. The translation reports both contingencies as completed facts.
findings.japanese:
だからしばらくは、貯金を切り崩してでも、
母親に頭下げてでも、優先させなくちゃならない。
findings.todokanai: That's why even though I used up my savings and had to bow my head before my mother to ask for money, I have to prioritize that thing above everything else.

findings.highlight: pretending that our relationship is great
findings.evidenceJa: 家族には深い関係みたいに装って
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she pretends to her family that the relationship is deep or serious. The translation substitutes the vague claim that the relationship is going well and loses both the audience and the nature of the deception.
findings.japanese:
「退屈でも我慢して夜遅くまで時間潰して、
飲みたくもないお酒まで飲んで、
酔って遅く帰って、家族には深い関係みたいに装って…」
findings.todokanai: "I endure the boredom and kill time until evening, drinking when I don't even want to, going home drunk, pretending that our relationship is great…"

findings.highlight: it's not too close or too far, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 当たらずとも遠からずなんじゃない？
findings.explanation: The idiom means the accusation is not exactly right but is not far off. The literalized English instead discusses physical distance and obscures the proposition.
findings.japanese:
「ま、当たらずとも遠からずなんじゃない？
さ、大通りまで出るわよ」
findings.todokanai: "Well, it's not too close or too far, right? Come on, let's walk to the main street."

findings.highlight: My wrist has become weaker
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の腕の衰え
findings.explanation: 腕 here is Haruki's skill or ability, paired with insufficient practice and fragile skin. The translation treats the idiom as a physically weakened wrist, changing his appraisal of his playing.
findings.japanese:
自分の腕の衰えと練習不足と皮膚の弱さ…
互いに相関関係のある、どれも情けない今の現実に
ため息をつくと、それが指先に触れてまた痛む。
findings.todokanai: My wrist has become weaker due to the lack of practice, and my skin has become more fragile… These factors put together make me realize the awful truth. I sigh once again and flinch in pain when air reaches my fingers.

findings.highlight: a side of Setsuna I've seen quite recently
findings.evidenceJa: 出会って間もない頃の
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes the troublesome phone voice from shortly after they first met. The translation says he saw it recently, reversing the callback's time and losing the return of an early-relationship Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
それは、出会って間もない頃の、
電話口だといつもの３倍くらいワガママになってしまう、
困った雪菜。
findings.todokanai: And that's when I realize this is a side of Setsuna I've seen quite recently; her troublesome side, one that's three times more selfish than usual, even over the phone.

findings.highlight: ever since New Year's Eve
findings.evidenceJa: 元旦の時以来
findings.explanation: The last occasion was New Year's Day, not New Year's Eve. The distinction matters because it identifies the post-midnight confession call.
findings.japanese:
だって、あの、元旦の時以来、
雪菜の声を聞くことができたんだから。
findings.todokanai: Because ever since New Year's Eve, I haven't once heard Setsuna's voice until now.

findings.highlight: The same Setsuna whom I so heartlessly destroyed.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が潰してしまった残酷な雪菜
findings.explanation: The source balances 'the pure Setsuna I stole' against 'the cruel Setsuna I crushed.' The translation makes heartlessness describe Haruki's manner and deletes the cruel aspect of Setsuna that had also been destroyed.
findings.japanese:
これが、かつて俺が奪ってしまった純粋な雪菜。
俺が潰してしまった残酷な雪菜。
findings.todokanai: This is the same Setsuna whose purity I stole. The same Setsuna whom I so heartlessly destroyed.

findings.highlight: I want her to be selfish. I want her to be self-centered. I want her to put me on the spot.
findings.evidenceJa:
ワガママを言われたい。
拗ねられたい。
困らされたい。
findings.explanation: Haruki's wish for Setsuna to sulk at him is reduced to his being self-centered.
findings.japanese:
ワガママを言われたい。
拗ねられたい。
困らされたい。
findings.todokanai: I want her to be selfish. I want her to be self-centered. I want her to put me on the spot.

findings.highlight: I absolutely… absolutely… won't hang up!
findings.evidenceJa: 絶対に、絶対に…切っちゃ嫌ぁ
findings.explanation: Setsuna pleads with Haruki not to hang up. The translation makes Setsuna declare that she herself will not hang up, reversing who controls the threatened action.
findings.japanese:
「信じられない…
絶対に、絶対に…切っちゃ嫌ぁ」
findings.todokanai: "I don't believe you… I absolutely… absolutely… won't hang up!"

findings.highlight: And I suppose that's about it.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、それだけだよ
findings.explanation: Haruki states with deliberate simplicity that loving Setsuna is all there is to it. 'I suppose that's about it' adds uncertainty and sounds dismissive, materially weakening the declaration.
findings.japanese:
「俺は、雪菜が大好きだ。
ただ、それだけだよ」
findings.todokanai: "I love you, Setsuna. And I suppose that's about it."

findings.highlight: want to pretend it never happened
findings.evidenceJa: 消えてしまいたい
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she wants to disappear. The translation makes her want to pretend the preceding event never happened, changing self-erasure into denial of an event.
findings.japanese: 「わたし、わたし…消えてしまいたい。
findings.todokanai: "I… I… want to pretend it never happened.

findings.highlight: the way Setsuna used to avoid me was actually bad for me
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふうに雪菜が萎縮してしまうのこそ、俺にとってはお門違いだった
findings.explanation: Haruki says Setsuna cowering or shrinking back like this is the misplaced reaction. The translation substitutes her past avoidance of him, changing the immediate emotional response under discussion.
findings.japanese:
本当は、そんなふうに雪菜が萎縮してしまうのこそ、
俺にとってはお門違いだった。
findings.todokanai: To be honest, the way Setsuna used to avoid me was actually bad for me.

findings.highlight: all because Setsuna snapped at me
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜がこんなふうにテンパってしまったからこそ
findings.explanation: テンパる means Setsuna panicked or became badly flustered. The translation says she snapped at Haruki, replacing distress with aggression and changing why the two finally meet each other's eyes.
findings.japanese:
雪菜がこんなふうにテンパってしまったからこそ、
俺たちは一月ぶりに見つめあうことができた。
findings.todokanai: We're actually capable of seeing each other for the first time in a month all because Setsuna snapped at me.

findings.highlight: she can't resist prying further
findings.evidenceJa: 態度で踏み込んでくる
findings.explanation: Contrary to her words and expression, Setsuna's attitude or behavior steps closer into Haruki's space. The translation turns relational approach into intrusive questioning.
findings.japanese:
そして、言葉や表情とは逆に、
態度で踏み込んでくる。
findings.todokanai: Yet contrary to her words and expression, she can't resist prying further.

findings.highlight: I can now play this song from start to finish
findings.evidenceJa: 通しで弾こうとしても、未だに二、三箇所は止まってしまう
findings.explanation: Haruki says that even when he tries to play straight through, he still stops in two or three places. The translation first asserts that he can play start to finish, directly contradicting the limitation.
findings.japanese:
通しで弾こうとしても、
未だに二、三箇所は止まってしまう今の俺にとって、
弾き飽きるなんてことはまったく未知の領域だった。
findings.todokanai: Even though I can now play this song from start to finish, I still tend to pause in two or three places, so I'm far from the point where I can actually feel tired of playing this song.

findings.highlight: whenever I finish a song, she immediately wants to hear the next one
findings.evidenceJa: 演奏が止まってしまうと、すぐに再開を促す
findings.explanation: Whenever Haruki's playing stops, Setsuna immediately urges him to resume. The translation makes him finish songs normally and her request successive songs, deleting music's function of preventing silence.
findings.japanese:
だから雪菜は、俺のギターの音色を求める。
演奏が止まってしまうと、すぐに再開を促す。
findings.todokanai: That's why Setsuna wants to hear the sound of my guitar. That's why whenever I finish a song, she immediately wants to hear the next one.

findings.highlight: your Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday girlfriends
findings.evidenceJa: 月曜の彼女と火曜の彼女が水曜に鉢合わせ？
findings.explanation: The joke is that the Monday girlfriend and Tuesday girlfriend run into each other on Wednesday. The translation invents a third, Wednesday girlfriend and breaks the calendar setup.
findings.japanese:
「なに？　修羅場？
月曜の彼女と火曜の彼女が水曜に鉢合わせ？」
findings.todokanai: "What? Is there a fight going on inside? Did your Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday girlfriends happen to meet each other?"

findings.highlight: I spent the day wandering aimlessly and was just about ready to give up.
findings.evidenceJa: 途方に暮れて傷だらけの指を見つめたあの日
findings.explanation: Haruki recalls the day he stared at his battered fingers in despair over the missing instruments and vocalist. The translation invents a day of wandering and nearly giving up, deleting the concrete finger-and-guitar callback.
findings.japanese:
ギターしかいない、
ベースもドラムもボーカルすらもアテのない、
途方に暮れて傷だらけの指を見つめたあの日。
findings.todokanai: With only guitarists in the groupーwithout a bassist, a drummer, or a singerーI had no idea where to even start. I spent the day wandering aimlessly and was just about ready to give up.

findings.highlight: I've been keeping an eye on you since then, Setsuna. It's also one of the reasons why I asked you to take her spot.
findings.evidenceJa: あの頃からずっと雪菜を意識してたんだろうな。彼女の後釜に雪菜が座ったことも理由の一つかも
findings.explanation: Haruki speculates that Tomo had been conscious of Setsuna since then, perhaps partly because Setsuna occupied the successor position after her. The translation makes Haruki the watcher and invents that he asked Setsuna to take Tomo's spot.
findings.japanese:
「あの頃からずっと雪菜を意識してたんだろうな。
彼女の後釜に雪菜が座ったことも理由の一つかも」
findings.todokanai: "I've been keeping an eye on you since then, Setsuna. It's also one of the reasons why I asked you to take her spot."

findings.highlight: people who I can speak ill of nonchalantly
findings.evidenceJa: 人の嫌がることをズバズバ言うコ
findings.explanation: Setsuna objects to a girl who bluntly says things other people hate hearing. The translation makes Setsuna the person who can speak ill of those people, reversing the speaker of the offensive remarks.
findings.japanese:
「や、やめてよもう！　今寒気がしちゃったよ！
あんなに人の嫌がることをズバズバ言うコなんて
こっちから願い下げだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "D-Don't say that, jeez! You just gave me the chills! I'd rather not have to deal with people who I can speak ill of nonchalantly like that!"

findings.highlight: guaranteed to graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 進級も約束されたようなもの
findings.explanation: The notes supposedly guarantee advancement to the next academic year, not graduation.
findings.japanese:
「そんなことないってマジで！
何しろ六年間も使い続けてきた信頼品質だ。
これで俺の進級も約束されたようなもの」
findings.todokanai: "No way! I've been using this product for the past six years, so I can guarantee its quality. When I'm using these notes, I feel like I'm guaranteed to graduate!"

findings.highlight: The snack he ate with his tea
findings.evidenceJa: お茶請けっぽく置かれているピンクのリボンがついた紙包み
findings.explanation: A paper package tied with a pink ribbon sits there like a tea snack while Haruki avoids looking at it. The translation calls it a snack Takeya ate, inventing consumption and misidentifying the package.
findings.japanese:
そこにお茶請けっぽく置かれている
ピンクのリボンがついた紙包みを
必死で視界からそらしつつ…
findings.todokanai: I tried my best to avoid looking at it… The snack he ate with his tea, the bag with the pink ribbon on it…

findings.highlight: A question I ask about my sheet music and my parental bond
findings.evidenceJa: 楽譜も、親子の情愛も、なぁ…
findings.explanation: Haruki ruefully pairs the missing sheet music with missing parent-child affection. The English turns the parallel noun fragments into an unexplained question and obscures the proposition.
findings.japanese: 楽譜も、親子の情愛も、なぁ…
findings.todokanai: A question I ask about my sheet music and my parental bond…

findings.highlight: do you want me to fail them or something?
findings.evidenceJa: 俺一浪くらいならいいよね？
findings.explanation: Haruki asks his mother whether spending one year as a ronin to retake entrance examinations would be acceptable. The translation instead accuses her of wanting him to fail, changing both the academic fact and the speech act.
findings.japanese: 「…母さん俺一浪くらいならいいよね？」
findings.todokanai: "Mom… do you want me to fail them or something?"

findings.highlight: the honeymoon period
findings.evidenceJa: 今さら発情期ってのもなぁ
findings.explanation: Haruki crudely jokes that his parents are going into heat or rut at their age. 'Honeymoon period' sanitizes the sexual-animal register and changes the joke.
findings.japanese:
「今さら発情期ってのもなぁ…
ホント、あの二人っていつまでも仲いいよな」
findings.todokanai: "I guess this is what they call the honeymoon period… Those two are always so close."

findings.highlight: we suddenly fell into a slump, overwhelmed by our emotions and memories
findings.evidenceJa: 急に自己完結して落ち込んでいく『思い出しへこみ』
findings.explanation: This is Setsuna's recurring pattern of abruptly closing the loop inside herself and sinking when something triggers a memory. The translation makes both speakers jointly slump and loses the named behavioral pattern.
findings.japanese:
さっきまではしゃいでたはずなのに、
何かのきっかけがあると急に自己完結して
落ち込んでいく『思い出しへこみ』。
findings.todokanai: Although we were having a wonderful conversation just now, like on cue, we suddenly fell into a slump, overwhelmed by our emotions and memories.

findings.highlight: My graduation has already been guaranteed
findings.evidenceJa: とっくに進級は確定してる
findings.explanation: Setsuna says advancement to the next year is already assured, not graduation.
findings.japanese:
「わ、わたしも…
わたしも、とっくに進級は確定してる！」
findings.todokanai: "M-Me too! My graduation has already been guaranteed too!"

findings.highlight: If I stay chained to you
findings.evidenceJa: あなたを繋ぎ止めたまま
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she may keep Haruki tied to her while remaining unable to move. The translation makes Setsuna the person chained to Haruki, reversing who is binding whom in her confession of guilt.
findings.japanese:
「そうやって、あなたを繋ぎ止めたまま、
ずっとどこにも行けずに立ちすくんだままかも」
findings.todokanai: "If I stay chained to you like that, I'll probably always stand still, without ever being able to move anywhere…"

findings.highlight: Finals are about to start
findings.evidenceJa: 試験の真っ最中にまで
findings.explanation: Finals are already in full swing, not about to begin.
findings.japanese:
「…呆れてるのよ。
あんたたち、試験の真っ最中にまで、
そんなおままごと続けてんの？」
findings.todokanai: "…Of course I'm taken aback. Finals are about to start and you two are still fooling around like that?"

findings.highlight: If you want a man to show you affection, you have to take some desperate measures. If you're interested in him, go embrace him
findings.evidenceJa: 男が気を引こうと必死こいてるんだから、そいつに気があるなら女は抱かれてあげる
findings.explanation: Io says the man is desperately trying to win the woman's attention, and if she likes him she should let him take her to bed or embrace her. The translation makes the woman desperate and tells her to initiate the embrace, reversing both pursuit and sexual agency.
findings.japanese:
「男が気を引こうと必死こいてるんだから、
そいつに気があるなら女は抱かれてあげるんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "If you want a man to show you affection, you have to take some desperate measures. If you're interested in him, go embrace him, girl."

findings.highlight: I'm not particularly happy with some parts I played here and there
findings.evidenceJa: ところどころに自分の赤が入ってた
findings.explanation: The handwritten score has Haruki's own red annotations or corrections in places. The translation invents dissatisfaction with parts he played and loses the material trace by which the old score carries his participation.
findings.japanese:
ところどころに自分の赤が入ってた、
たった一日しか練習しなかった…
findings.todokanai: I'm not particularly happy with some parts I played here and there, but then again, I only had one day to practice…

findings.highlight: Noーto Setsuna, it might take an eternity until it isn't too soon for this song.
findings.evidenceJa:
いや、もしかしたら雪菜にとっては
“永遠に早すぎる”曲なのかもしれない。
findings.explanation: ‘It might take an eternity until it isn't too soon’ is tortured English and can suggest eventual readiness where 永遠に早すぎる means eternally too soon.
findings.japanese:
いや、もしかしたら雪菜にとっては
“永遠に早すぎる”曲なのかもしれない。
findings.todokanai: Noーto Setsuna, it might take an eternity until it isn't too soon for this song.

findings.highlight: that's not quite the reason why I stopped playing it willingly
findings.evidenceJa: 俺がそれを自分から止めるのは違うと思った
findings.explanation: Haruki decides it would be wrong for him to stop the song or the confrontation with memory of his own accord. The translation says he did stop voluntarily and merely disputes the reason, reversing the decision.
findings.japanese: でも、俺がそれを自分から止めるのは違うと思ったから。
findings.todokanai: Nevertheless, that's not quite the reason why I stopped playing it willingly.

findings.highlight: I'm doing my best in desperately removing whatever Setsuna doesn't want to see from her sight
findings.evidenceJa: 必死で見せないように努力するのは、俺のするべきことじゃない
findings.explanation: Haruki says desperately hiding from Setsuna whatever she averts her eyes from is not his role. The translation says he is actively doing exactly that, reversing the policy that motivates his use of the song.
findings.japanese:
雪菜が目をそらしているものを、
必死で見せないように努力するのは、
俺のするべきことじゃないって思ったから…
findings.todokanai: And even though I know it's not what I should be doing, I'm doing my best in desperately removing whatever Setsuna doesn't want to see from her sight.

findings.highlight: in the past few days, we've made a bit of progress
findings.evidenceJa: ここ数日で、ほんの少しは進展が見られるかもしれないという予感
findings.explanation: Setsuna's voice gives Haruki a premonition that the next few days may bring some progress. The translation turns that future possibility into progress already made over the past few days.
findings.japanese:
もしかしたらここ数日で、
ほんの少しは進展が見られるかもしれないという予感が、
じわじわと湧き上がってくる、雪菜の柔らかい声。
findings.todokanai: Listening to Setsuna's soothing voice, I couldn't help but excitedly think that in the past few days, we've made a bit of progress.

findings.highlight: she has to be careful so as to not unintentionally say anything hurtful
findings.evidenceJa: 意図しない言葉の刃で削り合うとき
findings.explanation: Haruki contrasts Tomo's stress release with the way he and Setsuna scrape and wound each other using unintended blades of language. The translation describes Setsuna carefully avoiding hurtful words, the opposite interaction.
findings.japanese: …俺と、意図しない言葉の刃で削り合うときとは対照的に。
findings.todokanai: …It's a stark contrast to how she speaks with me at least, where she has to be careful so as to not unintentionally say anything hurtful.

findings.highlight: Just then… it crossed my mind.
findings.evidenceJa: その時までは…そう思ってたんだ
findings.explanation: Haruki says that until that moment, he had believed Tomo might be a good frenemy for Setsuna; the phrasing foreshadows the imminent collapse of that belief. The translation merely repeats that the thought occurred then.
findings.japanese: その時までは…そう思ってたんだ。
findings.todokanai: Just then… it crossed my mind.

findings.highlight: after her second consecutive year of participating
findings.evidenceJa: 去年に引き続き二度目の登場となる
findings.explanation: The DJ says Tomo is making her second appearance on the program, following last year's appearance. The translation turns this into a second consecutive year of pageant participation.
findings.japanese:
「はい、ということで、今日のゲストは
去年に引き続き二度目の登場となる、今年度ミス峰城大、
柳原朋ちゃんにお越しいただきました」
findings.todokanai: "Thank you, that wraps things up. Our guest today was Yanagihara Tomo-chan, who won the title of Miss Houjou University this year after her second consecutive year of participating!"

findings.highlight: her mother instead felt grateful for my doing so
findings.evidenceJa: お母さんは逆に恐縮した
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother reacts apologetically or with embarrassed deference over the trouble, in contrast to the father's grim face. The translation says she is grateful, changing the parents' emotional response to Haruki's request.
findings.japanese:
門限になっても帰らない、居場所も連絡してこない
小木曽家の長女についての事情説明と協力要請に、
お父さんは渋い顔をして、お母さんは逆に恐縮した。
findings.todokanai: Having explained the situation about their daughter not returning past her curfew and giving no indication of her whereabouts before, then asking for their cooperation, her father had a sullen look on his face, while her mother instead felt grateful for my doing so.

findings.highlight: the reason for that is worse than even what I'm trying to do to her
findings.evidenceJa: そうなった理由の方が、わたしなんかよりよっぽどタチ悪くありません？
findings.explanation: Tomo says the reason—or person responsible—for Setsuna's loss of song may be far nastier than Tomo herself, pointedly implicating the past cause before Haruki. The translation compares that cause with Tomo's current actions instead, blunting the personal accusation.
findings.japanese:
「なんでそんなことになったんでしょうね…
もしかしたら、そうなった理由の方が、
わたしなんかよりよっぽどタチ悪くありません？」
findings.todokanai: "And I wonder what exactly caused that… I suppose the reason for that is worse than even what I'm trying to do to her, huh?"

findings.highlight: With all of the small handful of other places to search I could think of proving to be dead ends, I dragged my feet and returned to the Ogiso household, and like a tyrant, proclaimed it to be my forward base of operations during the course of this campaign.
findings.evidenceJa:
その他の数少ない心当たりも全て空振りに終わり、
疲れた足を引きずって、また小木曽家に戻ったのは、
ここを前線基地にしようという俺の横暴な計算から。
findings.explanation: Haruki's internal, overbearing calculation to use the Ogiso home as a forward base becomes an overt proclamation to the household.
findings.japanese:
その他の数少ない心当たりも全て空振りに終わり、
疲れた足を引きずって、また小木曽家に戻ったのは、
ここを前線基地にしようという俺の横暴な計算から。
findings.todokanai: With all of the small handful of other places to search I could think of proving to be dead ends, I dragged my feet and returned to the Ogiso household, and like a tyrant, proclaimed it to be my forward base of operations during the course of this campaign.

findings.highlight: Public Policy Department third-year students
findings.evidenceJa: 政経の三年
findings.explanation: 政経 denotes political science/economics, not a Public Policy Department. Io is naming the concrete academic group whose third-year students she contacted.
findings.japanese:
「とりあえず、政経の三年の心当たりには全部当たった。
…結局、空振りだったけどね」
findings.todokanai: "For starters, I've gotten in touch with all the Public Policy Department third-year students who I thought might have a clue. …But none of them had any idea."

findings.highlight: since she's gone under the radar, it's been extra hard for me
findings.evidenceJa: 本来の露払いが機能してなかったから
findings.explanation: Io says the person who was originally supposed to clear unwanted suitors and recruiters away—Haruki—had not been functioning in recent years. The translation instead says Setsuna went under the radar, replacing the absent protector with Setsuna's visibility.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜を看板にしようとするサークル多かったからね。
ここ数年、本来の露払いが機能してなかったから
苦労したのなんの」
findings.todokanai: "There are countless clubs that want Setsuna as their poster girl. Especially in these past couple of years, since she's gone under the radar, it's been extra hard for me."

findings.highlight: you only need to ask
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を…求めてくれよ
findings.explanation: Haruki pleads for Setsuna to want, need, or seek him. The translation turns that emotionally exposed demand into a generic instruction to ask, losing its object and relational force.
findings.japanese: 俺を…求めてくれよ。
findings.todokanai: Please… you only need to ask.

findings.highlight: I feel a strange sense of relief
findings.evidenceJa: 見事なまでに当初の予想通りの結果に落ち着きつつあった
findings.explanation: The fruitless search is settling into exactly the result Haruki predicted. The source does not say he feels relieved; the translation invents relief during his increasingly desperate search for Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
午前中から、かけた電話の件数はもう三桁を超えた。
もともと成果を期待できなかったローラー作戦は、
見事なまでに当初の予想通りの結果に落ち着きつつあった。
findings.todokanai: The number of places I've called must be in the hundreds by now since this morning. Admittedly, I didn't expect this strategy to bear any fruit, so upon having that prediction come true, I feel a strange sense of relief.

findings.highlight: I imagine, is most likely a lie
findings.evidenceJa: 多分、きっと、はっきりと偽証した
findings.explanation: The narration deliberately escalates through 'probably, surely, clearly' and says Setsuna perjured herself only on the final answer. The translation retreats to speculative 'I imagine' and 'most likely,' deleting the certainty produced by the paradoxical repetition.
findings.japanese:
最後のその一つにだけは、
多分、きっと、はっきりと偽証した。
findings.todokanai: This last sentence, I imagine, is most likely a lie.

findings.highlight: I'll call you later today.
findings.evidenceJa: 今日はちゃんと電話繋がるようにしとく
findings.explanation: Setsuna promises to keep her phone on and reachable that day. The translation instead promises an outgoing call later, changing the assurance she gives her family.
findings.japanese:
「…わかった。
今日はちゃんと電話繋がるようにしとく」
findings.todokanai: "…I understand. I'll call you later today."

findings.highlight: memories from the past three years
findings.evidenceJa: 三年前の記憶
findings.explanation: Haruki says the room now contains no memories or traces of what happened three years ago. The translation broadens this to memories from the entire intervening three-year period, changing the traumatic time being erased.
findings.japanese:
もう、俺たちの間に三年前の記憶はない。
思い出の痕跡は、お互い全て消し去った。
findings.todokanai: Meaning there's nothing holding memories from the past three years here now. I've removed everything that could possibly evoke any such memory for either of us.

findings.highlight: As if dispelled by her touch, the sound of the guitar stopped
findings.evidenceJa: ギターの音が止むと、まるで魔除けの効力が解けたかのように、雪菜が、喜び勇んで俺の領域に入り込む
findings.explanation: The guitar stops first; then, as though its protective charm has expired, Setsuna eagerly enters Haruki's space. The translation invents her touch stopping the guitar and reverses the metaphor's causal order.
findings.japanese:
ギターの音が止むと、
まるで魔除けの効力が解けたかのように、
雪菜が、喜び勇んで俺の領域に入り込む。
findings.todokanai: As if dispelled by her touch, the sound of the guitar stopped as Setsuna cheerfully invaded my personal space.

findings.highlight: our shadows merged into one
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちの影が一つに重なろうとして
findings.explanation: Their shadows are about to merge when Haruki interrupts the approach. The translation says they already merged, contradicting the prevented kiss or embrace that follows.
findings.japanese: ごく自然に、俺たちの影が一つに重なろうとして…
findings.todokanai: Naturally, our shadows merged into one…

findings.highlight: As I turn my vague reaction into a definite statement, I reveal its true meaning.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の曖昧な反応を勝手に肯定と捉えたせいで、馬脚を現してしまった
findings.explanation: Setsuna exposes her hand because she arbitrarily interprets Haruki's ambiguous response as assent. The translation makes Haruki convert his own response into a definite statement and reveal its meaning, reversing the interpreting subject.
findings.japanese:
俺の曖昧な反応を勝手に肯定と捉えたせいで、
馬脚を現してしまった。
findings.todokanai: As I turn my vague reaction into a definite statement, I reveal its true meaning.

findings.highlight: can sing and enjoy herself, despite my crappy guitar's accompaniment
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の下手くそなギターに、勝手に乗っかって歌い出す雪菜
findings.explanation: Haruki loves the Setsuna who jumps in uninvited and starts singing over his lousy guitar. The translation loses her spontaneous, presumptuous entry, which is the recurring unguarded behavior he wants restored.
findings.japanese:
「俺の下手くそなギターに、
勝手に乗っかって歌い出す雪菜が」
findings.todokanai: "The Setsuna who can sing and enjoy herself, despite my crappy guitar's accompaniment."

findings.highlight: make an impact before telling her what I really want to say
findings.evidenceJa: 落としてから持ち上げる口説き方のテクニック
findings.explanation: Takeya's pickup technique is to knock a hard-to-get or high-value girl down and then lift her up, exactly what Haruki's 'second in the world' feint performs. The translation replaces the down-then-up mechanism with making an impact and telling the truth, breaking the joke and explanation.
findings.japanese:
武也に教わった、『高めのコ』を狙うための、
落としてから持ち上げる口説き方のテクニック。
findings.todokanai: Takeya taught me this method of persuasion, telling me that in order to reach that "unreachable girl," I'd have to make an impact before telling her what I really want to say.

findings.highlight: despite complaining a lot during rehearsals
findings.evidenceJa: リハーサルの時はガチガチだったくせに
findings.explanation: Setsuna was rigid with nerves during rehearsal, then exuberant in the performance. The translation changes stage fright into complaining, mischaracterizing the contrast Haruki loves.
findings.japanese:
「リハーサルの時はガチガチだったくせに、
本番になったらノリノリで歌い上げて、
観客の大歓声に完璧な笑顔で応える雪菜が」
findings.todokanai: "The Setsuna who, despite complaining a lot during rehearsals, still sang to her heart's content during the actual concert and accepted the audience's cheers with a beaming smile."

findings.highlight: I must make her understand this.
findings.evidenceJa: 心の底まで…骨の髄までも墜とす必要がある
findings.explanation: Continuing the pickup-technique language, Haruki says he must bring or seduce her down not only bodily but to the bottom of her heart and marrow of her bones, with 墜とす intensifying the conquest metaphor. The translation replaces this with mere understanding and drops the whole payoff.
findings.japanese:
しかも身体だけじゃなく、心の底まで…
骨の髄までも墜とす必要があるから。
findings.todokanai: But it's not only her body, but the bottom of her heart as well… I must make her understand this.

findings.highlight: Setsuna will never judge the way I do things.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜は、決して俺のしていることを評価しない。
findings.explanation: 評価しない means Setsuna will not acknowledge or accept what Haruki is doing, while 'will never judge' can suggest she refrains from criticizing him.
findings.japanese: 雪菜は、決して俺のしていることを評価しない。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna will never judge the way I do things.

findings.highlight: Are you pretending to be lonely…? Why is that, I wonder…?
findings.explanation: The Japanese line is only silence. The translation invents a complete two-question utterance, assigning Setsuna explicit thoughts and speech where the scene deliberately ends without a verbal decision.
findings.todokanai: "Are you pretending to be lonely…? Why is that, I wonder…?"

findings.highlight: performances are reserved exclusively for the students of Houjou University
findings.evidenceJa: 峰城大生限定の音楽イベント
findings.explanation: The event itself is limited to students of 峰城 University. The translation instead restricts the performances to student performers, changing who may attend or participate.
findings.japanese:
大学内でミニＦＭ局を運営する放送研究サークル
『峰城ブロードキャスト』が企画、運営する
峰城大生限定の音楽イベント。
findings.todokanai: A musical event whose performances are reserved exclusively for the students of Houjou University in accord with a project known as Houjou Broadcast, hosted by a group comprising the mini FM station's broadcasting and research club.

findings.highlight: tried to reassure her
findings.evidenceJa: どれだけ口説いたか
findings.explanation: Haruki counts how insistently he wooed or courted Setsuna alongside repeating that he loved her. The translation recasts that romantic pursuit as reassurance.
findings.japanese:
どれだけ口説いたか。
どれだけ『好き』を繰り返したことか…
findings.todokanai: All those times I tried to reassure her. And all those times I told her I love her…

findings.highlight: "Go for it, Haruki. …And let me know whether your winter has ended, okay?"
findings.evidenceJa:
「頑張ってね、春希。
…あんたの冬が終わったのかどうか、
ちゃんと聴かせてもらうからね？」
findings.explanation: Chikashi literally says she will listen to the performance to determine whether Haruki's winter has ended, while the English asks him to let her know.
findings.japanese:
「頑張ってね、春希。
…あんたの冬が終わったのかどうか、
ちゃんと聴かせてもらうからね？」
findings.todokanai: "Go for it, Haruki. …And let me know whether your winter has ended, okay?"

findings.highlight: what has she been doing since the beginning of the April semester
findings.evidenceJa: 四月からの学年
findings.explanation: The source wonders what school year she will be in from April. The translation instead asks what she has been doing since April, reversing the temporal direction and replacing grade level with activity.
findings.japanese: あと、あいつの四月からの学年とか。
findings.todokanai: And just what has she been doing since the beginning of the April semester?

findings.highlight: The chances of being spotted by another girl are really low too.
findings.evidenceJa: 他の彼女に見つかるリスクは伴うけど
findings.explanation: Takeya says the cheap, atmospheric venue carries a risk of being spotted by another girlfriend. The translation says that risk is very low and makes it another advantage, reversing the joke's warning.
findings.japanese:
「安く上がる割にはムードいいからな。
他の彼女に見つかるリスクは伴うけど」
findings.todokanai: "It's cheap, and the atmosphere here is great. The chances of being spotted by another girl are really low too."

findings.highlight: the sole member who we could rely on for the music
findings.evidenceJa: 音楽的に中心にいたメンバー
findings.explanation: Kazusa was the member at the musical center of the earlier group. Calling her the sole musically reliable member converts centrality into exclusive competence and disparages the remaining performers.
findings.japanese:
しかもあの時、音楽的に中心にいたメンバーは、
今はこの場にいないと来たら…
findings.todokanai: And the worst part might be the fact that the sole member who we could rely on for the music isn't with us this time…

findings.highlight: I won't let us ever be apart.
findings.evidenceJa: 離れてなんかいない
findings.explanation: Haruki denies that the three are apart now. The translation replaces that present claim with a future promise under his control, changing both state and agency.
findings.japanese:
「離れてなんかいない。
ずっと、一緒だ」
findings.todokanai: "I won't let us ever be apart. We'll be together forever."

findings.highlight: Maybe Ogiso doesn't know.
findings.evidenceJa: 小木曽はわからなくないにしても
findings.explanation: The speaker says Ogiso's nervousness is understandable and asks why Yada is nervous. The translation makes the clause about Ogiso not knowing something, breaking the comparison that motivates the question.
findings.japanese:
「なに緊張してるのよ矢田？
小木曽はわからなくないにしても」
findings.todokanai: "What are you freaking out for, Yada? Maybe Ogiso doesn't know."

findings.highlight: Please leave me out of it
findings.evidenceJa: せめて俺を巡ってにしてくれよ
findings.explanation: Takeya jokes that if the women are going to have a showdown, it should at least be over him. The translation says the opposite: leave him out of it.
findings.japanese:
「お前らなぁ…
修羅場るならせめて俺を巡ってにしてくれよ」
findings.todokanai: "Listen, you two… Please leave me out of it if you're going to come to blows."

findings.highlight: if we'll ever be able to truly restore the bond
findings.evidenceJa: 完全に修復したかどうかもわからない
findings.explanation: Haruki is uncertain whether the broken bond has already been fully repaired. The translation turns that present uncertainty into doubt that repair will ever be possible.
findings.japanese: 壊れた絆が完全に修復したかどうかもわからない。
findings.todokanai: I don't know if we'll ever be able to truly restore the bond that we once destroyed.

findings.highlight: Still, the feelings and thoughts we are pouring into it right now are incomparable to those we had back then.
findings.evidenceJa:
けれど、そこに込められた想いだけは、
あの時の俺たちにだって引けは取ってないと思ってる。
findings.explanation: A claim that the performance is no less affecting than the earlier one becomes a claim that it is incomparable.
findings.japanese:
けれど、そこに込められた想いだけは、
あの時の俺たちにだって引けは取ってないと思ってる。
findings.todokanai: Still, the feelings and thoughts we are pouring into it right now are incomparable to those we had back then.

findings.highlight: our only friend
findings.evidenceJa: もう一人の親友
findings.explanation: Kazusa is the other close friend. Calling her their only friend excludes the friendship between Haruki and Setsuna and changes the trio's relationship structure.
findings.japanese:
遠い空にいる、もう一人の親友に、
俺たちは大丈夫だよって、伝えるために。
findings.todokanai: To tell our only friend on the other side of the horizon that everything is alright, just as before.

findings.highlight: The two of us have come together
findings.evidenceJa: かずさがいなくなって、俺たちは、二人になった
findings.explanation: The source says Kazusa left and the three thereby became two. The translation positively states that Haruki and Setsuna came together, replacing loss and subtraction with romantic union.
findings.japanese:
かずさがいなくなって、
俺たちは、二人になった。
findings.todokanai: The two of us have come togetherーin an era where Kazusa is no longer with us.

findings.highlight: continue moving on with our own lives
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちは二人で生きていく
findings.explanation: Haruki says the two of them will live together or live as a pair from now on. The translation's separate 'own lives' erases the joint commitment.
findings.japanese: だけどこれからは、俺たちは二人で生きていく。
findings.todokanai: But even so, we must continue moving on with our own lives.

findings.highlight: Setsuna even more so
findings.evidenceJa: 俺にとってはたった一年。雪菜に至っては半年
findings.explanation: Haruki says his time with Kazusa was only a year and Setsuna's only half a year. The translation invents a comparison in which Setsuna received even more from Kazusa in half the time.
findings.japanese:
俺にとってはたった一年。
雪菜に至っては半年の…
findings.todokanai: I received so much from her in only a year; Setsuna even more so, and in half the time I had with her, no less…

findings.highlight: everythingーwe can no longer bear with us from here on out
findings.evidenceJa: 形に残らないものをもらった
findings.explanation: They received many intangible things from Kazusa. The translation says these are things they can no longer carry forward, reversing enduring influence into abandonment.
findings.japanese:
たくさんの、いろいろな、
形に残らないものをもらったから。
findings.todokanai: All of itーeverythingーwe can no longer bear with us from here on out, in any shape or form.

findings.highlight: "Well then… now that I've gained some strength for the first time in three years, maybe it's time I started working toward my own goal as well."
findings.evidenceJa:
「さてと…三年ぶりに力もらったことだし、
あたしもラストスパート頑張るか」
findings.explanation: The final push toward an already established goal is generalized into beginning toward the goal.
findings.japanese:
「さてと…三年ぶりに力もらったことだし、
あたしもラストスパート頑張るか」
findings.todokanai: "Well then… now that I've gained some strength for the first time in three years, maybe it's time I started working toward my own goal as well."

findings.highlight: You've really been wearing on us
findings.evidenceJa: こっちだって結構キてるのに
findings.explanation: The others say they are quite emotionally affected too, but cannot immerse themselves because of Yada. The translation instead says Yada has been wearing them down, changing their emotion and its cause.
findings.japanese:
「ほらぁ…もういい加減落ち着きなよ。
こっちだって結構キてるのに、
あんたのせいで浸れないじゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "Come on… it's about time you calmed down. You've really been wearing on us; we couldn't even enjoy the whole song because of you."

findings.highlight: after I graduate
findings.evidenceJa: 俺も進学したら
findings.explanation: Takahiro wonders whether he will understand once he advances to university. The translation moves the milestone to graduation, the opposite end of university life.
findings.japanese:
「ふぅん…
俺も進学したらわかるようになんのかな？」
findings.todokanai: "Hmmm… Will I be able to understand it too after I graduate?"

findings.highlight: After passing the guard
findings.evidenceJa: ガードをくぐった先
findings.explanation: ガード is the railway underpass they pass beneath on the way to the familiar apartment. The translation invents a security guard and corrupts the route description.
findings.japanese:
ガードをくぐった先の、
見慣れたマンションが、ある。
findings.todokanai: After passing the guard, we see a familiar apartment building.

findings.highlight: If I truly want the two of us to stay together forever from now on, I have to make some big decisions and follow through with them.
findings.evidenceJa:
これからも、ずっと二人でいるために、
決めなくちゃならないこと全てを洗い出したい。
findings.explanation: A promise to report every decision is reduced to following some major decisions.
findings.japanese:
これからも、ずっと二人でいるために、
決めなくちゃならないこと全てを洗い出したい。
findings.todokanai: If I truly want the two of us to stay together forever from now on, I have to make some big decisions and follow through with them.

findings.highlight: Rather than leaving her for a bit
findings.evidenceJa: 一度離れようとしてしまった以上
findings.explanation: Haruki asks whether merely changing his mind and sleeping beside Setsuna can warm her now that he already tried to leave. The translation turns that causal past act into an alternative he did not choose.
findings.japanese:
一度離れようとしてしまった以上、
このまま気が変わったと、一緒に眠るだけで、
雪菜はふたたび心から温まってくれるだろうか？
findings.todokanai: Rather than leaving her for a bit, would the sole act of changing my mind and sleeping together with her be able to warm Setsuna's heart up once again?

findings.highlight: she hasn't had enough of me spoiling her
findings.evidenceJa: 甘えるだけでは飽きたらず
findings.explanation: Setsuna is not satisfied with only acting dependent or affectionate and escalates her own behavior. The translation makes Haruki's spoiling of her the action she wants more of.
findings.japanese: しかも甘えるだけでは飽きたらず…
findings.todokanai: But it's like she hasn't had enough of me spoiling her…

findings.highlight: low blood pressure isn't something you should worry about
findings.evidenceJa: 『低血圧だろ』という指摘は
findings.explanation: After Setsuna mistakenly says low atmospheric pressure, Haruki deliberately refrains from correcting her to low blood pressure because of the mood. The translation invents medical reassurance and loses the pressure-word correction.
findings.japanese:
『低血圧だろ』という指摘は、
この場の空気を冷静に鑑みて敢えてスルーした。
findings.todokanai: I realized, after thinking about it for a moment, that "low blood pressure isn't something you should worry about" isn't an appropriate comment to make in this situation.

findings.highlight: she just doesn't know what to do
findings.evidenceJa: もう、色々とどうしたらいいのやら
findings.explanation: The first-person narration says Haruki does not know what to do with the enormous gap from last night. The translation assigns that uncertainty to Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
…昨夜とのギャップが凄すぎて、
もう、色々とどうしたらいいのやら。
findings.todokanai: …Because the gap between now and last night is too great, she just doesn't know what to do.

findings.highlight: something that we should have been dealing with
findings.evidenceJa: 三年間でゆっくり重ねるはずだった行為
findings.explanation: Setsuna tried in three hours to catch up on intimate acts they should have accumulated slowly over three years. 'Dealing with' recasts the intimacy as an unresolved problem.
findings.japanese:
俺たちが三年間でゆっくり重ねるはずだった行為に、
たった三時間で追いつこうとした。
findings.todokanai: She wanted to make up for something that we should have been dealing with over the course of three years in a mere three hours.

findings.highlight: "This really isn't the time for keen insights like that…"
findings.evidenceJa: 「穿った見方するなって…」
findings.explanation: Haruki tells Setsuna not to take a cynical or warped view, while the English calls her response a keen insight.
findings.japanese: 「穿った見方するなって…」
findings.todokanai: "This really isn't the time for keen insights like that…"

findings.highlight: with a single stream of tears, undoubtedly precious and pure
findings.evidenceJa: 一筋の涙で答え合わせをしてくれた
findings.explanation: Setsuna's tear lets Haruki check and confirm the emotional answer he has just reached. The translation leaves a descriptive fragment and omits the tear's confirming function.
findings.japanese:
何度流してみせても、その尊さにちっとも陰りの見えない
一筋の涙で答え合わせをしてくれた。
findings.todokanai: …And with a single stream of tears, undoubtedly precious and pure, no matter how many times she has shown them before.

findings.highlight: I had no choice but to trick… Uhh, I mean "appease" her with my guitar.
findings.evidenceJa:
仕方がないから雪菜を口説…じゃなくて、
それ用のツールを適当に弾いていた。
findings.explanation: The self-correction from wooing Setsuna to strumming a tool meant for that purpose is rewritten as tricking and appeasing her with a guitar.
findings.japanese:
仕方がないから雪菜を口説…じゃなくて、
それ用のツールを適当に弾いていた。
findings.todokanai: I had no choice but to trick… Uhh, I mean "appease" her with my guitar.

findings.highlight: she'd just give up and slouch on top of me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を前屈みに…いたたまれなくさせた
findings.explanation: Setsuna's teasing leaves Haruki bent forward and unable to sit comfortably. The translation makes Setsuna give up and slump on him, reversing the subject and bodily consequence.
findings.japanese:
けれどまだ日が出てるせいなのか、
決してそれ以上の雰囲気には持ち込まず、
俺を前屈みに…いたたまれなくさせた。
findings.todokanai: But, perhaps because the sun was still up, she refused to do anything beyond that, so she'd just give up and slouch on top of me.

findings.highlight: notices what's in my heart
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の心にけじめをつけ
findings.explanation: Setsuna quickly settles matters within her own heart and reaches the actually correct conclusion. The translation says she notices what is in Haruki's heart instead.
findings.japanese:
雪菜はあっさり自分の心にけじめをつけ、
『本当は正しい』結論を出してしまった。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna easily notices what's in my heart and responds with an apt, proper conclusion to all this.

findings.highlight: She must have become aware
findings.evidenceJa: 悪魔の誘惑だって、自覚してた
findings.explanation: Haruki says he himself was conscious that this was devilish temptation. The translation assigns the awareness to Setsuna and weakens it into speculation.
findings.japanese: 悪魔の誘惑だって、自覚してた。
findings.todokanai: She must have become aware of the devilish temptation we're locked in.

findings.highlight: so many painful and cruel things I did
findings.evidenceJa: 辛いことや苦しいことが多くて
findings.explanation: Setsuna says there were many painful and difficult experiences at first, then separately apologizes for the awful things she said. The translation turns the suffering itself into painful and cruel acts she committed.
findings.japanese:
「色々とあったけど…
特に、最初は辛いことや苦しいことが多くて、
色々と酷いこと言っちゃってごめんなさい」
findings.todokanai: "So much has happened… Especially when it first started, there were so many painful and cruel things I did… And I also said so many awful things to you. For that, I'm sorry."

findings.highlight: a girl by the name of Ogiso Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 小木曽雪菜という“女性”
findings.explanation: The passage culminates by calling Setsuna a woman strong enough to master both her girl-like and womanly sides. The translation calls her a girl, erasing the explicit maturation contrast.
findings.japanese:
でも、その二人をねじ伏せる強さまで持ってる、
小木曽雪菜という“女性”
findings.todokanai: Someone who's capable of keeping the two contrasting strengths she holds in checkーa girl by the name of Ogiso Setsuna.

findings.highlight: It's my dutyーthis I know full well.
findings.evidenceJa: 義務感を持ってるって、思い込んでた
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes that he only thought he was protecting Setsuna and had convinced himself he acted from duty. The translation presents protection and duty as current certainties, erasing the self-deception he is confessing.
findings.japanese:
俺が雪菜を庇護してるつもりだったのに。
義務感を持ってるって、思い込んでたのに。
findings.todokanai: I'm the one that should be protecting Setsuna. It's my dutyーthis I know full well.

findings.highlight: None of those things would ever occur to her
findings.evidenceJa: 最低の想像しか浮かんでこない
findings.explanation: Haruki says only the worst interpretations occur to him. The translation instead claims those ideas would never occur to Setsuna, changing both thinker and polarity.
findings.japanese:
…なんて、どれもこれも、
最低の想像しか浮かんでこないんだけど。
findings.todokanai: …What am I even thinking? None of those things would ever occur to her, even if she were to picture me in the worst way possible.

findings.highlight: the damage she's received
findings.evidenceJa: 実は結構ダメージを受けていた
findings.explanation: Haruki admits that he himself took a substantial emotional hit from Setsuna's answer. The translation assigns the damage to Setsuna.
findings.japanese: 実は結構ダメージを受けていた。
findings.todokanai: Such is the extent of the damage she's received.

findings.highlight: My astonishingly crafty self
findings.evidenceJa: 現金な奴
findings.explanation: Haruki calls Setsuna shamelessly quick to perk up once he makes his promise. The translation makes Haruki the crafty or opportunistic person instead.
findings.japanese: そんな、呆れるくらいに現金な奴…
findings.todokanai: My astonishingly crafty self right now…

findings.highlight: a foundation of my love toward Setsuna
findings.evidenceJa: 深い愛情だけが、今の俺のよりどころ
findings.explanation: Haruki says his small, narrow, deep love for Setsuna is the only support or anchor he has now. The translation makes an unidentified thing a foundation of that love and loses the clause's central relationship.
findings.japanese:
雪菜に対しての、小さくて、狭くて、
そして、深い愛情だけが、今の俺のよりどころ。
findings.todokanai: Is simply a foundation of my love toward Setsuna, however small and narrow, albeit deep and profound it may be.

findings.highlight: "That's fine. Even if it hurts so much that I feel I could die, I would have no complaints. …In a way, that's how I'd ideally want to die, after all."
findings.evidenceJa:
「大丈夫。
苦しくて死にそうになっても絶対に言わないよ。
だってそれ、ある意味理想の死に方だよね」
findings.explanation: Setsuna's claim that she would not tell him even if it became unbearable becomes a claim that she would have no complaints.
findings.japanese:
「大丈夫。
苦しくて死にそうになっても絶対に言わないよ。
だってそれ、ある意味理想の死に方だよね」
findings.todokanai: "That's fine. Even if it hurts so much that I feel I could die, I would have no complaints. …In a way, that's how I'd ideally want to die, after all."

findings.highlight: Drown me in more and more of
findings.evidenceJa: もっと、わたしに溺れ
findings.explanation: Setsuna tells Haruki to drown in her, and to drown in her more deeply. The translation makes Setsuna ask to be drowned, reversing the desired subject and object.
findings.japanese:
「溺れて…
もっと、わたしに溺れ…んちゅぅぅぅ…ぷぁっ、
は、あ、あ…こほっ、こほっ…ん、ん～っ！」
findings.todokanai: "Drown me in it… Drown me in more and more of… nnchu, haa, haa, aah, kuh, kuh… nn, nn～!"

findings.highlight: savor even more of our mixed saliva
findings.evidenceJa: 飲み込み、飲み込ませる
findings.explanation: The source ends with one partner swallowing and making the other swallow, a reciprocal exchange. The translation reduces both directed actions to savoring mixed saliva.
findings.japanese:
そしてまた、すぐに唇を重ね、
舌を重ね、歯をぶつけ、唾液を混ぜ合わせ、
飲み込み、飲み込ませる。
findings.todokanai: And once again bring our lips together, entwine our tongues, bump our teeth every now and then, and savor even more of our mixed saliva.

findings.highlight: an aesthetically pleasing, but unassured method of treatment
findings.evidenceJa: 保険の利かない治療
findings.explanation: Setsuna chose an expensive cosmetic treatment not covered by health insurance. The translation calls it an 'unassured' treatment, turning an insurance-coverage fact into a claim about medical reliability.
findings.japanese:
その被せ物が、白いことも。
見栄張って保険の利かない治療を選んだことも。
findings.todokanai: The sparkling white on that crown. The fact that she chose an aesthetically pleasing, but unassured method of treatment.

findings.highlight: everything that has escaped us
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで逃げていた分
findings.explanation: Setsuna's gaze seems to reclaim everything she herself had fled from until now. The translation makes unspecified things escape the pair, erasing her earlier avoidance and present reversal.
findings.japanese:
今まで逃げていた分を
全て取り返そうとするかのように、
俺を、深くまでえぐる。
findings.todokanai: As if trying to make up for everything that has escaped us, they pierce deeply into my heart.

findings.highlight: Make a mess of me. Don't hold back.
findings.evidenceJa: 無理やり、して。寄り道なんかしないで
findings.explanation: Setsuna explicitly asks Haruki to do it forcefully, not take detours, and come to her quickly. The translation substitutes making a mess and not holding back, obscuring the force and direct-route instructions that define the requested act.
findings.japanese:
「無理やり、して。
寄り道なんかしないで。
早く、わたしのところに来てよぉ」
findings.todokanai: "Make a mess of me. Don't hold back. Hurry up and come to me already."

findings.highlight: As I bring my hand up to her waist in an attempt to lower her stockings and underwear, Setsuna reaches for the zipper on my pants.
findings.evidenceJa:
俺が、雪菜の腰にまで手を伸ばし、
ショーツごとストッキングをずり下ろしたのを察知すると、
雪菜も、俺のズボンのファスナーに手をかける。
findings.explanation: The culmination of preparation is softened to an attempt to proceed.
findings.japanese:
俺が、雪菜の腰にまで手を伸ばし、
ショーツごとストッキングをずり下ろしたのを察知すると、
雪菜も、俺のズボンのファスナーに手をかける。
findings.todokanai: As I bring my hand up to her waist in an attempt to lower her stockings and underwear, Setsuna reaches for the zipper on my pants.

findings.highlight: Just this foreplay was enough
findings.evidenceJa: こんな、準備だけすぐに
findings.explanation: Setsuna marvels that although she has never had sex, her body became physically prepared so quickly. The translation mistakes that bodily readiness for foreplay and leaves the contrast incomplete.
findings.japanese:
「したこと、ないのに…
こんな、準備だけすぐに…っ」
findings.todokanai: "Even though I've never done it before… Just this foreplay was enough to…"

findings.highlight: has been preparing for it for all these years
findings.evidenceJa: その頃から身体が勝手に準備を始めてしまい
findings.explanation: Haruki speculates that Setsuna's body involuntarily began preparing from around that moment. The translation factualizes the inference and changes the onset into continuous preparation across all the intervening years.
findings.japanese:
だから雪菜は、必死でそれに応えようと、
その頃から身体が勝手に準備を始めてしまい…
