findings.japanese:
「とにかく俺はね、
そういう、後で気の迷いだったとか思われそうな
状況はヤなの」
findings.todokanai: "In any case, I wouldn't want to discover that I've been under nothing but a delusion after that."

findings.highlight: I wonder if it'll be acceptable.
findings.evidenceJa: うまく行ったな
findings.explanation: Haruki states with satisfaction that it went well. The translation converts this into doubt about whether it will be accepted.
findings.japanese: 「うまく行ったな」
findings.todokanai: "I wonder if it'll be acceptable."

findings.highlight: Kazusa's not going to forgive me anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさはもう、許しはしなかった。
findings.explanation: In context 許す means Kazusa will no longer permit Haruki to remain with her or keep circling indecisively; she orders him to go to Setsuna. It is not a declaration that she will not forgive him.
findings.japanese: かずさはもう、許しはしなかった。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa's not going to forgive me anymore.

findings.highlight: the person I once loved.
findings.evidenceJa: さようなら…あたしの愛した春希
findings.explanation: Kazusa's 愛した is an attributive farewell to the Haruki she has loved, not a claim that her love is over. She explicitly says immediately before and after this that she will love him forever. 'Once loved' introduces a contradiction absent from the Japanese.
findings.japanese: 「さようなら…あたしの愛した春希」
findings.todokanai: "Goodbye, Haruki… the person I once loved."

findings.highlight: ease and resentment
findings.evidenceJa: 安堵と悔恨の色
findings.explanation: 悔恨 is regret or remorse, not resentment. Setsuna is simultaneously relieved at being chosen and remorseful about what that choice does to Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
そして、そんな数々の表情の中に、
安堵と悔恨の色が同時にさぁっと広がっていく。
findings.todokanai: And within her varying expressions, I can see ease and resentment spreading across her face simultaneously.

findings.highlight: I love Kazusa. And I love you more than anything, Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺、かずさのことが好きだ。そして俺、雪菜を愛してる
findings.explanation: The load-bearing distinction is 好き for Kazusa versus 愛してる for Setsuna: 'I love Kazusa. But I'm in love with you, Setsuna.' Todokanai TL replaces that contrast with an unsupported comparative 'more than anything,' flattening the precise emotional taxonomy.
findings.japanese:
「俺、かずさのことが好きだ。
そして俺、雪菜を愛してる」
findings.todokanai: "I love Kazusa. And I love you more than anything, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: in my ignorance of her lingering affections for me.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさへの未練を、なにも知らずに振り切ろうとする俺じゃなく
findings.explanation: かずさへの未練 is Haruki's lingering attachment to Kazusa, not Kazusa's affection for him. He is rejecting the version of himself that unknowingly tried to shake off his own unresolved feelings.
findings.japanese:
かずさへの未練を、
なにも知らずに振り切ろうとする俺じゃなく。
findings.todokanai: Nor am I the person who brushed Kazusa away in my ignorance of her lingering affections for me.

findings.highlight: Did she say that? Did Kazusa really say something like that!?
findings.evidenceJa: 言ったの？かずさにそんなこと言っちゃったの！？
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether Haruki said those cruel terms to Kazusa. Todokanai TL reverses the direction and asks whether Kazusa said them.
findings.japanese:
「言ったの？
かずさにそんなこと言っちゃったの！？」
findings.todokanai: "Did she say that? Did Kazusa really say something like that!?"

findings.highlight: She did!
findings.evidenceJa: 言ったよ！
findings.explanation: Haruki answers 'I did!' Todokanai TL makes Kazusa the speaker again, extending the reversal from the preceding line.
findings.japanese:
「言ったよ！
だって俺が愛してるの雪菜だけだもん！」
findings.todokanai: "She did! Because you're the only one I truly love, Setsuna!"

findings.highlight: I sought you to help Kazusa after tossing her aside
findings.evidenceJa: かずさにふらついて、かずさとの解決を丸投げして
findings.explanation: Haruki confesses that he wavered toward Kazusa and dumped the work of resolving the Kazusa conflict onto Setsuna. Todokanai TL instead says he tossed Kazusa aside and then asked Setsuna to help her.
findings.japanese:
「だって俺、雪菜に酷いことばかりした。
かずさにふらついて、かずさとの解決を丸投げして、
それどころか、そのことずっと隠してて…」
findings.todokanai: "After all, I've been nothing but cruel to you, Setsuna. I sought you to help Kazusa after tossing her aside, and more importantly, I've hid that from you the whole time…"

findings.highlight: please don't leave me alone…!
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を、見殺しにしないで
findings.explanation: Haruki coercively pleads 'don't leave me to die.' 'Don't leave me alone' suppresses the deliberately ugly emotional extremity that Setsuna immediately condemns.
findings.japanese:
「それでも考えて…
俺を、見殺しにしないで」
findings.todokanai: "Even so, please consider… please don't leave me alone…!"

findings.explanation: Haruki realizes that gentle sex can sometimes hurt one's partner precisely because it is gentle. The translation turns this broader, present realization into a completed statement that this particular sex hurt Kazusa.
findings.japanese:
優しいセックスが…
優しいセックスだからこそ、
相手を傷つけてしまうことがある。
findings.todokanai: The gentle sex ended up… no, the gentle sex was the reason she was hurt.

findings.highlight: I'm breathless…
findings.evidenceJa: 息を、合わせずに
findings.explanation: He resolves to move without matching or synchronizing their breathing. The translation instead says he lacks breath, losing his deliberate rejection of attentive coordination.
findings.japanese: 息を、合わせずに…
findings.todokanai: I'm breathless…

findings.highlight: her calves are hitting my legs too
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の背を打つふくらはぎも、足首も
findings.explanation: Kazusa's calves and ankles strike Haruki's back as her legs lock around him. The translation moves that contact to his legs.
findings.japanese:
俺の腰を挟み込む太股も、
俺の背を打つふくらはぎも、足首も…
findings.todokanai: Her thighs entwined around my hips do so too, her calves are hitting my legs too, as well as her ankles…

findings.highlight: tries to fill herself with me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺を、飲み込もうとする
findings.explanation: Every point of contact tightens as though Kazusa is trying to swallow Haruki whole. The translation reduces that engulfing, possessive image to filling herself.
findings.japanese:
俺に触れているところの全てが強く力み、
俺を、飲み込もうとする。
findings.todokanai: She puts all her force in every part of her that is in contact with me, and tries to fill herself with me.

findings.highlight: fill herself with the fact that we truly did make love here
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に抱きあったという証を、飲み込もうとする
findings.explanation: She tries to swallow and retain the proof that they truly held each other. The translation makes an abstract fact fill her, weakening the bodily metaphor that continues line 284.
findings.japanese:
本当に抱きあったという証を、
飲み込もうとする。
findings.todokanai: She's trying to fill herself with the fact that we truly did make love here.

findings.highlight: where I never thought I'd ever be again
findings.evidenceJa: 二度と、届かせるはずのなかった、最奥に
findings.explanation: This is the deepest place he was never supposed or permitted to reach again, not merely somewhere he did not expect to revisit. The translation removes the moral prohibition binding the scene to betrayal.
findings.japanese: 二度と、届かせるはずのなかった、最奥に。
findings.todokanai: I come in the deepest end, where I never thought I'd ever be again.

findings.highlight: She's just as impulsive as she was back then. With a firm resolve, she decided to accept me
findings.evidenceJa: あの時の、衝動的なふたりのまま。何もかも覚悟の上、俺を受け入れようって、決心してた
findings.explanation: They remain the same impulsive pair from that night, and Kazusa had resolved to accept him fully prepared for everything. The translation assigns the shared impulsiveness only to her and drops the all-consequences-known scope of her resolve.
findings.japanese:
あの時の、衝動的なふたりのまま。
何もかも覚悟の上、
俺を受け入れようって、決心してた…
findings.todokanai: She's just as impulsive as she was back then. With a firm resolve, she decided to accept me…

findings.highlight: mysterious when it comes to promoting her own daughter
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に得体の知れない母親にしてプロモーターだ
findings.explanation: Youko is unfathomable both as a mother and as a promoter. The translation confines the mystery to how she promotes her daughter, losing Haruki's broader unease about how much she knows and controls.
findings.japanese:
一体、俺たちのことを何処まで掴んでるのか…
本当に得体の知れない母親にしてプロモーターだ。
findings.todokanai: I wonder how much she knows about us… She really is very mysterious when it comes to promoting her own daughter.

findings.highlight: until her last concert
findings.evidenceJa: 追加公演が終わるまで
findings.explanation: The contract lasts until the additional performance ends. Calling it her 'last concert' asserts finality not present in the term and obscures the production's repeated distinction between scheduled and additional performances.
findings.japanese:
「冬馬かずさ独占取材は、
一応、追加公演が終わるまでって契約になってる」
findings.todokanai: "The contract that allows us exclusive coverage on Touma Kazusa will last until her last concert."

findings.highlight: the first time since that night when we have fulfilled our one week rule in Tokyo
findings.evidenceJa: 東京では一月ぶりの“一週間ルール”を果たす日
findings.explanation: This is their first Tokyo observance of the weekly rule in a month, as well as the first since the Osaka night. The translation drops the explicit one-month gap.
findings.japanese:
今日は、あの夜以来の、
東京では一月ぶりの“一週間ルール”を果たす日。
findings.todokanai: Today is the first time since that night when we have fulfilled our one week rule in Tokyo.

findings.highlight: But the apartment next to mine…
findings.evidenceJa: けれど、今の俺の部屋は。その隣は…
findings.explanation: Haruki breaks off over both his room as it now is and the room next door, because Setsuna's return home will expose Kazusa's proximity and traces. The translation deletes the first room and reduces the double threat to the neighbor alone.
findings.japanese:
けれど、今の俺の部屋は。
その隣は…
findings.todokanai: But the apartment next to mine…

findings.highlight: having a strong sense of responsibility
findings.evidenceJa: 生活感たっぷりな、いつもの雪菜だよ
findings.explanation: Haruki teases Setsuna for being thoroughly practical and redolent of everyday domestic life. A 'strong sense of responsibility' turns that concrete, slightly dowdy household quality into an abstract virtue.
findings.japanese:
「ああ、いつも通りだ。
ケチケチしてて、所帯じみてて、生活感たっぷりな、
いつもの雪菜だよ」
findings.todokanai: "Yes, just like always. Stingy, family-oriented, and having a strong sense of responsibility, just like the usual Setsuna."

findings.highlight: after I repair my reputation
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの名誉回復してからにしてよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna demands that Haruki restore her reputation after calling her stingy and old-fashioned before they go shopping. The translation makes Setsuna responsible for repairing her own reputation.
findings.japanese:
「も、もう！
わたしの名誉回復してからにしてよ～！」
findings.todokanai: "J-Jeez! We can do that after I repair my reputation!"

findings.highlight: I love how she's overly familial. I love how she's just so rigid.
findings.evidenceJa: 所帯じみてる雪菜が。生活臭漂う雪菜が
findings.explanation: Haruki loves Setsuna's settled, housewifely air and the palpable scent of everyday life around her. 'Familial' and especially 'rigid' discard the domestic imagery that makes her feel like home.
findings.japanese:
ケチケチしてる雪菜が。
所帯じみてる雪菜が。
生活臭漂う雪菜が。
findings.todokanai: I love how stingy Setsuna is. I love how she's overly familial. I love how she's just so rigid.

findings.highlight: we decided on 4 PM
findings.evidenceJa: 午後４時からでお願いしますとのことでした
findings.explanation: Kimura's email says they request that Monday's meeting begin at 4 p.m. The voicemail does not report a mutual decision; its phrasing is deliberately constructed to hide a code number.
findings.japanese:
「あ、北原です。先ほど吉浜エンジニアリングの
木村さんからメールがありまして、月曜の打ち合わせの件、
午後４時からでお願いしますとのことでした」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, it's me, Kitahara. Some time ago I got an email from Kimura-san at Yoshihama Engineering. On the matter of the appointment on Monday, we decided on 4 PM."

findings.highlight: Before confirming my prediction from three seconds ago.
findings.evidenceJa: 三秒前の予想を簡単に正解にしてしまう。俺を、求めてくれる
findings.explanation: By looking up and closing her eyes, Setsuna easily proves Haruki's three-second-old prediction correct: she wants him. 'Before confirming' leaves the sentence fragment logically inverted and detaches her desire from the confirmation.
findings.japanese:
なんて、三秒前の予想を簡単に正解にしてしまう。
俺を、求めてくれる。
findings.todokanai: …Before confirming my prediction from three seconds ago. Setsuna desires me.

findings.highlight: Normally, I would pull up her shirt
findings.evidenceJa: 多分俺はここでキスを続けたまま、雪菜の服をたくし上げ、軽く愛撫する
findings.explanation: Haruki predicts what he will probably do here and now if the kiss continues. 'Normally' reframes the imagined next step as a general sexual routine rather than the immediate choice he fears making.
findings.japanese:
多分俺はここでキスを続けたまま、
雪菜の服をたくし上げ、軽く愛撫する。
findings.todokanai: Normally, I would pull up her shirt and caress her as I'm still kissing her.

findings.highlight: fall down on the bed with her under me
findings.evidenceJa: 抱きかかえ、ベッドまで運び、仰向けに寝かせる
findings.explanation: He imagines picking Setsuna up, carrying her to the bed, and laying her on her back. The translation replaces those deliberate actions with both of them falling onto the bed.
findings.japanese:
唇を繋げたまま抱きかかえ、
ベッドまで運び、仰向けに寝かせる。
findings.todokanai: I'd embrace her as my lips are still attached to hers, and fall down on the bed with her under me.

findings.highlight: I'd take off her shirt, make her take off mine
findings.evidenceJa: 服を脱いで、脱がせて
findings.explanation: Haruki imagines undressing himself and undressing Setsuna. The translation limits both to shirts, assigns his undressing to Setsuna, and adds coercive 'make her.'
findings.japanese:
服を脱いで、脱がせて、
優しく、激しく交わり…
findings.todokanai: I'd take off her shirt, make her take off mine, then gently yet fervently make love with her…

findings.highlight: we'd take a shower
findings.evidenceJa: 二人一緒に風呂に入る
findings.explanation: They would enter the bath together after enjoying the afterglow. A shower changes the established shared bathing routine and its intimacy.
findings.japanese:
果てた後、しばらく余韻を楽しんだら、
二人一緒に風呂に入る。
findings.todokanai: Once we were done and finished enjoying the afterglow, we'd take a shower.

findings.highlight: The keyword that represents the most despicable thing possible.
findings.evidenceJa: 最低の最低を上塗りするときの、キーワード
findings.explanation: Four is the keyword Haruki uses when adding another layer of vileness atop the very worst—sending Kazusa away so he can sleep with Setsuna. The translation turns it into an abstract label and loses the repeated act of compounding betrayal.
findings.japanese:
そして４は………『一晩部屋を空けてくれ』。
最低の最低を上塗りするときの、キーワード。
findings.todokanai: And 4 is "Leave the apartment tonight." The keyword that represents the most despicable thing possible.

findings.highlight: You're together until Saturday morning
findings.evidenceJa: 土曜は、朝からずっと一緒なんだろ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki and Setsuna spend all of Saturday together starting in the morning. 'Until Saturday morning' ends their time when the source says it begins, materially changing the weekly arrangement.
findings.japanese:
「週末には、必ず会ってるんだろ？
土曜は、朝からずっと一緒なんだろ？
金曜の夜は………泊めるんだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "You always see her on the weekends, right? You're together until Saturday morning, right? And on Friday night… you always let her stay, right?"

findings.highlight: has finally returned to us
findings.evidenceJa: 一月がかりでようやく戻ってきた
findings.explanation: It took an entire month for Haruki and Setsuna to restore last year's weekly pattern. The translation omits that slow month-long recovery.
findings.japanese:
昨年までは、毎週のように繰り返してた生活パターンに、
一月がかりでようやく戻ってきた。
findings.todokanai: The lifestyle we had repeated almost every week last year has finally returned to us.

findings.highlight: I can manage to stay in Setsuna's room overnight all the time
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜を大っぴらに部屋に泊めることもできる
findings.explanation: Because the Ogiisos discuss sex openly, Haruki can openly have Setsuna stay overnight in his own room. The translation reverses host and guest and moves Haruki into Setsuna's family bedroom.
findings.japanese:
…まぁ、逆にこういう一家だからこそ、
雪菜を大っぴらに部屋に泊めることもできるんだけど。
findings.todokanai: …Well, on the other hand, it's precisely because this family is the way it is that I can manage to stay in Setsuna's room overnight all the time.

findings.highlight: Setsuna and I look at each other in confusion
findings.evidenceJa: 何のことかと雪菜に目配せしたけれど、それは完全に空振りに終わってしまった
findings.explanation: Haruki sends Setsuna a glance asking what the family means, but gets no response because she looks down in acute embarrassment. The translation makes both mutually confused, falsely erasing Setsuna's awareness of the ring discussion.
findings.japanese:
何のことかと雪菜に目配せしたけれど、
それは完全に空振りに終わってしまった。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna and I look at each other in confusion in an attempt to see if the other understands what's going on, but the effort is in vain.

findings.highlight: there is no need for us to find out over dinner
findings.evidenceJa: そういう身も蓋もないことを食事中にバラさなくても
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother says Takahiro need not expose such brutally frank behind-the-scenes details during dinner. The family already knows; the translation wrongly says dinner is when they would find out.
findings.japanese:
「…ええと。
だからそういう身も蓋もないことを
食事中にバラさなくても、ねぇ？」
findings.todokanai: "…Ehm, that doesn't mean you should be so blunt about it, and there is no need for us to find out over dinner."

findings.highlight: Amidst this heavy atmosphere
findings.evidenceJa: この、軽くて浮き足立った雰囲気の中でも
findings.explanation: The atmosphere is light and excited, almost giddy with wedding speculation. Calling it heavy reverses the social mood against which Haruki's sunken silence stands out.
findings.japanese:
この、軽くて浮き足立った雰囲気の中でも。
一世一代の決め所かもしれなかった場面でも…
findings.todokanai: Amidst this heavy atmosphere, and in this place where my once in a lifetime choice could be made…

findings.highlight: it was probably the best way to go about it
findings.evidenceJa: 正式に申し込むべき話の流れだった
findings.explanation: The conversation had reached a point where Haruki should formally make the proposal or request for Setsuna's hand. The translation turns that concrete obligation into a vague 'best way' and loses why his silence is a fatal mistake.
findings.japanese:
気が早すぎても、問題ないはずだった。
それどころか、正式に申し込むべき話の流れだった。
findings.todokanai: There shouldn't be anything wrong with being eager. In fact, it was probably the best way to go about it.

findings.highlight: Setsuna's mother started talking about the future of the household, putting her in direct opposition to the children who insisted on talking about that with only the family around.
findings.evidenceJa: もう親戚の予定を気にしだして、『内輪で』を多用する若手組と真っ向から対立し
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother is already checking relatives' schedules, while the younger group repeatedly advocates keeping the ceremony private or within a small circle. The translation replaces both concrete wedding-planning positions with generic household future talk.
findings.japanese:
お母さんは、もう親戚の予定を気にしだして、
『内輪で』を多用する若手組と真っ向から対立し。
findings.todokanai: Setsuna's mother started talking about the future of the household, putting her in direct opposition to the children who insisted on talking about that with only the family around.

findings.highlight: needing to talk to my mother
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の母親に一度会う必要がある
findings.explanation: Setsuna's father says he needs to meet Haruki's mother at least once, a formal family step. The translation reduces this to talking with her and loses the in-person obligation.
findings.japanese:
お父さんはそういう話には参加したがらなかったけれど、
去り際、俺の母親に一度会う必要があると呟いた。
findings.todokanai: Her father didn't seem to want to join the conversation, but when I was about to leave, he muttered to me about needing to talk to my mother.

findings.highlight: I was supposed to be taken aback by this family
findings.evidenceJa: すこし辟易しつつ、少し羨望を抱き
findings.explanation: Haruki expected to feel a little fed up with their entangling family talk while also envying it. 'Taken aback' loses his weary resistance to the very ties he hoped would absorb him.
findings.japanese:
すこし辟易しつつ、少し羨望を抱き、
そして徐々に、自分も染まっていくはずだったのに。
findings.todokanai: I was supposed to be taken aback by this family, feel envious, and then I'd eventually join them.

findings.highlight: I was just on my way to the station right now
findings.evidenceJa: あたしも今、ちょうど駅に着いたところでさ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she herself has just arrived at the station. The translation says she is still traveling toward it, contradicting her physical presence there.
findings.japanese:
「なんてな…ははっ、信じたか？
本当は、金曜からまだ一度も部屋に帰ってないんだ。
あたしも今、ちょうど駅に着いたところでさ」
findings.todokanai: "Just kidding… haha! Did you actually believe that? I actually haven't been in my apartment since Friday. I was just on my way to the station right now."

findings.highlight: I want her to finally stop using "I'm cold" to fool me someday.
findings.evidenceJa: いつか『寒いから』だけでは誤魔化しきれなくなるから
findings.explanation: Haruki fears that someday Kazusa will no longer be able to pass all her trembling and tears off as merely caused by cold. The translation makes this a wish that she stop fooling him, reversing his anxious forecast into a demand.
findings.japanese: いつか『寒いから』だけでは誤魔化しきれなくなるから。
findings.todokanai: I want her to finally stop using "I'm cold" to fool me someday.

findings.highlight: I can manage it at home
findings.evidenceJa: 少しだけ仕事残ってるけど、出なくてもなんとかなる
findings.explanation: Haruki has some work left but can manage without going into the office. The translation invents that he will do it at home, which changes whether Sunday remains wholly Kazusa's.
findings.japanese:
「大丈夫。
少しだけ仕事残ってるけど、
出なくてもなんとかなる」
findings.todokanai: "It's alright, I have a bit of work left to do, but I can manage it at home."

findings.highlight: You ran away from my concert
findings.evidenceJa: 好きだったはずのあたしのピアノから、逃げ出した
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki ran from her piano—the thing he supposedly loved—not specifically from a concert. The instrument and her music are the emotional object of his avoidance; narrowing it to an event weakens that accusation.
findings.japanese:
「でも春希は逃げた。
好きだったはずのあたしのピアノから、逃げ出した…」
findings.todokanai: "But you ran away, Haruki. You ran away from my concert that you supposedly loved so much…"

findings.highlight: her hand, which was already almost squeezing mine. She pulls my shoulder to her body
findings.evidenceJa: 未だに引きつるはずの右手にしっかり力を入れ、俺の肩に身体を寄せ
findings.explanation: Kazusa puts firm strength into the right hand that should still be twinging, then leans her body against Haruki's shoulder. The translation invents prior squeezing and has her pull his shoulder instead of moving herself close.
findings.japanese:
未だに引きつるはずの右手にしっかり力を入れ、
俺の肩に身体を寄せ、体温を伝え合う。
findings.todokanai: She puts even more force into her hand, which was already almost squeezing mine. She pulls my shoulder to her body, and we feel each other's warmth.

findings.highlight: I'll simply pass it off as something beyond my ability
findings.evidenceJa: その結果叩かれても仕方ないってくらい頑張るよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa will give everything and work so hard that, if the result is still criticized, she can accept that it cannot be helped. The translation says she will dismiss dissatisfaction as beyond her ability, replacing resolve with excuse-making.
findings.japanese:
「持てる力を出し切ってさ、
その結果叩かれても仕方ないってくらい頑張るよ」
findings.todokanai: "I'll make use of all the strength I have. I'll work so hard that if someone is still not satisfied despite that, I'll simply pass it off as something beyond my ability."

findings.highlight: make this winter a pleasant one
findings.evidenceJa: この冬だけは、お前もいいことにしてくれ
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks Haruki, just for this winter, to decide that being the worst is acceptable too. She is asking him to permit their wrongness, not to make the season pleasant.
findings.japanese:
「最低でも、あたしはいい。
…だから、頼む。
この冬だけは、お前もいいことにしてくれ」
findings.todokanai: "I don't mind being despicable… so please, make this winter a pleasant one."

findings.highlight: My apartment is only five minutes away
findings.evidenceJa: ここから俺たちの部屋まで、歩いて５分もかからない
findings.explanation: Their rooms—the paired apartments that now constitute their secret domestic space—are under five minutes away. Singular 'my apartment' removes Kazusa's neighboring room from the shared destination.
findings.japanese:
ここから俺たちの部屋まで、
歩いて５分もかからないのに…
findings.todokanai: My apartment is only five minutes away…

findings.highlight: I've looked at you longer than you have looked at yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: お前よりも、お前のこと見てるんだぞ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she watches Haruki more than he watches or understands himself, asserting perceptiveness. The translation changes comparative intensity into elapsed duration.
findings.japanese:
「ずっとお前のこと見つめてるんだぞ？
お前よりも、お前のこと見てるんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "I've always looked at you, you know? I've looked at you longer than you have looked at yourself."

findings.highlight: one obvious lie after the next
findings.evidenceJa: あんなに最低な嘘を重ねたのに
findings.explanation: Haruki has piled up so many despicable lies; 最低 condemns their morality, not their transparency. Calling them obvious undercuts the next question about why his lying skill has not improved.
findings.japanese:
あんなに最低な嘘を重ねたのに。
何度も騙し続けたのに。
findings.todokanai: I told one obvious lie after the next, yet still managed to deceive her.

findings.highlight: until I told you myself in the end, you never found out
findings.evidenceJa: 自分からバラすまでは、最後まで相手に気づかれなかったよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the other person she deceived did not notice until Kazusa herself revealed the truth. 相手 is not Haruki, as his following questions struggle to identify whom she means. The translation answers that mystery prematurely by making him the deceived person.
findings.japanese:
「五年前もさ…
結局、自分からバラすまでは、
最後まで相手に気づかれなかったよ」
findings.todokanai: "Five years ago… until I told you myself in the end, you never found out."

findings.highlight: that you love me more than anyone else
findings.evidenceJa: あたしのこと好きだって、愛してるって、ずっと昔から、変わらぬ気持ちのままだって
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks for lies that he likes her, loves her, and has felt unchanged since long ago. She does not ask him to rank her above everyone else; that added superlative destabilizes the carefully partitioned Setsuna/Kazusa arrangement.
findings.japanese:
「あたしのこと好きだって、愛してるって、
ずっと昔から、変わらぬ気持ちのままだって…」
findings.todokanai: "If you were to tell me that you love me, that you love me more than anyone else, that your feelings for me haven't changed one bit…"

findings.highlight: Because you'll still be able to love Setsuna. Because there'll still be a you who doesn't love me.
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜のことを愛してる春希が現実にいるから。あたしのことを愛してない春希が日常にいるから
findings.explanation: Kazusa grounds her safety in a present reality where Haruki loves Setsuna and an everyday life where Haruki does not love Kazusa. The translation turns the first into future ability and loses the explicit reality-versus-daily-life partition.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜のことを愛してる春希が現実にいるから。
あたしのことを愛してない春希が日常にいるから」
findings.todokanai: "Because you'll still be able to love Setsuna. Because there'll still be a you who doesn't love me."

俺の背中を胸で受け止めて、
頭を抱え込み、何度も頬ずりを繰り返す。
findings.todokanai: She supports my back with her chest, holds her arms around my head, and strokes my cheeks over and over again.

findings.highlight: She hits me with her warm emotions.
findings.evidenceJa: 熱い気持ちを、吹きかける
findings.explanation: Following her warm breath against his neck, Kazusa 'breathes' her hot feelings onto him by saying she loves him. The translation replaces the linked physical-verbal image with an aggressive, abstract hit.
findings.japanese: 熱い気持ちを、吹きかける。
findings.todokanai: She hits me with her warm emotions.

findings.highlight: As we went on living our lives without each other, a wall grew between us that could no longer be crossed with just our feelings alone.
findings.evidenceJa: 距離も立場も進むべき未来も…
findings.explanation: The English assigned to line 374 translates the full thought from line 375, while line 375 receives only line 374's fragment about distance, standing, and future. Continuous meaning survives, but the line mapping and rhetorical order are reversed.
findings.japanese: 距離も立場も進むべき未来も…
findings.todokanai: As we went on living our lives without each other, a wall grew between us that could no longer be crossed with just our feelings alone.

findings.highlight: decided to get close to the two girls you thought of as number one and number two
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の中のナンバー１とナンバー２に、ただ、無節操に甘えてただけなのか
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether Haruki indiscriminately imposed on and depended upon the two top-ranked girls. The translation reduces that ethically charged reliance to simply getting close to them.
findings.japanese:
「自分の中のナンバー１とナンバー２に、
ただ、無節操に甘えてただけなのか…？」
findings.todokanai: "So you just decided to get close to the two girls you thought of as number one and number two…?"

findings.highlight: calculating, vindictive man
findings.evidenceJa: 計算高くて執念深い奴
findings.explanation: Kazusa calls Haruki calculating and obsessively persistent or tenacious in pursuing her. 執念深い does not make him vindictive; revenge is not her accusation.
findings.japanese:
「なんて…なんて計算高くて執念深い奴なんだ。
そんな、そんな…」
findings.todokanai: "…You're such a calculating, vindictive man… to think… to think…"

findings.highlight: All she could do was…
findings.evidenceJa: 冬馬かずさっていう、とんでもない馬鹿なら…
findings.explanation: The Japanese trails on the conditional thought 'if it is that extraordinary idiot Touma Kazusa…' before her speech. The English appends a new unfinished claim, 'All she could do was,' with no source predicate or continuation.
findings.japanese:
俺を五年間ずっと忘れなかった、
冬馬かずさっていう、とんでもない馬鹿なら…
findings.todokanai: Because Touma Kazusa is a preposterous idiot who couldn't forget about me for five whole years. All she could do was…

findings.highlight: the woman you caught is really bad at giving up
findings.evidenceJa: 諦めの悪い女に引っかかっちゃってなぁ
findings.explanation: Kazusa jokes that Haruki has had the bad luck to get caught by or tangled up with a woman who will not give up. The translation makes her the woman he caught, reversing agency in the trap image.
findings.japanese:
「残念だったな、春希…
諦めの悪い女に引っかかっちゃってなぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Too bad, Haruki… the woman you caught is really bad at giving up."

findings.highlight: a peaceful look on her face
findings.evidenceJa: ものすごく満たされた顔で眠ってた
findings.explanation: Kazusa sleeps looking profoundly fulfilled or satisfied after their night of mutual confession. 'Peaceful' keeps calmness but loses the sense that her longing has been filled.
findings.japanese:
かずさは、俺が揺り起こすまで、
ものすごく満たされた顔で眠ってた。
findings.todokanai: Until I shook her awake, Kazusa slept with such a peaceful look on her face.

findings.highlight: Rokuya
findings.evidenceJa: ろくろ屋
findings.explanation: The kana name reads Rokuro-ya or Rokuroya: ろくろ is rokuro and 屋 is ya. 'Rokuya' drops the second ro and changes the shop name.
findings.japanese:
「来月、楽しみにしてるからね～。
わたし今ろくろ屋のバウムクーヘンにハマってんだ。
西急の地下にあるんだけどいっつも１時間待ちで」
findings.todokanai: "That's because I'm looking forward to next month. Right now I'm completely addicted to the baumkuchen they sell at Rokuya. It's in the basement of Seikyu, though there's always an hour-long queue there."

findings.highlight: Kizaki-san has been really stiff ever since his marriage was decided on.
findings.evidenceJa: 木崎さんも結婚決めちゃって食いつき悪くなった
findings.explanation: Since Kizaki decided to marry, he no longer bites at or shows much interest in Matsuoka's chocolate-count competition. 'Stiff' describes demeanor rather than his reduced engagement with the game.
findings.japanese:
「だって浜田さんは娘にもらったチョコ自慢しかしないし、
木崎さんも結婚決めちゃって食いつき悪くなったしさぁ、
勝負できそうなのお前ぐらいしかいないんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "Because Hamada-san doesn't brag about anything except for the chocolate he got from his daughter. Kizaki-san has been really stiff ever since his marriage was decided on. The only person I can compete against is you."

findings.highlight: Had you sucked up to Mari-san as much as he did
findings.evidenceJa: あんただって麻理さんに頭下げてお願いしてたらとことんまで鍛えてくれた
findings.explanation: Suzuki says Mari would have trained Matsuoka thoroughly too if he had bowed his head and asked her. The translation adds that Haruki sucked up to Mari, degrading a relationship the source does not characterize that way.
findings.japanese:
「二年先輩がこの言い草…
あんただって麻理さんに頭下げてお願いしてたら

findings.todokanai: "Is that something a second-year senior should be saying? Had you sucked up to Mari-san as much as he did, she'd have trained you too."

findings.highlight: I'll get back to my work!
findings.evidenceJa: 出先行ってきます！今日はそのまま直帰ですから
findings.explanation: Haruki announces that he is heading out to an external work destination and will go straight home from there. The translation says he is returning to work, making the following direct-return declaration incoherent.
findings.japanese:
「出先行ってきます！
今日はそのまま直帰ですから！」
findings.todokanai: "I'll get back to my work! Once I'm done, I'm going straight home!"

findings.highlight: I feel like I'm going to have a bad time

findings.explanation: Haruki fears they will probe a belly that is not entirely pain-free: unlike the idiom's innocent person, he really does have secrets to uncover. The translation reduces this guilt-laden risk to a generic bad time.

今日の浮かれた日に、この人たちに付き合ってると、
痛くも無くない腹を探られるかもしれないから

findings.todokanai: If I spend any more time with these people on a day as festive as today, I feel like I'm going to have a bad time, so I run away from my post.

findings.highlight: minor pains in her hand
findings.evidenceJa: 手首に少し痛みが出た
findings.explanation: Youko's cover story specifically locates post-concert pain in Kazusa's wrist. The translation broadens it to the hand, changing a concrete medical detail during hostile press questioning.
findings.japanese:
「いいえ、そのようなことはありません。
確かに前回公演後、手首に少し痛みが出たようですが、

findings.todokanai: "No, that's not true. She did indeed have minor pains in her hand after her last concert, but it is fully healed by now."

findings.highlight: Her special number will be released after the next issue of Ensemble.

findings.explanation: Youko promotes an upcoming special or feature issue on Kazusa from Ensemble. The translation calls it a 'special number' and says it will appear after the next issue, adding a release sequence absent from 今度.
findings.japanese:
「あらご存じ？
今度アンサンブルから彼女の特集号が出るんですのよ？
記事の中でも是非取り上げてくださると嬉しいですわ」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, so you're aware? Her special number will be released after the next issue of Ensemble. I'd be thrilled if you could write about it in your article."

findings.highlight: I thought it'd be fine if it was just for a short while.
findings.evidenceJa: 昨日までは短い時間なら問題ないと言ってた
findings.explanation: Miyoko says that through yesterday Kazusa herself had said a short interview would be no problem. The translation makes the approval Miyoko's own judgment, obscuring why she accepted despite Youko's warning.
findings.japanese:
「本当に申し訳ありません。
昨日までは短い時間なら問題ないと言ってたので…」
findings.todokanai: "I'm really sorry. Up until yesterday, I thought it'd be fine if it was just for a short while."

findings.highlight: I sent a text not to "Setsuna," but "Sakamoto Sumiki."
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が選んだ通話先は、『雪菜』じゃなくて『坂本純生』だった
findings.explanation: Haruki chooses whom to call, not whom to text; the voicemail content will carry Kazusa's numeric code. Changing the medium breaks the established answering-service mechanism. The given-name reading 'Sumiki' also remains unverified from source-only kanji.
findings.japanese:
そんな思いに耽りながら俺が選んだ通話先は、
『雪菜』じゃなくて『坂本純生』だった。
findings.todokanai: While indulging myself in these thoughts, I sent a text not to "Setsuna," but "Sakamoto Sumiki."

findings.highlight: At night, we made love tenderly and kissed.
findings.evidenceJa: 夜は優しく抱きあって、キスをしあってた
findings.explanation: At night Haruki and Kazusa tenderly held one another and kissed. 抱きあう here states mutual embracing; translating it as 'made love' asserts nightly sex the source does not specify.
findings.japanese:
昼間は普段の生活を取り戻してた。
夜は優しく抱きあって、キスをしあってた。
findings.todokanai: During the day, she had returned to playing the piano and going about her normal life. At night, we made love tenderly and kissed.

findings.highlight: my head alone pretended to "not be there."
findings.evidenceJa: 頭だけが『ここじゃない』と必死に抵抗してた
findings.explanation: As his limbs make him leave the train, Haruki's mind desperately resists by insisting 'this isn't the place.' The translation says his head pretends not to be there, losing the conflict over getting off one stop early.
findings.japanese:
勝手に降りようとする手足に対して
頭だけが『ここじゃない』と必死に抵抗してた。
findings.todokanai: My feet forced themselves to get off the train, but my head alone pretended to "not be there."

findings.highlight: There's really… nothing I want.
findings.evidenceJa: あたし、別に…なんでもないよ
findings.explanation: Kazusa tries to dismiss her condition and the call as nothing—she is fine, nothing is the matter. The translation says she has no wants, turning denial of distress into a denial of desire.
findings.japanese: 「あたし、別に…なんでもないよ」
findings.todokanai: "There's really… nothing I want."

findings.highlight: Putting myself down
findings.evidenceJa: 自分をねじ伏せるくらい、なんでもない
findings.explanation: Haruki says forcibly suppressing or overpowering himself is nothing if it protects Kazusa's heart. 'Putting myself down' means belittling himself and loses his choice to crush his own competing will.
findings.japanese:
かずさの心を守るためには、
自分をねじ伏せるくらい、なんでもない。
findings.todokanai: Putting myself down for the sake of protecting Kazusa's heart is nothing to me.

findings.highlight: a spoiled child who lacks sense
findings.evidenceJa: 甘えん坊で、悪いか。言ってることメチャクチャで、悪いか
findings.explanation: Kazusa separately defends being needy and saying internally contradictory nonsense before admitting she cannot wait five minutes. The translation folds the first two into one generic child who lacks sense, losing her recognition that her rules and wishes conflict.
findings.japanese:
「甘えん坊で、悪いか。
言ってることメチャクチャで、悪いか。
たった５分ですら我慢できなくて、悪いかぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Is there something wrong with being a spoiled child who lacks sense? Is there something wrong with being unable to wait for even five minutes?"

findings.highlight: Cold, judgemental stares
findings.evidenceJa: 視線は、冷たかったり、生温かかったりした
findings.explanation: Passers-by look at them sometimes coldly and sometimes with lukewarm, indulgent amusement. The translation retains only hostile judgment and loses the mixed social reaction to the conspicuous couple.
findings.japanese:
こんな人通りの多い場所であたり構わず抱きあう
周囲の見えていないカップルに注ぐ視線は、
冷たかったり、生温かかったりしたけれど。

そんな視線が気にはなったけど、
それでも二人とも、相手の背中に回した手を
決して緩めるつもりなんかなかった。
findings.todokanai: I am a bit bothered by the attention, but not enough for my arms around her to loosen.

かずさを抱きしめて、そしてキスして…
findings.todokanai: I've forgotten my promise with Setsuna, and I'm embracing and kissing Kazusa…

周りの音も聞こえないかのように、
二人、唇も身体も、激しく絡み合う。

コート越しに身体を密着させる。

findings.todokanai: Right now, we don't want to make love in a room hidden from the world.

findings.explanation: They want to inscribe in the world, just once, the two of them embracing against everything without blessing or permission. The English escalates the visible image to intercourse before that act begins.
findings.japanese:
誰からも祝福されず、誰にも許されず、
全てに背いて抱きあう俺たちを、
一度だけでもいいから、世界に刻んでおきたかった。

findings.explanation: Their intimacy is bold, reckless, and strong and deep. 'Careless' weakens deliberate recklessness, while 'rough' turns emotional and physical depth into a style of sex.

そんな大胆で、無謀で…
そして強く深い、俺たちの睦みあい。
findings.todokanai: Our bold, careless… and rough love-making.

findings.highlight: not even Youko-sanーwould ever forgive
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちのことを認めてくれていたかもしれない曜子さんすらも裏切る
findings.explanation: Youko may have been the sole person in the world willing to recognize or approve their love, yet this public sex and scandal risk betray even her. The translation says she would never forgive them, reversing her exceptional possible support.
findings.japanese:
世界でたった一人、
俺たちのことを認めてくれていたかもしれない
曜子さんすらも裏切る、罪深すぎる行為。
findings.todokanai: Our sinful action that not a single person in the worldーnot even Youko-sanーwould ever forgive.

findings.highlight: Kazusa, bent against a tree in the thicket, presses her entire weight against it as if trying to crush it.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさを押し潰すように全体重をかけて重なる
findings.explanation: Haruki puts his full weight against Kazusa, who is leaning on a tree, as if crushing her. The translation makes Kazusa press her own weight into the tree and removes his violent bodily pressure.
findings.japanese:
繁みの中の木にもたれかかるかずさを
押し潰すように全体重をかけて重なる。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa, bent against a tree in the thicket, presses her entire weight against it as if trying to crush it.

findings.evidenceJa: 爪先立ちの足ががくがく震えるくらい負荷をかける
findings.explanation: Haruki imposes enough load on Kazusa that her tiptoeing legs shake violently. The translation reports the posture and shaking but omits that his applied force causes it.

太股を合わせ、ふくらはぎを絡め、
爪先立ちの足ががくがく震えるくらい負荷をかける。
findings.todokanai: Our thighs touch, our calves entwine, her feet start to shake as she's standing on tiptoes.

findings.evidenceJa: 奥へと届けとばかりに腰を突き出すと
findings.explanation: After Haruki seizes initiative and her hips, he thrusts his own hips as though to reach her depths. The translation returns initiative to Kazusa and makes her drive backward onto him.
findings.japanese:
奥へと届けとばかりに腰を突き出すと、
かずさの狭いけれど優しい、
柔らかいけれどきつい肉が俺を締めつける。
findings.todokanai: She thrusts her butt against me so that I can enter her depths. Kazusa's tight yet kind, and soft yet intense flesh surrounds me.

findings.highlight: My entire penis stiffens
findings.evidenceJa: 全身を硬直させて、かずさのなかに叩き込む
findings.explanation: Haruki stiffens his entire body as blood surges to head and lower body, then pounds himself into Kazusa. The translation reattaches 全身 to his penis and loses the full-body convulsion.

頭と、下半身に血がたぎり、
全身を硬直させて、かずさのなかに叩き込む。
findings.todokanai: Blood rushes to my head and lower body. My entire penis stiffens and I thrust it deep into Kazusa.

findings.evidenceJa: かずさの嗜虐的な支配欲が俺を飲み込み
findings.explanation: The phrase invokes sadistic domination—an urge centered on dominating or hurting Kazusa—that swallows Haruki. The translation explicitly labels it Kazusa's masochistic wish to be dominated, reversing both the technical term 嗜虐的 and the desire's agency.
findings.japanese:
かずさの嗜虐的な支配欲が俺を飲み込み、
俺の中の痛みまでも全て快感に変えていく。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa's masochistic desire to be dominated by me sucks me in, and she turns even the pain inside of me into pleasure.

findings.highlight: she ignores all of them
findings.evidenceJa: その価値をちっとも理解しようとせず
findings.explanation: Though loved by the world and God, Kazusa refuses to understand the value of that love and prioritizes love from speck-like Haruki. The translation treats the world and God as people she ignores and loses her failure to value herself.
findings.japanese:
世界に、神様に愛されてるくせに、
その価値をちっとも理解しようとせず、
こんな芥子粒みたいな俺に愛されることを優先する。
findings.todokanai: She is loved by the worldーby god. Yet despite that, she ignores all of them and prioritizes being loved by me instead.

findings.highlight: Kazusa's reluctant assertiveness
findings.evidenceJa: かずさの控えめな積極性
findings.explanation: Kazusa's initiative is restrained, modest, or reserved, not reluctant. The translation implies unwillingness during actions she actively offers.
findings.japanese:
そんないつも通りの、かずさの控えめな積極性に、
俺は余計に情欲を燃え上がらせる。
findings.todokanai: I find myself only more aroused by Kazusa's reluctant assertiveness.

findings.evidenceJa: 離れて思いが募り、再会して熾火が燃え上がり
findings.explanation: Separation makes their longing accumulate, and reunion makes banked embers blaze up again. The translation omits separation as the cause and replaces the persistent ember with a newly lit fuse.
findings.japanese:
最初から好きで、どんどん好きになっていって、
離れて思いが募り、再会して熾火が燃え上がり。
findings.todokanai: I loved her from the start, and those feelings only got more and more powerful. The fuse was lit when we had our reunion.

findings.highlight: I loved the way she glared at me, was fed up with me, and smiled bitterly at me.
findings.evidenceJa: 睨まれてときめき、呆れられて舞い上がり、苦笑されて鼓動が止まらなくなり、見つめられて狂おしさに身悶えて
findings.explanation: Each look produces a distinct escalating reaction: glare makes him thrill, exasperation sends him soaring, a wry smile races his heart, and her gaze makes him writhe with madness. The translation turns them into traits he simply liked and drops most reactions.
findings.japanese:
睨まれてときめき、呆れられて舞い上がり、
苦笑されて鼓動が止まらなくなり、
見つめられて狂おしさに身悶えて。
findings.todokanai: I loved the way she glared at me, was fed up with me, and smiled bitterly at me. The way she made me go mad with her gaze.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分たちの作り上げた超えられないはずの幻想を、現実の相手にあっさり凌駕されてしまった
findings.explanation: They believed their polished fantasies should be impossible to surpass, yet each real person effortlessly exceeded the fantasy. The translation instead says Haruki expected reunion to tear the fantasies apart, inventing anticipated disillusionment.
findings.japanese:
なのに再会を果たした俺たちは、
自分たちの作り上げた超えられないはずの幻想を、
現実の相手にあっさり凌駕されてしまった。
findings.todokanai: I thought those fantasies would be torn apart once we actually met, yet the real person surpassed the fantasy in nearly every way.

findings.highlight: It far surpassed all the societal rules
findings.evidenceJa: 社会のルールも、築き上げた自分の世界も何もかも飛び越えて、夢を、現実にしてしまった
findings.explanation: Haruki and Kazusa leap over every social rule and self-built world to make the dream real. The English gives the action to an impersonal 'it' and omits the culminating transformation of dream into reality.
findings.japanese:
五年間で身につけた社会のルールも、
築き上げた自分の世界も何もかも飛び越えて、
夢を、現実にしてしまった…
findings.todokanai: It far surpassed all the societal rules I had grown accustomed to, and the world I had slowly built up during the past five years…

findings.highlight: The father whom Kazusa doesn't even know the name of.
findings.evidenceJa: 他人とは少し違う生い立ちのこと。父親の名前すら知らない自分のこと
findings.explanation: Haruki considers three connected facts: her conflicted mother, her upbringing unlike other people's, and Kazusa herself not knowing even her father's name. The translation omits the unusual upbringing entirely and reduces the latter two to the father.
findings.japanese:
尊敬し、一時期嫌悪した母のこと。
他人とは少し違う生い立ちのこと。
父親の名前すら知らない自分のこと。
findings.todokanai: I recall her mother, whom Kazusa respects, and at one point used to hate. The father whom Kazusa doesn't even know the name of.

findings.highlight: fills the deepest part of her
findings.evidenceJa: かずさの一番精密な場所を、どろどろに満たしていく
findings.explanation: The semen fills Kazusa's most delicate, intricately made reproductive place, continuing the pregnancy-risk realization. 'Deepest' substitutes spatial depth for biological delicacy.
findings.japanese:
俺の精子は、まっすぐにかずさの子宮を目指し、
かずさの一番精密な場所を、どろどろに満たしていく。
findings.todokanai: My semen heads straight for Kazusa's womb, and fills the deepest part of her.

findings.highlight: It wasn't negligence
findings.evidenceJa: 投げやりでも、快楽に溺れただけでもなく、それが俺の決断だから
findings.explanation: Haruki says this is neither a despairing, reckless abandonment of consequences nor merely drowning in pleasure; it is his decision. 'Negligence' makes the rejected motive accidental carelessness and weakens the deliberate reproductive choice.
findings.japanese:
投げやりでも、快楽に溺れただけでもなく、
それが俺の決断だから。
findings.todokanai: It wasn't negligence, nor did I lose control in a moment of intense pleasure. It was a firm determination to release it all into her.

findings.highlight: I can feel how I'm being squeezed dry.
findings.evidenceJa: たくさん、飲み込んでるのがわかる
findings.explanation: Haruki can feel Kazusa contract around him and swallow or receive a large amount inside. 'Squeezed dry' shifts attention to his depletion and omits her active reception, which grounds the next pregnancy implication.
findings.japanese:
かずさが、俺のを包んで縮んでるのが…
たくさん、飲み込んでるのがわかるから。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa contracts with my penis still inside her… so I can feel how I'm being squeezed dry.

findings.highlight: she simply sticks her tongue out at me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺に向けて微笑み、唇を突き出した
findings.explanation: Kazusa smiles at Haruki and puckers or protrudes her lips to request another kiss. The translation makes her stick out her tongue, changing an affectionate invitation into a teasing gesture.
findings.japanese:
でもこいつは、
そんなこと頭のどこにも残ってないみたいに、
俺に向けて微笑み、唇を突き出した。
findings.todokanai: But she simply sticks her tongue out at me, as if that notion doesn't even exist within her anymore.

findings.highlight: Whenever I tell her I love her, whenever I embrace her, whenever I betray her…
findings.evidenceJa:
雪菜へと愛を語ろうとすると。
雪菜を抱きしめようとすると。
雪菜を裏切ろうとすると…
findings.explanation: Haruki's body reacts when he tries to speak love, embrace, or betray Setsuna; the English turns attempts into habitual completed acts — The bodily breakdown around each possibility remains clear.
findings.japanese:
雪菜へと愛を語ろうとすると。
雪菜を抱きしめようとすると。
雪菜を裏切ろうとすると…
findings.todokanai: Whenever I tell her I love her, whenever I embrace her, whenever I betray her…

findings.highlight: when I chased her out of her apartment just so I could have Setsuna stay over
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜を部屋に泊めるためにかずさを部屋から追い出しておいて、『かずさの求める俺』もないもんだ…
findings.explanation: Haruki expelled Kazusa from his own apartment so Setsuna could stay there. The English says he drove Kazusa out of her apartment, reversing the location and obscuring the degrading command whose violation has just been revealed.
findings.japanese:
雪菜を部屋に泊めるために
かずさを部屋から追い出しておいて、
『かずさの求める俺』もないもんだ…
findings.todokanai: Though I suppose I can't call myself the me that Kazusa desires when I chased her out of her apartment just so I could have Setsuna stay over.

findings.highlight: Every time she calls out to me in that enticingly seductive way
findings.evidenceJa: わざといやらしい言葉を連発して挑発するたびに。
findings.explanation: Kazusa deliberately fires off one obscene phrase after another to provoke Haruki. The English replaces her explicit dirty talk and conscious provocation with a generally seductive manner of calling to him, flattening the strategy by which she tries to assume all blame for the sex.
findings.japanese: わざといやらしい言葉を連発して挑発するたびに。
findings.todokanai: Every time she calls out to me in that enticingly seductive way…

findings.highlight: As long as you pick me every now and then, I'll think of myself as lucky for that day.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ただ、たまたまあたしを選んでくれたら、今日はラッキーだったなって思うだけだ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says that if Haruki happens, by chance, to choose her, she will simply count that day as lucky. 'Every now and then' turns her self-effacing acceptance of accident into a request for periodic access or rotation.
findings.japanese:
「ただ、たまたまあたしを選んでくれたら、
今日はラッキーだったなって思うだけだ」
findings.todokanai: "As long as you pick me every now and then, I'll think of myself as lucky for that day."

findings.highlight: they were still too much to include in an article
findings.evidenceJa: 毒にも薬にもならないかずさの述懐は、けれど、インタビュー記事としては十分すぎる内容だった。
findings.explanation: Kazusa's neutral recollections are more than sufficient material for an interview article. The English says they are too much to include, reversing Haruki's professional assessment and the reason he later returns for his recorder.
findings.japanese:
毒にも薬にもならないかずさの述懐は、
けれど、インタビュー記事としては十分すぎる内容だった。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa's recollections were neither poison nor antidote, yet they were still too much to include in an article.

findings.highlight: Touma Youko's tutor
findings.evidenceJa: マーティン・フリューゲル。冬馬曜子、かずさ母子の師匠にして、現代クラシック音楽界の系譜に必ず出てくる演奏家の一人。
findings.explanation: Martin Fluegel is the master of both Youko and Kazusa, the Touma mother and daughter. The English identifies him only as Youko's tutor, omitting his direct mentorship of Kazusa—the relationship driving his warning and the entire recollection.
findings.japanese:
マーティン・フリューゲル。
冬馬曜子、かずさ母子の師匠にして、
現代クラシック音楽界の系譜に必ず出てくる演奏家の一人。
findings.todokanai: Martin Fluegel. Touma Youko's tutor, and a name that always comes up during the topic of modern classical music.

findings.highlight: I find myself calming down at the prospect
findings.evidenceJa: …そんな歴史的偉人も、口の悪い愛弟子たちにかかれば、『ただの口うるさい爺さん』という庶民的な表現に落ち着いてしまう。
findings.explanation: The narration jokes that even a historic giant becomes merely 'a nagging old man' once his foul-mouthed favorite pupils are through describing him. The English invents Haruki calming down, misassigning the predicate and losing the high-to-low-register joke.
findings.japanese:
…そんな歴史的偉人も、口の悪い愛弟子たちにかかれば、
『ただの口うるさい爺さん』という庶民的な表現に
落ち着いてしまう。
findings.todokanai: …I find myself calming down at the prospect that even a grand and historical man such as him is "nothing but an annoying old man" to his foul-mouthed favorite students.

findings.highlight: Do you think I'm being too clingy?
findings.evidenceJa: 「刷り込みだって思うか？『いつか必ず俺よりもっといい男が現れる』って、そんなくだらない台詞、言うか？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether Haruki dismisses her lifelong fixation as imprinting—the first available man becoming permanently encoded. 'Too clingy' removes the psychological concept and breaks her following defense that her world was broad but only Haruki truly chose her.
findings.japanese:
「刷り込みだって思うか？
『いつか必ず俺よりもっといい男が現れる』って、
そんなくだらない台詞、言うか？」
findings.todokanai: "Do you think I'm being too clingy? Are you going to tell me something worthless like, 'You'll find a better guy than me one day?'…?"

findings.highlight: I'm just one of many guys who happened to be near you five years ago
findings.evidenceJa: 「俺はただ、五年前にかずさの目の前にいた、唯一の男ってだけで…それ以外のことなんか、なにも」
findings.explanation: Haruki calls himself merely the one and only man who stood before Kazusa five years ago. The English says he was one of many, directly reversing the premise Kazusa spends the entire exchange defending.
findings.japanese:
「俺はただ、五年前にかずさの目の前にいた、
唯一の男ってだけで…
それ以外のことなんか、なにも」
findings.todokanai: "I'm just one of many guys who happened to be near you five years ago… nothing more than that."

findings.highlight: It was because she was special that she tried to avert her gaze from it.
findings.evidenceJa: 特別であるが故に、その特別から敢えて目を逸らしてた。
findings.explanation: The surrounding students deliberately looked away from Kazusa's specialness because it intimidated, inspired envy, or provoked hatred. The English makes Kazusa herself avert her gaze, severing the explanation for why hundreds surrounded her but only Haruki faced and chose her.
findings.japanese:
特別であるが故に、
その特別から敢えて目を逸らしてた。
findings.todokanai: It was because she was special that she tried to avert her gaze from it.

findings.highlight: picked you out of all the hundreds of guys she could have picked
findings.evidenceJa: 「雪菜はさ…自分を選んだ数百人の男の中からお前を選んだ」
findings.explanation: Setsuna chose Haruki from among hundreds of men who had chosen her. The English says merely that she could have picked hundreds, losing the reciprocal structure: Setsuna was widely chosen, whereas Kazusa says only one man ever chose her.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜はさ…
自分を選んだ数百人の男の中からお前を選んだ」
findings.todokanai: "Setsuna… picked you out of all the hundreds of guys she could have picked."

findings.highlight: I… had no one else to pick but you from the very start.
findings.evidenceJa: 「けどあたしはさ…最初からお前一人にしか選ばれなかったんだよ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says that from the beginning Haruki was the only person who chose her. The English says Haruki was the only person available for Kazusa to choose, reversing agent and patient and destroying the contrast with Setsuna in line 254.
findings.japanese:
「けどあたしはさ…
最初からお前一人にしか選ばれなかったんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "But I… had no one else to pick but you from the very start."

findings.highlight: We don't have to go all the way. We can just remain like this… I'll be as happy as I can until it's over.
findings.evidenceJa: 「実を結ばなくてもいい。花を咲かせるだけでいい。…散るまでの時間を、精一杯幸せに過ごすから」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says their love need not bear fruit; merely flowering is enough, and she will spend the time until the petals fall as happily as she can. The English deletes the sustained botanical image, which line 292 then extends from flower to a new sprout and possible child.
findings.japanese:
「実を結ばなくてもいい。花を咲かせるだけでいい。
…散るまでの時間を、精一杯幸せに過ごすから」
findings.todokanai: "We don't have to go all the way. We can just remain like this… I'll be as happy as I can until it's over."

findings.highlight: didn't feel all that warm
findings.evidenceJa: 毒にも薬にもならないはずのかずさの言葉は、やっぱり俺にとって、そんな生温いものであるはずもなく。
findings.explanation: Kazusa's supposedly neutral words could never be anything so lukewarm, mild, or harmless to Haruki. The English literally denies warmth, suggesting coldness instead of overwhelming emotional potency and breaking the poison-or-medicine frame.
findings.japanese:
毒にも薬にもならないはずのかずさの言葉は、
やっぱり俺にとって、そんな生温いものであるはずもなく。
findings.todokanai: In the end, the words Kazusa spoke, which were supposed to be neither poison nor antidote, didn't feel all that warm.

findings.highlight: I lose my strength, and invite Kazusa with me to oblivion.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさのなかに包まれたままの俺は、少しずつ力を失い、俺たちを終焉へと誘う。
findings.explanation: Still enveloped inside Kazusa, Haruki gradually loses his erection and brings their prolonged intercourse to its end. The English says he and Kazusa are being invited to oblivion, replacing a concrete sexual transition with unsupported melodrama.
findings.japanese:
かずさのなかに包まれたままの俺は、
少しずつ力を失い、俺たちを終焉へと誘う。
findings.todokanai: So as I lie down while being held by Kazusa, I lose my strength, and invite Kazusa with me to oblivion.

findings.highlight: If you could send me not a flower, but a new sprout
findings.evidenceJa: 「花だけでなく、新しい芽を吹かせてくれたら…そしたらあたし、もっともっと、幸せに…」
findings.explanation: Extending her earlier metaphor, Kazusa says that if Haruki let not only a flower bloom but also a new bud sprout, she would be happier still—an oblique wish for pregnancy. The English changes 'not only the flower, but also' into 'not a flower, but,' making the new life replace rather than grow from their flowering love.
findings.japanese:
「花だけでなく、新しい芽を吹かせてくれたら…
そしたらあたし、もっともっと、幸せに…」
findings.todokanai: "If you could send me not a flower, but a new sprout… then I'd be even happier."

findings.highlight: It's not that big of a deal for a journalist to be late.
findings.evidenceJa: 「なぁ、そんなに慌てなくても。出版業界なんて朝は遅刻しても平気なんじゃないのか？どうせ働き出すのは夜中だろ」
findings.explanation: Kazusa stereotypes the publishing industry as tolerant of late mornings because its work runs into the night. The English calls Haruki a journalist, changing his profession and the workplace culture being mocked.
findings.japanese:
「なぁ、そんなに慌てなくても。
出版業界なんて朝は遅刻しても平気なんじゃないのか？
どうせ働き出すのは夜中だろ」
findings.todokanai: "Hey, you don't have to be in such a rush. It's not that big of a deal for a journalist to be late. Most of your work is done at night, anyway."

findings.highlight: done along with professionals
findings.evidenceJa: 今回の特集号は、編プロと共同とは言え、俺が直接編集に携わるという意味で、記念すべき初仕事。
findings.explanation: The special issue is a joint project with an editorial-production company, 編プロ, not simply work done 'with professionals.' The English erases the subcontracting structure that makes this Haruki's first commemorative job with direct editorial responsibility.
findings.japanese:
今回の特集号は、編プロと共同とは言え、
俺が直接編集に携わるという意味で、記念すべき初仕事。
findings.todokanai: This current job might be one done along with professionals, but it's also my first job as a direct participant, which ought to be commemorated.

findings.highlight: Everything is going at a rapid pace already from the beginning of the week. There's no point in even thinking about taking sick leave.
findings.evidenceJa:
週の初めからものすごいペースだな。
リハビリなんて言ってる場合じゃない。
findings.explanation: Haruki says there is no time to ease back into work or rehabilitate; 'taking sick leave' is a different employment action — The punishing pace and abandoned recovery remain clear.
findings.japanese:
週の初めからものすごいペースだな。
リハビリなんて言ってる場合じゃない。
findings.todokanai: Everything is going at a rapid pace already from the beginning of the week. There's no point in even thinking about taking sick leave.

findings.highlight: it'll look like I'm trying to make up for my lack of natural skill
findings.evidenceJa: 「そう書かれると、母さんに比べてあたしが随分と小者に見えるな」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the comparison makes her look like a decidedly smaller figure or small fry beside Youko. The English invents compensating for deficient talent, while subsequent lines translate the repeated 小者 exchange as 'upstart' and 'inferior,' destroying the affectionate joke that industrious Kazusa and protective Haruki are both petty little mortals beside the effortless genius.
findings.japanese:
「そう書かれると、
母さんに比べてあたしが随分と小者に見えるな」
findings.todokanai: "If you write that, it'll look like I'm trying to make up for my lack of natural skill."

findings.highlight: I might decide on this hair…
findings.evidenceJa: 天才ピアニスト冬馬曜子の最高傑作は何かと聞かれたら、俺なら、この髪とその持ち主だと断言するくらい…
findings.explanation: Asked for Youko's greatest masterpiece, Haruki would unhesitatingly name both this hair and its owner—Kazusa herself. The English names only the hair, dropping the central declaration that Kazusa is Youko's supreme creation.
findings.japanese:
天才ピアニスト冬馬曜子の最高傑作は何かと聞かれたら、
俺なら、この髪とその持ち主だと断言するくらい…
findings.todokanai: If someone were to ask me what Touma Youko's greatest masterpiece was, I might decide on this hair…

findings.highlight: But Kazusa was very slightly hurt by my question that conveyed that I had an unimaginable attachment to her.
findings.evidenceJa:
けれどかずさは、
俺の、かつてないくらいかずさ寄りの問いかけにも、
ほんの少し傷ついた。
findings.explanation: Haruki's question is unprecedentedly aligned with Kazusa's side; 'unimaginable attachment' changes stance into emotional intensity — His willingness to let her skip practice for him remains.
findings.japanese:
けれどかずさは、
俺の、かつてないくらいかずさ寄りの問いかけにも、
ほんの少し傷ついた。
findings.todokanai: But Kazusa was very slightly hurt by my question that conveyed that I had an unimaginable attachment to her.

findings.highlight: And I accept that slight bit of unreasonableness in Kazusa.
findings.evidenceJa: そして俺は、かずさのそんな小さな理不尽に、胸を掻きむしられる。
findings.explanation: Kazusa's small, unreasonable hurt claws or tears at Haruki's heart. The English says he accepts her unreasonableness, replacing an involuntary wound with calm accommodation just before his embrace becomes crushingly desperate.
findings.japanese:
そして俺は、かずさのそんな小さな理不尽に、
胸を掻きむしられる。
findings.todokanai: And I accept that slight bit of unreasonableness in Kazusa.

findings.highlight: "You don't have to be in such a rush. Until March, there are countless places in Japan with lots of snow."
findings.evidenceJa:
「別に慌てなくても大丈夫。
三月いっぱいまでなら、雪が積もってるところなんか、
日本にはいくらでもある」
findings.explanation: Snow remains through the end of March, not merely until March begins — Kazusa still hears the intended extension beyond their two-week limit.
findings.japanese:
「別に慌てなくても大丈夫。
三月いっぱいまでなら、雪が積もってるところなんか、
日本にはいくらでもある」
findings.todokanai: "You don't have to be in such a rush. Until March, there are countless places in Japan with lots of snow."

findings.highlight: no matter how big the difference in our body temperatures becomes
findings.evidenceJa: けれど俺は、徐々に広がる温度差を感じていながらも、そこで言葉を切る器用さを持ち合わせていなかった。
findings.explanation: Haruki senses the figurative temperature gap widening between his feverish fantasy of future seasons together and Kazusa's cooling, lonely response. The English makes it a difference in their literal body temperatures, breaking the scene's emotional thermometer.
findings.japanese:
けれど俺は、徐々に広がる温度差を感じていながらも、
そこで言葉を切る器用さを持ち合わせていなかった。
findings.todokanai: But no matter how big the difference in our body temperatures becomes, I can't stop myself from speaking.

findings.highlight: the joy I had expected from her at that moment
findings.evidenceJa: けれど、その時得られるはずの喜びは、自分だけが感じられる、自分だけの心の動き。
findings.explanation: The joy Haruki imagines obtaining if Kazusa stays is an emotion only he would feel—his private self-satisfaction. The English says he expected joy from Kazusa, changing whose response was anticipated and blurring why she compares his demand with asking him to abandon Japan.
findings.japanese:
けれど、その時得られるはずの喜びは、
自分だけが感じられる、自分だけの心の動き。
findings.todokanai: However, the joy I had expected from her at that moment was something that only I felt, something that only I felt moved by.

findings.highlight: even Kazusa, who has never beaten me in an argument before
findings.evidenceJa: そんな拙い理屈だから、今まで言い合いで負けたことのないかずさにも、こんなにあっさりと論破されてしまう。
findings.explanation: Kazusa has never lost an argument; even she can effortlessly refute reasoning this poor. The English says she has never beaten Haruki, reversing her established argumentative dominance and contradicting the fact that she has just shattered his case.
findings.japanese:
そんな拙い理屈だから、
今まで言い合いで負けたことのないかずさにも、
こんなにあっさりと論破されてしまう。
findings.todokanai: My reasoning is so awkward that even Kazusa, who has never beaten me in an argument before, can completely shatter it.

findings.highlight: causing both to break down without a sound
findings.evidenceJa: あり得ない前提に、あり得ない前提をぶつけられ、ぐうの音も出ないほどに、叩き潰されて…
findings.explanation: Kazusa counters Haruki's impossible premise with another impossible premise, crushing Haruki so completely that he cannot make a sound. The English says the two suggestions themselves both collapse, erasing Kazusa's victory and the pressure that nearly forces Haruki to consider leaving Japan.
findings.japanese:
あり得ない前提に、
あり得ない前提をぶつけられ、
ぐうの音も出ないほどに、叩き潰されて…
findings.todokanai: An impossible suggestion collides with the impossible suggestion made before it, causing both to break down without a sound…

findings.highlight: I scrapped all of the articles that were written about it back then.
findings.evidenceJa: 「…存じてます。その時の記事、スクラップしてありますから。休暇を反対されたときに突きつけようと思って」
findings.explanation: Miyo has clipped and saved the old articles in a scrapbook so she can confront Youko with them if denied leave. In ordinary English, 'scrapped all of the articles' means discarded or destroyed them, contradicting the very blackmail joke in the next sentence.
findings.japanese:
「…存じてます。
その時の記事、スクラップしてありますから。
休暇を反対されたときに突きつけようと思って」
findings.todokanai: "…I'm aware of it. I scrapped all of the articles that were written about it back then. I intended to blackmail you with them in case you refused me my holiday."

findings.highlight: …I wonder what she finds so amusing about this. This is obviously going to be a crappy performance with absolutely no potential for improvement.
findings.evidenceJa:
…何がそんなに楽しいのやら。
想像通りの、全然成長の後が見られない
下手くそな演奏に決まってるのに。
findings.explanation: Haruki expects no sign of growth since his old playing; 'no potential for improvement' changes retrospective stagnation into future incapacity — He still anticipates an unchanged bad performance.
findings.japanese:
…何がそんなに楽しいのやら。
想像通りの、全然成長の後が見られない
下手くそな演奏に決まってるのに。
findings.todokanai: …I wonder what she finds so amusing about this. This is obviously going to be a crappy performance with absolutely no potential for improvement.

findings.highlight: With the way I am now, I've denied every single one of them.
findings.evidenceJa: その一つ一つのどれもが、今の俺の全てを否定する。
findings.explanation: Every remembered word from Haruki's confession and Setsuna's answer denies or condemns everything he is now. The English makes present Haruki the agent who has denied the memories, reversing the moral judgment that makes his hand freeze on Kazusa's song.
findings.japanese:
その一つ一つのどれもが、
今の俺の全てを否定する。

findings.highlight: which only makes me more aroused, causing the tightness to be more painful.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも、悪態を付きながらも俺を想ってくれるかずさに、俺はますます反応し、余計に苦しめてしまう。
findings.explanation: Kazusa caring about Haruki even while cursing makes him harder and therefore causes him to hurt Kazusa still more. The English leaves the pain attached to abstract 'tightness,' readily reading as greater pain for Haruki, and omits Kazusa as the person his increased erection makes suffer.
findings.japanese:
それでも、悪態を付きながらも俺を想ってくれるかずさに、
俺はますます反応し、余計に苦しめてしまう。
findings.todokanai: Kazusa still thinks about me despite her abusive attitude, which only makes me more aroused, causing the tightness to be more painful.

findings.highlight: I put it inside somewhere… different from usual…
findings.evidenceJa: 「はぁ、あ、あぁぁ…あんっ、んっ、んぅぅ…うあぁぁ…いつもと違うとこ、入ってきて…ぅぇぇ…」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says it is coming into a place different from usual—her anus rather than her vagina. The English makes Kazusa the agent who put it somewhere, reversing the action in her immediate bodily report after Haruki ejaculates inside her.
findings.japanese:
「はぁ、あ、あぁぁ…あんっ、んっ、んぅぅ…
うあぁぁ…いつもと違うとこ、入ってきて…ぅぇぇ…」
findings.todokanai: "Aah, ah, aaah. Ahn, mh, mhh… Uaaah… I put it inside somewhere… different from usual… aaah…"

findings.highlight: Kazusa's waves of liquid show no signs of stopping either.
findings.evidenceJa: なのに、俺の射精はいつまで経っても止まらずに、かずさの波も、おさまる気配を見せていない。
findings.explanation: Haruki's ejaculation continues while Kazusa's waves of climax or contraction likewise show no sign of subsiding. The English turns her orgasmic waves into liquid, introducing an unmentioned emission and breaking the line's parallel between his ejaculation and her continuing bodily spasms.
findings.japanese:
なのに、俺の射精はいつまで経っても止まらずに、
かずさの波も、おさまる気配を見せていない。
findings.todokanai: Despite that, my ejaculations never cease, and Kazusa's waves of liquid show no signs of stopping either.

findings.highlight: There is no dress, no ring, no contract, nor any seal. There is nothing physical that proves our oath.
findings.evidenceJa:
ドレスだって、指輪だって、
届け出の書類も、印鑑も、
俺たちの誓いを証明するものは、今は何もないけれど。
findings.explanation: 届け出の書類 are official registration papers, especially a marriage notification, not a generic contract — The absence of legal documentary proof for their marriage remains.
findings.japanese:
ドレスだって、指輪だって、
届け出の書類も、印鑑も、
俺たちの誓いを証明するものは、今は何もないけれど。
findings.todokanai: There is no dress, no ring, no contract, nor any seal. There is nothing physical that proves our oath.

findings.highlight: to think you'd add the whole arrangement of compositions on top of that…
findings.evidenceJa: 「だいたい、二人ともなに考えてるんですか？ただでさえ準備期間も全然ないって言うのに、その上プログラムを全曲変更してしまうなんて…」
findings.explanation: Miyo is appalled that Kazusa and Youko changed every piece in the concert program despite having virtually no preparation time. The English says they added an extra full arrangement of compositions, inventing additional repertoire rather than a complete last-minute replacement; line 39 repeats the same misunderstanding.
findings.japanese:
「だいたい、二人ともなに考えてるんですか？
ただでさえ準備期間も全然ないって言うのに、
その上プログラムを全曲変更してしまうなんて…」
findings.todokanai: "What were you two thinking in the first place? It's bad enough she has had almost no preparation, but to think you'd add the whole arrangement of compositions on top of that…"

findings.highlight: After I lied about having the flu and stopped going to work, and even turned off my phone, it goes without saying that the editing department faced a lot of hardships.
findings.evidenceJa:
インフルエンザを理由に出社しなくなり、
いつしか連絡もつかなくなった俺は、
当然ながら、編集部内でかなり問題になっていた。
findings.explanation: Haruki stops attending work using influenza as the reason; 'lied about having the flu' is stronger, especially because he had genuinely been diagnosed earlier — His continued absence and later deception make use of the illness as a pretext plausible, but the bounded line does not establish the diagnosis itself was false.
findings.japanese:
インフルエンザを理由に出社しなくなり、
いつしか連絡もつかなくなった俺は、
当然ながら、編集部内でかなり問題になっていた。
findings.todokanai: After I lied about having the flu and stopped going to work, and even turned off my phone, it goes without saying that the editing department faced a lot of hardships.

findings.highlight: put the front page editing on your shoulders.
findings.evidenceJa: 「よく考えてみればお前、一年目の新入社員なんだもんな。それでメインの編集まで任せるってのは、どだい無理な話だった」
findings.explanation: Hamada says it was unreasonable to entrust a first-year employee with serving as the main or lead editor. メインの編集 is a substantive editorial role, not the task of editing a front page; the English changes Haruki's professional responsibility and why management is blamed.
findings.japanese:
「よく考えてみればお前、一年目の新入社員なんだもんな。
それでメインの編集まで任せるってのは、
どだい無理な話だった」
findings.todokanai: "When I think about it, you're on your first year here, and I went as far as to put the front page editing on your shoulders. Obviously that was too much."

findings.highlight: "We promised to be together no matter what. We promised to be together no matter how much time passed."
findings.evidenceJa:
「どこまでも一緒だって。
いつまでも二人きりだって」
findings.explanation: They promised to remain alone together forever; the English says merely together no matter how much time passes — The surrounding two-person-world language preserves exclusivity.
findings.japanese:
「どこまでも一緒だって。
いつまでも二人きりだって」
findings.todokanai: "We promised to be together no matter what. We promised to be together no matter how much time passed."

findings.highlight: Why didn't you forget about me then?
findings.evidenceJa: 「そんなの五年前からわかりきってることだろ！どうしてあの時に振りほどいてくれなかったんだよ！」
findings.explanation: Haruki asks why Kazusa did not shake him off or push him away five years ago, since she always knew how aggravating he was. The English asks why she did not forget him, replacing the decisive outward rejection he now wishes she had made with an internal erasure of memory.
findings.japanese:
「そんなの五年前からわかりきってることだろ！
どうしてあの時に振りほどいてくれなかったんだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "You've known that for these five whole years, haven't you!? Why didn't you forget about me then?"

findings.highlight: Like hell he'd be tricked so easily… by these obvious lies!
findings.evidenceJa: 「そんな…そんないい加減な嘘に騙されるもんか！あたしの気持ちを馬鹿にするのもいい加減にしろ！」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she will not be fooled by Haruki's irresponsible lie that his broken present self is the real Haruki she loves. The English switches the subject to 'he,' making Haruki the one who would not be tricked and rendering Kazusa's furious defense of her own feelings incoherent.
findings.japanese:
「そんな…そんないい加減な嘘に騙されるもんか！
あたしの気持ちを馬鹿にするのもいい加減にしろ！」
findings.todokanai: "Like hell he'd be tricked so easily… by these obvious lies! Stop belittling my feelings!"

findings.highlight: "The new guy was handed such extreme tasks that he was unable to take care of them all, and ruined his health."
findings.evidenceJa:
『新入社員が過大な仕事量と責任を負ったせいで、
処理しきれずに精神的に参ってしまった』
findings.explanation: The office believes workload and responsibility caused a mental collapse; 'ruined his health' is broader and less psychologically precise — The mistaken overwork explanation remains.
findings.japanese:
『新入社員が過大な仕事量と責任を負ったせいで、
処理しきれずに精神的に参ってしまった』
findings.todokanai: "The new guy was handed such extreme tasks that he was unable to take care of them all, and ruined his health."

findings.highlight: fed up with myself for not even trying to explain the truth, and in the end, I don't even have anyone I can apologize to.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな自分に嫌気が差し、本当の事情を説明しようにも、結局、誰も謝罪を受け入れてくれない。
findings.explanation: Disgusted with himself, Haruki does try to explain the real circumstances, but nobody will accept his apology because everyone insists on treating him gently. The English says he never tries and has nobody available to apologize to, reversing both his attempted confession and his coworkers' refusal to receive it.
findings.japanese:
そんな自分に嫌気が差し、本当の事情を説明しようにも、
結局、誰も謝罪を受け入れてくれない。
findings.todokanai: And I feel fed up with myself for not even trying to explain the truth, and in the end, I don't even have anyone I can apologize to.

findings.highlight: the difference in body temperature between us.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさとの温度差に、鈍感でいようとしてた。
findings.explanation: Haruki has tried to remain deliberately insensitive to the widening figurative temperature gap between his desperate insistence and Kazusa's resolve to send him back. The English again literalizes emotional temperature as body heat, despite no bodily-temperature contrast in this train argument.
findings.japanese: かずさとの温度差に、鈍感でいようとしてた。
findings.todokanai: I tried to ignore the difference in body temperature between us.

findings.highlight: Back to the person who can protect you properly…
findings.evidenceJa: 「お前を、ちゃんと守れる雪菜のところに…」
findings.explanation: After first referring generically to someone who can treasure Haruki, Kazusa names Setsuna as the person who can properly protect him. The English repeats the generic description and omits Setsuna's name, erasing the culmination of Kazusa's argument at the exact moment the train leaves their white world.
findings.japanese: 「お前を、ちゃんと守れる雪菜のところに…」
findings.todokanai: "Back to the person who can protect you properly…"

findings.highlight: her hidden attempt to express her guilt and regret toward the woman who's sitting right next to me
findings.evidenceJa: そして今、俺の隣で再び涙を溢れさせている彼女への、後ろめたさと悔恨混じりのカモフラージュ。
findings.explanation: Kazusa's transcendent performance is camouflage for the affair, motivated by guilt and regret toward the crying Setsuna: it constructs an alibi that a pianist at this level could not have been trysting with Haruki. The English turns concealment into a hidden attempt to communicate guilt, the opposite function from the alibi explained in lines 364–366.
findings.japanese:
そして今、俺の隣で再び涙を溢れさせている彼女への、
後ろめたさと悔恨混じりのカモフラージュ。
findings.todokanai: And it's also her hidden attempt to express her guilt and regret toward the woman who's sitting right next to me with tears overflowing in her eyes.

findings.highlight: Despite that, I'm sure that Kazusa blamed everything on herself, acknowledged her sins, and is trying to accept her punishment.
findings.evidenceJa:
それでもかずさは多分
『ああ、全部あたしのせいだな』と、
罪を認め、罰を受けようとするだろう。
findings.explanation: Haruki predicts Kazusa will accept all blame and punishment; the English partly shifts the prediction into past and present fact — Her self-blaming disposition remains.
findings.japanese:
それでもかずさは多分
『ああ、全部あたしのせいだな』と、
罪を認め、罰を受けようとするだろう。
findings.todokanai: Despite that, I'm sure that Kazusa blamed everything on herself, acknowledged her sins, and is trying to accept her punishment.

findings.highlight: You were able to lie to me.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ほら、自分に嘘をつくこと、できたじゃないか。雪菜への気持ちをごまかして、あたしを抱いてくれたじゃないか」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki proved he can lie to himself: he disguised his feelings for Setsuna and embraced Kazusa. The English says he lied to Kazusa, reversing the addressee and breaking her proposal that he now perform the same self-deception in the other direction for Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
「ほら、自分に嘘をつくこと、できたじゃないか。
雪菜への気持ちをごまかして、
あたしを抱いてくれたじゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "See? You were able to lie to me. You were able to trick me regarding your feelings for Setsuna, and made love to me instead."

findings.highlight: Because I finally understood that I can't bring myself to contradict Kazusa's resolve.
findings.evidenceJa:
わかってしまったから。
かずさの覚悟を翻すことができないって。
findings.explanation: Haruki understands he cannot overturn Kazusa's resolve; 'can't bring myself to contradict' makes it a failure of will rather than efficacy — The finality of her resolve remains.
findings.japanese:
わかってしまったから。
かずさの覚悟を翻すことができないって。
findings.todokanai: Because I finally understood that I can't bring myself to contradict Kazusa's resolve.

findings.highlight: I bet she's dying to applaud herself
findings.evidenceJa: きっと、すごく拍手したいはずなのに、それでも、俺を気にかけることを優先する。
findings.explanation: Setsuna must desperately want to applaud Kazusa, yet prioritizes caring for Haruki and keeps both hands occupied with him. 'Applaud herself' means self-congratulation, replacing the very admiration for Kazusa that makes Setsuna's sacrifice of applause moving.
findings.japanese:
きっと、すごく拍手したいはずなのに、
それでも、俺を気にかけることを優先する。
findings.todokanai: I bet she's dying to applaud herself, but she's prioritizing watching over me.

findings.highlight: The boundless kindness Setsuna has is deceiving Setsuna herself
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の、その尽きない優しさこそが、雪菜を騙し、裏切ろうとする暗い心を呼び覚ます。
findings.explanation: Setsuna's inexhaustible kindness awakens in Haruki the dark impulse to deceive and betray Setsuna by accepting rescue without confessing. The English makes Setsuna's kindness itself deceive Setsuna, misattaching the action that belongs to Haruki's newly awakened dark heart.
findings.japanese:
雪菜の、その尽きない優しさこそが、
雪菜を騙し、裏切ろうとする暗い心を呼び覚ます。
