findings.evidenceJa: ただ不戦勝で残っただけの、わたしの二年間を、誰にも否定されたくなかったから
findings.explanation: Setsuna does not want anyone else to deny the two years that remained to her only by a walkover. Todokanai TL says she is trying to convince herself they were not meaningless, replacing possessive defiance toward outsiders with private uncertainty.
findings.japanese:
ただ不戦勝で残っただけの、わたしの二年間を、
誰にも否定されたくなかったから。
findings.todokanai: All I want to do… is to convince myself that the past two years weren't for nothing… when I won only because my opponent withdrew.

findings.highlight: You don't know unless you try!
findings.evidenceJa: “弾いてみなきゃわからない”って言われてるみたいで
findings.explanation: Kazusa dislikes an evaluation implying that nobody knows how well she will perform until she actually plays—an accusation of inconsistency. Todokanai TL turns it into the generic encouragement 'you don't know unless you try,' reversing criticism into motivational advice and weakening Youko's demand for stability.
findings.japanese:
「いちピアニストとしてはその評価はあまり嬉しくないな。
“弾いてみなきゃわからない”って言われてるみたいで」
findings.todokanai: "Being a pianist, I can't say that evaluation makes me happy. It's like you're telling me 'You don't know unless you try!' or something."

findings.highlight: provide me with such incredible power
findings.evidenceJa: そんな練習環境を用意できるなら、是非とも頼むよ社長
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks her boss to provide a training environment in which fifty or one hundred hours of daily practice are possible, setting up the Hyperbolic Time Chamber joke. Todokanai TL asks for 'incredible power,' breaking the transition from impossible hours to a time-altering room.
findings.japanese:
「そんな練習環境を用意できるなら、
是非とも頼むよ社長」
findings.todokanai: "If you can provide me with such incredible power, then by all means, boss."

findings.highlight: join me in my critique of these mandarins
findings.evidenceJa: ちゃんとボケに乗ってくれないと困るのよねぇ
findings.explanation: Youko complains that Kazusa failed to play along with her comic bit, which deliberately diverted the apology into frozen-mandarin expertise. Todokanai TL calls this a sincere critique of the fruit, deleting the joke-versus-seriousness contrast.
findings.japanese: 「…ちゃんとボケに乗ってくれないと困るのよねぇ」
findings.todokanai: "…I was really hoping you'd join me in my critique of these mandarins."

findings.highlight: Mom also left.
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんも、日本での用事を済ませてウィーンに帰ってきた
findings.explanation: Youko finished what business she could in Japan and returned to Vienna one week after Kazusa fled. 'Also left' omits the destination and the return that begins the passage about Youko abandoning Japan to follow and protect her daughter.
findings.japanese: 母さんも、日本での用事を済ませてウィーンに帰ってきた。
findings.todokanai: After finishing up the last of her business, Mom also left.

findings.highlight: my emotions were a mix of despair, unease and grief.
findings.evidenceJa: その事実に今さら納得してしまう自分がいた
findings.explanation: Amid despair, agitation, and grief, Kazusa recognizes that part of her is belatedly convinced by the truth of Youko's illness. Todokanai TL stops at the emotional mixture and omits the dawning acceptance that makes the next two explanations suddenly fit.
findings.japanese:
ウィーンで最初にその事実を知ったとき、
絶望や焦燥や悲嘆が混ざりあう感情の片隅で、
その事実に今さら納得してしまう自分がいた。
findings.todokanai: When I first found out about the truth, here in Vienna, my emotions were a mix of despair, unease and grief.

findings.highlight: I lost the little love I had for the idiotic daughter
findings.evidenceJa: 馬鹿娘に愛想が尽きた
findings.explanation: Kazusa is the foolish daughter and becomes disgusted with herself for trampling her mother's grave resolve over a childish heartbreak. Todokanai TL speaks as though she were a separate observer who possessed only a little love for that daughter, distorting both person and emotional direction.
findings.japanese:
そんな母親の重い決意を、
子供みたいな失恋で踏みにじってしまった
馬鹿娘に愛想が尽きた。
findings.todokanai: I lost the little love I had for the idiotic daughter who trampled all over her mother's determination, all because of some childish heartbreak.

findings.highlight: You're the idiot here!
findings.evidenceJa: 骨髄移植したらかなりの確率で治るんだろ？それに親族の方が適合する確率高いんだろ？
findings.explanation: Kazusa argues that a bone-marrow transplant has a strong chance of curing Youko and that relatives are more likely to match. Todokanai TL drops both medical premises and leaves only the insult, so Youko's 'And so what?' no longer answers a translated argument.
findings.japanese:
「馬鹿なのはそっちだろ！
骨髄移植したらかなりの確率で治るんだろ？
それに親族の方が適合する確率高いんだろ？」
findings.todokanai: "You're the idiot here!

findings.highlight: All because I've had a lifetime's worth of happiness…
findings.evidenceJa: 一生分の望みを叶えてしまったせいで…天国を垣間見てしまったせいで、今までよりも、過酷な現実が
findings.explanation: Because Kazusa fulfilled a lifetime's wishes and glimpsed heaven, the continuing reality is harsher than ever before. Todokanai TL reduces wishes to generic happiness, omits the glimpse of heaven, and leaves the causal literary climax incomplete.
findings.japanese:
一生分の望みを叶えてしまったせいで…
天国を垣間見てしまったせいで、
今までよりも、過酷な現実が。
findings.todokanai: A reality cruel beyond anything that preceded it. All because I've had a lifetime's worth of happiness…

findings.highlight: you'll always find something different than what you expected in the beginning.
findings.evidenceJa: けど、入って一月なんて、まだ見習いもいいところじゃない
findings.explanation: The reassurance continues: after only one month Tomo is still very much an apprentice. Todokanai TL drops that concrete calibration and leaves the quotation open, weakening why her dissatisfaction is premature.
findings.japanese:
「まぁ、最初のうちは色々とギャップ感じるよね。
けど、入って一月なんて、
まだ見習いもいいところじゃない」
findings.todokanai: "Well, you'll always find something different than what you expected in the beginning.

findings.highlight: Such as the mixer just the other day.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな人脈作れるのかって期待して行ったらさぁ、ＡＤクラスしかいなくってさぁ
findings.explanation: Tomo went expecting useful industry connections and found that every man there was only an assistant director. Todokanai TL omits the entire complaint and leaves only the event name, so the others' disbelief has no translated cause.
findings.japanese:
「例えばこないだの合コンよ。
どんな人脈作れるのかって期待して行ったらさぁ、
ＡＤクラスしかいなくってさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Such as the mixer just the other day.

findings.highlight: And to think they wanted to split the bill at such a cheap place.
findings.evidenceJa: しかもそんな価値もない飲みでワリカンとか終わってる。そんなんで二次会ったって誰が行くかってのよ、ねぇ？
findings.explanation: Tomo says an equally split bill made the worthless drinking party hopeless and asks who would attend its afterparty. Todokanai TL changes value into venue cheapness, omits the afterparty refusal, and leaves the quote unfinished.
findings.japanese:
「もうガッカリもいいとこ。
しかもそんな価値もない飲みでワリカンとか終わってる。
そんなんで二次会ったって誰が行くかってのよ、ねぇ？」
findings.todokanai: "I couldn't be more disappointed! And to think they wanted to split the bill at such a cheap place.

findings.highlight: An alumni meeting of former Miss Houjou winners.
findings.evidenceJa: 歴代ミス峰城大付の同窓会
findings.explanation: Tomo calls the trip a reunion of successive Miss Houjou University High titleholders. Todokanai TL reduces the school-specific title to generic 'Miss Houjou winners,' erasing the university-affiliated-school identity used throughout the work.
findings.japanese:
「ほんっと楽しみだなぁ。
歴代ミス峰城大付の同窓会。
findings.todokanai: "I'm so excited. An alumni meeting of former Miss Houjou winners.

findings.highlight: Arata hot springs
findings.evidenceJa: それじゃ阿多良温泉で決定
findings.explanation: The same destination is Atara Hot Springs at line 67. Todokanai TL changes it to Arata here, giving one location two spellings fourteen lines apart and breaking searchable continuity.
findings.japanese:
それじゃ阿多良温泉で決定！
なお、完全男子禁制で」
findings.todokanai: Alright, Arata hot springs it is then! No men allowed whatsoever."

findings.highlight: Hey, Setsuna…
findings.evidenceJa: 春希のこと、全部許すのも受け入れるのもいいけど、あいつの説教癖まで抱え込まなくていいから
findings.explanation: Io tells Setsuna that forgiving and accepting all of Haruki is one thing, but she need not absorb his compulsive lecturing too. Todokanai TL omits the entire line after the address, deleting the established Haruki trait that Setsuna has begun reproducing.
findings.japanese:
「雪菜さぁ…
春希のこと、全部許すのも受け入れるのもいいけど、
あいつの説教癖まで抱え込まなくていいから」
findings.todokanai: "Hey, Setsuna…

findings.highlight: I'll get someone else to take care of him.
findings.evidenceJa: うん、ちゃんと切り替える
findings.explanation: Setsuna promises she will properly switch mental gears and be present on the trip. Todokanai TL invents an arrangement for somebody else to care for Haruki, changing her internal decision into an unstated logistical plan.
findings.japanese:
「うん、ちゃんと切り替える。
…わたしね、最近気づいたんだ」
findings.todokanai: "It's okay, I'll get someone else to take care of him. …I realized, just recently."

findings.highlight: I mean, I want to be happy with everyone.
findings.evidenceJa: だから仕事も一生懸命やる。遊びだって手を抜かない
findings.explanation: Setsuna concludes that she will work with all her strength and refuse to neglect play either. Todokanai TL omits both commitments and leaves the quotation open, removing the practical definition of her resolve to sacrifice nothing.
findings.japanese:
「わたしはね、何も犠牲にしたりしないよ？
だって、みんなで幸せになりたいから。
だから仕事も一生懸命やる。遊びだって手を抜かない」
findings.todokanai: "I'm not going to sacrifice anything. I mean, I want to be happy with everyone.

findings.highlight: I just go with the flow without deciding anything.
findings.evidenceJa: その結果、雪菜を、かずさを、みんなを傷つけてさ
findings.explanation: Haruki's indecision has a stated result: he hurt Setsuna, Kazusa, and everyone. Todokanai TL drops the complete consequence and leaves the sentence hanging, softening the guilt that motivates his request for Takeya's judgment.
findings.japanese:
「人にはすぐに結果を求めるくせに、
結局、自分では何一つ決められずに流されてばっかで。
その結果、雪菜を、かずさを、みんなを傷つけてさ…」
findings.todokanai: "I always demand that everyone else is at their best, yet when it comes to myself, I just go with the flow without deciding anything.

findings.highlight: people have the hardest time understanding themselves over anyone else.
findings.evidenceJa: だから間違った選択をするし、けれど人の間違いはよく見える
findings.explanation: Takeya says people make wrong choices because they see themselves least clearly, yet see other people's mistakes well. Todokanai TL keeps only the first premise, deleting the paradox that authorizes him to advise Haruki despite his own failures.
findings.japanese:
「だいたい人間、自分のことが一番見えてないもんだ。
だから間違った選択をするし、
けれど人の間違いはよく見える」
findings.todokanai: "To begin with, people have the hardest time understanding themselves over anyone else.

findings.highlight: And once that baptism is over and done with, I'll be next.
findings.evidenceJa: 安心しろ、一生返せないくらいの恩返しをしてもらうさ
findings.explanation: After Haruki apologizes to the people who truly deserve it, Takeya jokes that he will demand a debt of gratitude impossible to repay in a lifetime. Todokanai TL drops that affectionate escalation and leaves the quotation unfinished.
findings.japanese:
「で、そっちの禊が終わったら次に俺な。
安心しろ、一生返せないくらいの恩返しをしてもらうさ」
findings.todokanai: "And once that baptism is over and done with, I'll be next.

findings.highlight: The monthly managerial meeting will be held at the end of this week, and I'm thinking of showing up then.
findings.evidenceJa: 今週末に月一の上司面談だから、そこで申し出てみようと思う
findings.explanation: This is Haruki's monthly interview with his supervisor, and he plans to ask there about returning to work. Todokanai TL turns it into a generic managerial meeting he may attend, omitting the actual proposal that makes Setsuna anxious.
findings.japanese:
『今週末に月一の上司面談だから、
そこで申し出てみようと思う』
findings.todokanai: "The monthly managerial meeting will be held at the end of this week, and I'm thinking of showing up then."

findings.highlight: the days are just as cheerfully warm as I remember.
findings.evidenceJa: 日中は思い出したように汗ばむ陽気になったりして、これからやってくる蒸し暑さに思いを馳せる頃
findings.explanation: The days now occasionally remember to grow warm enough to make people sweat, prompting thoughts of the muggy heat still to come. Todokanai TL invents remembered cheerful warmth and drops the forward-looking seasonal image.
findings.japanese:
まだ朝夕は涼しいけれど、
日中は思い出したように汗ばむ陽気になったりして、
これからやってくる蒸し暑さに思いを馳せる頃。
findings.todokanai: The mornings and evenings are still chilly, but the days are just as cheerfully warm as I remember.

findings.highlight: Haruki-kun sent me a text.
findings.evidenceJa: 春希くんが、メールを再開した
findings.explanation: Haruki has resumed emailing: the point is a recovered channel of communication after a period of silence, not the arrival of one isolated text. The reduction breaks the milestone developed in the surrounding paragraphs.
findings.japanese: 春希くんが、メールを再開した。
findings.todokanai: Haruki-kun sent me a text.

findings.highlight: He didn't even charge his cell phone until very recently. Even now, he never calls me nor answers any of my calls.
findings.evidenceJa: しばらく、携帯の電源すら入れられなかったけれど。今もまだ、電話はかけられないし、出られないけれど
findings.explanation: Haruki was unable even to turn the phone on, and still cannot place or answer calls at all. Todokanai TL changes powering it on into charging it and narrows a general incapacity into behavior specifically toward Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
しばらく、携帯の電源すら入れられなかったけれど。
今もまだ、電話はかけられないし、出られないけれど。
findings.todokanai: He didn't even charge his cell phone until very recently. Even now, he never calls me nor answers any of my calls.

findings.highlight: Then on top of that, I maintain a bit more distance
findings.evidenceJa: …彼を怯えさせないように、息苦しさを感じさせないように、ほんの少しだけ距離を置いて
findings.explanation: Setsuna first tells herself the small distance is to keep Haruki dry, then corrects herself: it is really so she will not frighten or suffocate him. Todokanai TL makes this a second, additional increase in distance and destroys the revealing self-correction.
findings.japanese:
…彼を怯えさせないように、
息苦しさを感じさせないように、
ほんの少しだけ距離を置いて。
findings.todokanai: Then on top of that, I maintain a bit more distance, so that I don't scare him… so that I don't make him feel suffocated.

findings.highlight: a postcard with everyone's names on it.
findings.evidenceJa: 寄せ書きだってくれたじゃない、みんな
findings.explanation: His colleagues gave him a group-written message board, described on the next line as a shikishi displayed beside his bed. A postcard bearing names is the wrong object and loses the personal messages gathered for his recovery.
findings.japanese:
「だからぁ、春希くんだって必要とされてるよ。
寄せ書きだってくれたじゃない、みんな」
findings.todokanai: "I keep telling you, you're needed as well. They even sent you a postcard with everyone's names on it."

findings.highlight: a piece of colored paper, sent by the editorial staff of Kaiousha.
findings.evidenceJa: 開桜グラフ編集部の人たちが贈ってくれた色紙
findings.explanation: The gift is a shikishi message board from the Kaiou Graph editorial department. Todokanai TL reads 色紙 literally as colored paper and substitutes a company-like 'Kaiousha' for the named publication, breaking both the physical scene and institutional continuity.
findings.japanese:
彼のベッドの脇には、
開桜グラフ編集部の人たちが贈ってくれた
色紙が飾られている。
findings.todokanai: Beside his bed lies a piece of colored paper, sent by the editorial staff of Kaiousha.

findings.highlight: far from what he intended
findings.evidenceJa: 多分、彼が意図したものとはちょっとだけ違ってて
findings.explanation: Setsuna says the pain differs only a little from what Haruki intended, a fine distinction before she explains why his betrayal proves feelings can endure. 'Far from' reverses that degree and makes the connection much looser than the Japanese.
findings.japanese:
けれどその痛みは、
多分、彼が意図したものとはちょっとだけ違ってて。
findings.todokanai: But that inflicted pain is far from what he intended with those words.

findings.highlight: when I had to sit beside you for five years as you kept thinking about Kazusa.
findings.evidenceJa: 五年もかずさを忘れなかったあなたが側にいるから、信じられてしまうんだよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna can believe in unfading love because the man beside her now failed to forget Kazusa for five years. Todokanai TL instead says Setsuna sat beside him throughout those five years and 'had to' believe, changing both the timeline and her painful logic.
findings.japanese:
五年もかずさを忘れなかったあなたが側にいるから、
信じられてしまうんだよ…
findings.todokanai: I had no choice but to believe it, when I had to sit beside you for five years as you kept thinking about Kazusa.

findings.highlight: I'm doing this because I want to…
findings.evidenceJa: だから、それはわたしのワガママで
findings.explanation: Setsuna explicitly calls remaining beside Haruki her own selfishness. Todokanai TL reduces the morally charged ワガママ to neutral personal desire, cleaning away her characteristic self-indictment.
findings.japanese: 「だから、それはわたしのワガママで…」
findings.todokanai: "I told you, I'm doing this because I want to…"

findings.highlight: once every two weeks or so.
findings.evidenceJa: 十日に一度くらい陥る
findings.explanation: The severe crash occurs about once every ten days, not once every two weeks. This is a direct numerical error in Setsuna's account of Haruki's condition.
findings.japanese:
昨日の彼は、わたしが側にいるだけで参ってしまうほどの、
十日に一度くらい陥る、どん底の状態だったから。
findings.todokanai: Yesterday, he was in such a terrible state that just having me around was enough to ruin him, something that only happens once every two weeks or so.

findings.highlight: The sound of the rain and the darkness of the sky seeped into the tepidness of his room, robbing him of any courage or joy he had left.
findings.evidenceJa: 雨の音と、空の暗さと、生温い空気にあてられて、元気も、勇気も奪われてしまっていたから
findings.explanation: The rain, dark sky, and lukewarm air acted on Haruki and robbed him of vigor and courage. Todokanai TL makes rain and darkness seep into 'the tepidness of his room,' a causal relationship absent from the source, and changes vigor into joy.
findings.japanese:
雨の音と、空の暗さと、生温い空気にあてられて、
元気も、勇気も奪われてしまっていたから。
findings.todokanai: The sound of the rain and the darkness of the sky seeped into the tepidness of his room, robbing him of any courage or joy he had left.

findings.highlight: no matter how much I tried to console him, encourage him, or embrace him.
findings.evidenceJa: 慰めても、励ましても、優しくしても
findings.explanation: Setsuna says that consoling, encouraging, or treating him gently has never restored his strength. Todokanai TL invents embracing him, immediately before the text explains that on such days she cannot safely embrace him.
findings.japanese:
そんな日は、慰めても、励ましても、優しくしても、
春希くんが力を取り戻すことは、経験上ない。
findings.todokanai: On days like that, I never managed to restore Haruki-kun's strength, no matter how much I tried to console him, encourage him, or embrace him.

findings.highlight: I'm always caught in a struggle between myself and my low blood pressure, which keeps trying to hold me tied down to bed.
findings.evidenceJa: 低血圧と戦いながら、ゆっくりと体を起こす
findings.explanation: The sentence culminates in Setsuna slowly sitting herself up while fighting her low blood pressure. Todokanai TL translates the subordinate struggle but omits the main physical action.
findings.japanese:
休みの日の朝になると、
いつもわたしをベッドに縛り付けようとする
低血圧と戦いながら、ゆっくりと体を起こす。
findings.todokanai: Every weekend morning, I'm always caught in a struggle between myself and my low blood pressure, which keeps trying to hold me tied down to bed.

findings.highlight: only told me out of convenience.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女と、ついでにわたしにしか話さない
findings.explanation: Setsuna downgrades herself to an afterthought: he told Kazusa, and incidentally her. 'Out of convenience' invents a utilitarian motive and changes the precise form of Setsuna's self-abasement.
findings.japanese:
ううん、彼女と、ついでにわたしにしか話さない、
彼の、切り捨てた過去のこと。
findings.todokanai: No, he told her first and only told me out of convenience. About the past he had cast away.

findings.highlight: he lost sight of his family when he was younger.
findings.evidenceJa: 子供の頃の行き違いがもとで捻れてしまっているだけかもしれない
findings.explanation: Setsuna's father suggests a childhood misunderstanding may simply have twisted the relationship. Todokanai TL replaces the misunderstanding with Haruki 'losing sight' of his family, an event not stated in the Japanese.
findings.japanese:
「単に、子供の頃の行き違いがもとで
捻れてしまっているだけかもしれない。
一度、母親の真意を確かめる必要があるんじゃないか？」
findings.todokanai: "He might simply be in a bad way because he lost sight of his family when he was younger. Shouldn't we at least ask his mother what she thinks?"

findings.highlight: We can just set things straight if there was simply a misunderstanding between them.
findings.evidenceJa: けれど、もし彼の言う通り、根が深いのであれば、もっと色々考えていかなければならない
findings.explanation: The father contrasts an easily resolved misunderstanding with the possibility that the roots are as deep as Haruki says, in which case the families must consider much more. Todokanai TL deletes the complete second half, leaving the next question without its antecedent.
findings.japanese:
「単なる誤解だったら解けばいい。
けれど、もし彼の言う通り、根が深いのであれば、
もっと色々考えていかなければならない」
findings.todokanai: "We can just set things straight if there was simply a misunderstanding between them.

findings.highlight: the way you're handling it isn't doing him any good.
findings.evidenceJa: だからって、今のままでは何も進まないじゃないか
findings.explanation: Her father says that even so, nothing will move forward if things remain as they are. Todokanai TL turns an impersonal stalemate into an accusation that Setsuna's handling is ineffective, adding blame not present in the line.
findings.japanese: 「だからって、今のままでは何も進まないじゃないか」
findings.todokanai: "But the way you're handling it isn't doing him any good."

findings.highlight: I hit the nail on the head.
findings.evidenceJa: その目論見はみごとに的中した
findings.explanation: Setsuna's scheme to draw her mother into the argument appeared to work exactly as planned. 'Hit the nail on the head' normally means making a correct diagnosis or statement, not successfully executing a scheme, so the English assigns the success to the wrong kind of act.
findings.japanese: そして、その目論見はみごとに的中した。
findings.todokanai: And I hit the nail on the head.

findings.highlight: we weren't on speaking terms with his family
findings.evidenceJa: 家族同士が知り合いでない方が後々いいんじゃないかと
findings.explanation: Setsuna's mother says it may be better later if the two families never become acquainted. Todokanai TL's 'weren't on speaking terms' implies an existing acquaintance followed by estrangement, changing the preventive argument she is making.
findings.japanese:
「そういう場合は、家族同士が知り合いでない方が
後々いいんじゃないかと…」
findings.todokanai: "Then perhaps it'd be better if… we weren't on speaking terms with his family…"

findings.highlight: She simply had her own reason.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ、たまたま思惑が一致しただけ
findings.explanation: The revelation is that mother and daughter happened to want the same immediate outcome for entirely different reasons. Todokanai TL notes only that her mother had a reason, omitting the accidental alignment that explains the apparent support.
findings.japanese: ただ、たまたま思惑が一致しただけ。
findings.todokanai: She simply had her own reason.

findings.highlight: I thought about going back…
findings.evidenceJa: 仕方なく踵を返して玄関に戻る
findings.explanation: Setsuna actually turns on her heel and returns to the entryway, where she notices she is wearing slip-ons. Todokanai TL changes the completed movement into merely thinking about returning.
findings.japanese:
仕方なく踵を返して玄関に戻る。
…と、その踵に履いていたものもただの突っかけだった。
findings.todokanai: Deeming it a lost cause, I thought about going back… Only then realizing that I had left in my slippers.

findings.highlight: She's starting to wonder whether something bad happened between you and Kitahara-san.
findings.evidenceJa: それも、婚約とか言い出した頃からさ
findings.explanation: Takahiro adds that their mother suspects the trouble began around the time Setsuna started talking about engagement. Todokanai TL drops that complete timing clause and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「姉ちゃんと北原さん、
なんかトラブルがあったんじゃないかって。
それも、婚約とか言い出した頃からさ」
findings.todokanai: "She's starting to wonder whether something bad happened between you and Kitahara-san.

findings.highlight: Until just recently, you both treated him like family
findings.evidenceJa: 二人とも、今まで彼のこと、ずっと家族みたいにしてくれてたじゃない
findings.explanation: Setsuna protests that they have treated Haruki like family all along up to the present crisis. 'Until just recently' says that treatment had already stopped, contradicting the continuity asserted by 今まで and ずっと.
findings.japanese:
「二人とも、今まで彼のこと、
ずっと家族みたいにしてくれてたじゃない！」
findings.todokanai: "Both of you! Until just recently, you both treated him like family, didn't you!?"

findings.highlight: Why do you have to grasp at straws like that!?
findings.evidenceJa: どうしてそういう揚げ足ばっかり取るのよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna accuses Takahiro of constantly seizing on verbal slips and inconsistencies. 'Grasp at straws' means making a desperate weak attempt, not pedantically catching somebody's wording, so the English accusation is the wrong one.
findings.japanese: 「っ！　どうしてそういう揚げ足ばっかり取るのよ！」
findings.todokanai: "…! Why do you have to grasp at straws like that!?"

findings.highlight: This is an important time for me right now.
findings.evidenceJa: 今が大事な時期なんだよ
findings.explanation: The critical period is Haruki's recovery and the need to support him carefully, not a special period for Setsuna personally. Todokanai TL inserts 'for me,' shifting the center of the argument away from the patient she is discussing.
findings.japanese:
「今が大事な時期なんだよ。
お父さんもお母さんも、
そのことが全然わかってないんだよ」
findings.todokanai: "This is an important time for me right now. Mom and dad don't understand that at all."

findings.highlight: Mom has started to entertain the thought of us breaking up.
findings.evidenceJa: 孝宏は、彼の誠実を疑うようになり
findings.explanation: The three-part family inventory ends with Takahiro beginning to doubt Haruki's sincerity. Todokanai TL omits that entire third clause, breaking the parallel and deleting the brother's distinct concern.
findings.japanese:
お父さんは、彼を家族から家族候補に格下げし。
お母さんは、わたしたちが別れる可能性を否定しなくなり。
孝宏は、彼の誠実を疑うようになり。
findings.todokanai: Dad has demoted him from "family member" to "potential family member." Mom has started to entertain the thought of us breaking up.

findings.highlight: I've got nothing to do with this
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は、部外者だから
findings.explanation: Takahiro modestly calls himself an outsider to the couple's relationship, which limits his right to pronounce on it. Todokanai TL says he has nothing to do with the situation at all, disowning an involvement his conduct and family position plainly retain.
findings.japanese:
「俺は、部外者だから
そうそうえらそうなことは言えないけどさ…」
findings.todokanai: "I've got nothing to do with this, so I can't act like I know everything, but…"

findings.highlight: she's started to neglect even hiding that fact.
findings.evidenceJa: なにより、それらの手入れを怠るようになっていった
findings.explanation: Above all, Youko has begun neglecting the care and maintenance of her hair, skin, and appearance. Todokanai TL instead says she has stopped hiding her decline, changing neglected grooming into a decision about concealment.
findings.japanese: …なにより、それらの手入れを怠るようになっていった。
findings.todokanai: …And above all, she's started to neglect even hiding that fact.

findings.highlight: in an attempt to feign indifference, but it's all too obvious.
findings.evidenceJa: 体力を削り、生命力を削り、軽さを保とうとしながらも、けれど内容が怪しくなってくる
findings.explanation: Youko spends visible stamina and vitality trying to preserve her customary lightness, but the content of her chatter grows ominous and suspect. Todokanai TL makes the problem merely that her indifference is obviously feigned, omitting the increasingly death-oriented content.
findings.japanese:
あからさまに体力を削り、生命力を削り、
軽さを保とうとしながらも、
けれど内容が怪しくなってくる。
findings.todokanai: She's clearly tearing away at her body, her energy, in an attempt to feign indifference, but it's all too obvious.

findings.highlight: She's not making fun of me anymore. She's not avoiding confrontations anymore.
findings.evidenceJa: からかってくれない。受け流してくれない。面白くない、愉快じゃない話を繰り返す
findings.explanation: Youko no longer teases Kazusa, no longer brushes matters lightly aside, and keeps repeating stories that are neither interesting nor cheerful. Todokanai TL changes brushing things off into avoiding confrontations and omits the complete third clause.
findings.japanese:
からかってくれない。
受け流してくれない。
面白くない、愉快じゃない話を繰り返す。
findings.todokanai: She's not making fun of me anymore. She's not avoiding confrontations anymore.

findings.highlight: her regrets, worries and memories.
findings.evidenceJa: やり残し、心配事、思い出話だけが増えていく
findings.explanation: The growing subjects are unfinished business, worries, and reminiscences: a practical inventory of a life being put in order. 'Regrets' is not the meaning of やり残し and blurs the preparations that lead into keys, inheritance, and family history.
findings.japanese: やり残し、心配事、思い出話だけが増えていく。
findings.todokanai: She's been talking more and more about her regrets, worries and memories.

findings.highlight: being the sole descendant of Touma Youko
findings.evidenceJa: 冬馬曜子の子孫の方は、どうやらあたし一人になってしまいそうなのは申し訳ない
findings.explanation: Kazusa's aside is that she feels sorry the line of Youko's descendants looks likely to end with Kazusa alone. Todokanai TL treats her present status as an only descendant as the source of guilt, losing the implication that Kazusa expects to leave no descendants after herself.
findings.japanese:
…ついでに言うと、冬馬曜子の子孫の方は、
どうやらあたし一人になってしまいそうなのは
申し訳ないとは思ってるけどさ。
findings.todokanai: I also feel somewhat guilty over being the sole descendant of Touma Youko, for that matter.

findings.highlight: breaks the silence of the hospital room, resounding amidst the pitter-patter of the rain outside.
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんの嗚咽が、雨音の隙間を塗って病室に静かに響く
findings.explanation: Youko's sobs fill the gaps in the sound of the rain and echo quietly through the room. Todokanai TL says they break silence despite the audible rain, reversing the carefully described interleaving of the two sounds.
findings.japanese: 母さんの嗚咽が、雨音の隙間を塗って病室に静かに響く。
findings.todokanai: Mom's weeping breaks the silence of the hospital room, resounding amidst the pitter-patter of the rain outside.

findings.highlight: She was an insurmountable wall of a rival.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、心安らかに語らえる親友だった
findings.explanation: The four-part portrait ends by calling Youko a close friend with whom Kazusa could speak in peace. Todokanai TL stops after goddess, mother, and rival, deleting the tender role whose disappearance makes the ordinary old woman before her so painful.
findings.japanese:
冬馬曜子は、あたしにとって傲慢な神だった。
身勝手な母親だった。手の届かない宿敵だった。
そして、心安らかに語らえる親友だった。
findings.todokanai: Touma Youko was always an arrogant goddess in my eyes. She was a selfish mother. She was an insurmountable wall of a rival.

findings.highlight: I've gotten much better since my last concert, you know?
findings.evidenceJa: 一日５０時間も１００時間も弾いてるからな
findings.explanation: Kazusa boasts that she has improved enormously because she practices fifty or even a hundred hours a day. Todokanai TL omits the impossible comic exaggeration and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「そしたら、あたしのピアノ聴かせてやる。
この前のコンサートの時より格段に上手くなったぞ？
一日５０時間も１００時間も弾いてるからな」
findings.todokanai: "Then I'll let you hear me playing the piano. I've gotten much better since my last concert, you know?

findings.highlight: It'll start Saturday night and will continue until everyone's performed.
findings.evidenceJa: 全部のステージが終わったら解散。出演順だけ決めて、あとは持ち時間も適当なんだって
findings.explanation: The performers disband once every set is over; only the order is fixed, while each act's allotted time is deliberately loose. Todokanai TL drops both defining details and leaves the quotation open, weakening the joke answered by Io on the next line.
findings.japanese:
「そ、レギュラー総出演のオールナイト！
土曜の夜から始めて全部のステージが終わったら解散。
出演順だけ決めて、あとは持ち時間も適当なんだって」
findings.todokanai: "Right, it's an all-night showing of all the regulars. It'll start Saturday night and will continue until everyone's performed.

findings.highlight: I'm just a backup singer.
findings.evidenceJa: わたし、ただのヘルプだし
findings.explanation: Setsuna describes herself as only a fill-in or guest helping Routes, not as a backing vocalist within the performance. 'Backup singer' assigns her a different musical role and undercuts why Tomo says she alone still sees herself as temporary.
findings.japanese:
「え？　で、でも…
わたし、ただのヘルプだし」
findings.todokanai: "Eh? B-But… I'm just a backup singer."

findings.highlight: I'll be forced to take countless days off, right?
findings.evidenceJa: 何回か休み、拘束されるよね
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether rehearsals will occupy several of her days off. Todokanai TL says she must take countless days off work, changing both the finite quantity and whose schedule is being consumed.
findings.japanese:
「でも、練習だってあるよね？
何回か休み、拘束されるよね？」
findings.todokanai: "But I'll have to rehearse, right? I'll be forced to take countless days off, right?"

findings.highlight: You can rehearse the rest during karaoke.
findings.evidenceJa: あとは個人練習でカバーすればさぁ
findings.explanation: Tomo says one or two group rehearsals are enough and the rest can be covered by individual practice. Karaoke is not mentioned and turns a general rehearsal plan into an invented venue/activity.
findings.japanese:
「それだって１、２回くらいいいじゃん。
あとは個人練習でカバーすればさぁ」
findings.todokanai: "Just one or two days should be enough. You can rehearse the rest during karaoke."

findings.highlight: Why won't she change for my sake…?
findings.evidenceJa: どうして、変わってくれないのかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna wonders why Tomo will not change. Todokanai TL adds 'for my sake,' converting her exhausted wish for greater understanding into a more explicitly self-centered demand.
findings.japanese: どうして、変わってくれないのかな…
findings.todokanai: Why won't she change for my sake…?

findings.highlight: he's not gonna get better just because you suffer yourself, Setsuna.
findings.evidenceJa: どれだけ雪菜が苦しんでも、彼は楽にならないよ？あの北原さんなら尚更でしょ？
findings.explanation: Tomo adds that this is especially true of Haruki, whose personality makes Setsuna's suffering still less capable of easing his own. Todokanai TL drops that pointed appeal to Haruki's character and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「彼の苦しみを引き受けてあげたいのかもしれないけど、
どれだけ雪菜が苦しんでも、彼は楽にならないよ？
あの北原さんなら尚更でしょ？」
findings.todokanai: "I understand that you want to take on all his suffering, but he's not gonna get better just because you suffer yourself, Setsuna.

findings.highlight: The gloomy dimness of my own world refuses to be chased away.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの世界の中からは、湿っぽさも、薄暗さも未だ吹き飛んでくれてはいない
findings.explanation: Even after the rainy season, neither dampness nor dimness has cleared from Setsuna's world. Todokanai TL fuses the two into 'gloomy dimness,' deleting the dampness that has structured the chapter's weather and emotional imagery.
findings.japanese:
わたしの世界の中からは、
湿っぽさも、薄暗さも未だ吹き飛んでくれてはいない。
findings.todokanai: The gloomy dimness of my own world refuses to be chased away.

findings.highlight: the European branch of Touma Youko Office
findings.evidenceJa: 冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部
findings.explanation: Urgent callers are directed to the European headquarters, not another branch. The headquarters/branch distinction matters because the Japanese office has suspended operations and Europe is now carrying the organization.
findings.japanese:
「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、
冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。
電話番号は…」
findings.todokanai: "If you have urgent business, please contact the European branch of Touma Youko Office. The number to them is…"

findings.highlight: Just how long is Miyoko's vacation, exactly…?
findings.evidenceJa: いつまで休んでんだよ、美代子さん
findings.explanation: Kazusa is complaining to Miyoko about how long the Japanese office remains closed or inactive after the recorded announcement. Todokanai TL invents a personal vacation, though the surrounding lines establish a suspended branch rather than ordinary leave.
findings.japanese: 「いつまで休んでんだよ、美代子さん…」
findings.todokanai: "Just how long is Miyoko's vacation, exactly…?"

findings.highlight: makes my head hurt.
findings.evidenceJa: 受話器を置く手がどうにも重かった
findings.explanation: Imagining the wasted international charge makes Kazusa's hand heavy as she puts down the receiver. Todokanai TL replaces the concrete reluctance to hang up with a generic headache.
findings.japanese:
たった数秒とはいえ、
無駄になった日本への国際通話料の金額を想像すると、
受話器を置く手がどうにも重かった。
findings.todokanai: The call might have only lasted for a few seconds, but just imagining the fee for international calls to Japan makes my head hurt.

findings.highlight: I've been greeted by the answering machine the entire month.
findings.evidenceJa: 日本支部はほぼ開店休業状態ってことらしかった
findings.explanation: Ten calls and nearly a month of answering-machine responses lead Kazusa to conclude that the Japanese branch is effectively open in name only. Todokanai TL gives the call history but omits that explicit organizational conclusion.
findings.japanese:
最初にかけてから１０回連続、
ほぼ一か月間ずっと留守電のままということから、
日本支部はほぼ開店休業状態ってことらしかった。
findings.todokanai: This is the tenth time since I first called her, and I've been greeted by the answering machine the entire month.

findings.highlight: Mom managed to bring herself to ask for that song
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんが喉の奥から絞り出した曲名
findings.explanation: Youko squeezed the title out from deep in her throat, a bodily image consistent with her failing strength. Todokanai TL makes the difficulty psychological reluctance to ask, altering the scene's account of her condition.
findings.japanese:
あの、母さんが喉の奥から絞り出した曲名を聞いてから、
はや一月…
findings.todokanai: It's been a month since Mom managed to bring herself to ask for that song…

findings.highlight: After the third orchestra I tried to negotiate with…
findings.evidenceJa: 三箇所目で挫折した
findings.explanation: Kazusa gave up on the telephone campaign at the third office. Todokanai TL omits the actual failure and leaves the sentence unfinished.
findings.japanese:
最初のうちは、レッスンの合間を縫って、
電話帳で探したオケの事務所にかたっぱしから
電話を掛けて交渉しようとして…三箇所目で挫折した。
findings.todokanai: At first, I used the time between my lessons to check the phone book for all orchestras from A to Z. After the third orchestra I tried to negotiate with…

findings.highlight: Getting an email address and functioning internet took another three.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、文面を考えるのに、さらに３日間
findings.explanation: The comic schedule is three days for the computer, three for email and internet, and another three merely composing the message. Todokanai TL drops the third equal interval and therefore the setup for 'nearly ten days' on the next line.
findings.japanese:
パソコンのセットアップに３日間。
メールやインターネットのセットアップに３日間。
そして、文面を考えるのに、さらに３日間。
findings.todokanai: It took me three days to get the computer running. Getting an email address and functioning internet took another three.

findings.highlight: every single orchestra in the phone book, whose email addresses I found on the web.
findings.evidenceJa: ｗｅｂ上で探したオケのメールアドレスに、片っ端から送って…返ってきたのは質問の嵐だった
findings.explanation: The addresses themselves were found on the web, not in the phone book, and the mass mailing produced a storm of questions. Todokanai TL combines contradictory sources and omits the response that drives the next line.
findings.japanese:
そんな、１０日近くもかけて作り上げた文面を、
ｗｅｂ上で探したオケのメールアドレスに、
片っ端から送って…返ってきたのは質問の嵐だった。
findings.todokanai: After nearly ten days worth of effort, the resulting message was sent to every single orchestra in the phone book, whose email addresses I found on the web.

findings.highlight: About the pay, about the scheduling, about the venue…
findings.evidenceJa: 結局、その返信にまた三日かかり、さらに返ってきたのは疑問と怒りとお断りの嵐だった
findings.explanation: It took Kazusa another three days to answer questions about money, schedule, and venue, after which she received a storm of confusion, anger, and refusals. Todokanai TL deletes the complete result and leaves only the list of subjects.
findings.japanese:
お金のこととか、日程のこととか、会場のこととか、
結局、その返信にまた三日かかり、
さらに返ってきたのは疑問と怒りとお断りの嵐だった。
findings.todokanai: About the pay, about the scheduling, about the venue…

findings.highlight: the headquarters of our European branch just couldn't bear to watch any longer.
findings.evidenceJa: 欧州本部のスタッフが、オケとの交渉を一手に引き受けてくれた
findings.explanation: The European headquarters staff took over all negotiation with orchestras. Todokanai TL supplies only their exasperated observation and omits the action that explains why Kazusa is now calling Emma for results.
findings.japanese:
そんなこんなで、無駄に半月ほど費やした頃、
見るに見かねた欧州本部のスタッフが、
オケとの交渉を一手に引き受けてくれた。
findings.todokanai: After seeing me run around like a headless chicken for nearly half a month, the headquarters of our European branch just couldn't bear to watch any longer.

findings.highlight: It's the means I hated most of all.
findings.evidenceJa: 『日本人ピアニスト』『冬馬曜子の娘』というキンキラキンの看板が一番目立つ国を利用する、自分が一番嫌ってた悪趣味な手
findings.explanation: Kazusa considers exploiting the country where the gaudy labels 'Japanese pianist' and 'Touma Youko's daughter' carry the greatest promotional force. Todokanai TL omits the entire substance of the tactic, leaving only that she hated it.
findings.japanese:
それは『日本人ピアニスト』『冬馬曜子の娘』という
キンキラキンの看板が一番目立つ国を利用する、
自分が一番嫌ってた悪趣味な手。
findings.todokanai: It's the means I hated most of all.

findings.highlight: would probably end in failure… No, it would definitely end in failure.
findings.evidenceJa: そんな赤字覚悟…というか、赤字確実の興行
findings.explanation: The planned concert would probably—indeed certainly—run at a financial loss. Todokanai TL changes red ink into artistic or practical failure, obscuring the extravagance of importing an entire Japanese orchestra to Vienna.
findings.japanese:
そんな赤字覚悟…というか、
赤字確実の興行を計画するところまで、
追い詰められていた。
findings.todokanai: I felt so cornered that I found no other choice but to rely on something that would probably end in failure… No, it would definitely end in failure.

findings.highlight: the very first orchestra I sent a request to
findings.evidenceJa: ここから歩いて五分の市民オケ
findings.explanation: The reply comes from a civic orchestra only a five-minute walk away. Todokanai TL omits the striking proximity, a concrete irony after Kazusa's sprawling and unsuccessful international search.
findings.japanese:
アドレスを確認すると、
一番最初にメールを出したけど返事の来なかった、
ここから歩いて五分の市民オケからだった。
findings.todokanai: Checking the address, I noticed it was from the very first orchestra I sent a request to, but never got any response from.

findings.highlight: Any orchestra he commands always fills every seat at their concerts, and he's booked solid until next year.
findings.evidenceJa: 自身が率いるオーケストラの定期公演はいつも満席。それどころか一年先まで予約で一杯
findings.explanation: It is Dupre's own orchestra whose regular subscription concerts are always sold out, with reservations filled a year ahead. Todokanai TL generalizes this to any orchestra he happens to command and leaves what is booked ambiguous.
findings.japanese:
自身が率いるオーケストラの定期公演はいつも満席。
それどころか一年先まで予約で一杯。
まさに今、脂の乗った気鋭の指揮者と言える。
findings.todokanai: Any orchestra he commands always fills every seat at their concerts, and he's booked solid until next year.

findings.highlight: Franz Dubre Orchestra
findings.evidenceJa: フランツ・デュプレ・オーケストラ
findings.explanation: The orchestra is the Franz Dupre Orchestra everywhere else in the same scene. 'Dubre' creates a second spelling for the same named ensemble at a line emphasizing its extraordinary availability.
findings.japanese:
そもそも、フランツ・デュプレ・オーケストラを
年内で押さえることができたのは奇跡だったらしい。
findings.todokanai: The very fact that the Franz Dubre Orchestra could even find an opening within the year is a miracle in and of itself.

findings.highlight: Sweat pouring out just by standing outside during the day, and discomfort no matter how many times I turn over in bed during the night.
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく体力を奪っていく
findings.explanation: The merciless daytime heat and sleepless nights are explicitly draining Setsuna's physical strength. Todokanai TL translates two atmospheric fragments but omits the main predicate, which sets up her question about what else has been taken from her.
findings.japanese:
外にいるだけで汗が噴き出す日中が、
何度寝返りを打っても寝苦しい夜中が、
容赦なく体力を奪っていく。
findings.todokanai: Sweat pouring out just by standing outside during the day, and discomfort no matter how many times I turn over in bed during the night.

findings.highlight: The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly.
findings.evidenceJa: まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります
findings.explanation: The announcement says the Onjuku-bound train will arrive shortly. Todokanai TL says it is about to depart, reversing the train's movement before the later announcement that it actually leaves without Setsuna.
findings.japanese:
「まもなく、一番線御宿行きが参ります。
白線の内側までお下がりください」
findings.todokanai: "The train on Line 1 toward Onjuku will depart shortly. Please stay within the white lines."

findings.highlight: my family didn't allow me to visit him on Friday
findings.evidenceJa: 金曜にお泊まりっていうのは家族が許してくれなかった
findings.explanation: Setsuna's family refused to let her stay overnight on Friday after she spent Thursday ill in bed. Todokanai TL reduces the restriction to visiting at all, changing both the degree of family control and why Saturday morning is only half a day late.
findings.japanese:
さすがに木曜に体調不良で休んでおいて、
金曜にお泊まりっていうのは家族が許してくれなかった。
findings.todokanai: Unsurprisingly, my family didn't allow me to visit him on Fridayーnot after having spent the entirety of Thursday bedridden.

findings.highlight: Yeah, the day will go something like that.
findings.evidenceJa: 今週は少しの時間しか一緒にいられないけど、来週を乗り切れば、今度はお盆休みが待っている
findings.explanation: Setsuna can spend only a short time with Haruki this week, but if she gets through the next one, the Obon holiday awaits. Todokanai TL omits both sentences, deleting the longer reward she uses to propel herself onward.
findings.japanese:
うん、そんな感じ。
今週は少しの時間しか一緒にいられないけど、
来週を乗り切れば、今度はお盆休みが待っている。
findings.todokanai: Yeah, the day will go something like that.

findings.highlight: I can't even board the train
findings.evidenceJa: 全身の汗に熱を奪われ寒気に震えるわたしは
findings.explanation: Sweat is drawing heat from Setsuna's whole body and leaving her shivering with chills when she cannot board. Todokanai TL retains only the failed action and omits the alarming physical state that disproves her heat-exhaustion explanation.
findings.japanese:
なのに今、全身の汗に熱を奪われ寒気に震えるわたしは、
たった一駅先で降りるはずの電車にすら乗れなかった。
findings.todokanai: But right now, I can't even board the train that I'll be getting off a single station later.

findings.highlight: gazing at his ever so slightly changing expressions.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなふうに彼の隣で、彼の回復を見守る
findings.explanation: The sequence culminates in Setsuna remaining beside Haruki and watching over his recovery. Todokanai TL drops that action and leaves the sentence open, weakening the precise caretaking identity she immediately questions as ego.
findings.japanese:
彼の寝顔を見て、彼の数少ない言葉を刻んで、
彼のほんの少しだけ変わる表情を見つめて、
そんなふうに彼の隣で、彼の回復を見守る。
findings.todokanai: Seeing his sleeping face, engraving the few words he mutters in my heart, gazing at his ever so slightly changing expressions.

findings.highlight: the angel of death
findings.evidenceJa: こんな疫病神が毎週現れたんじゃ
findings.explanation: Setsuna calls herself a 疫病神, a jinx or god of misfortune whose weekly appearance prevents recovery. 'Angel of death' makes her an agent or omen of literal death, substantially intensifying and changing the self-accusation.
findings.japanese:
そっか…
こんな疫病神が毎週現れたんじゃ、
よくなるわけなんかないよね…？
findings.todokanai: I get it now… How could he possibly get better when he's visited by the angel of death every week?

findings.highlight: Let's go with a light lunch and a filling dinner then, okay?
findings.evidenceJa: 豚肉安かったから多めに買ってきたんだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna adds that pork was cheap, so she bought extra. Todokanai TL omits the line's final clause, removing the ingredient setup for her cold-shabu idea two lines later.
findings.japanese:
「なんでもいいってのが一番張り合いないんだよね～。
ま、いっか。じゃあお昼はあっさりで夜はがっつりね。
豚肉安かったから多めに買ってきたんだ」
findings.todokanai: "I won't be as motivated if you're fine either way. Well, whatever. Let's go with a light lunch and a filling dinner then, okay?

findings.highlight: let's add it to the noodles cold
findings.evidenceJa: お昼、冷しゃぶもつけようかな
findings.explanation: Setsuna considers adding cold shabu-shabu as another lunch dish. Todokanai TL instead puts cold pork into the somen noodles, inventing a different preparation.
findings.japanese:
「そうだ、せっかく豚肉あるんだから、
お昼、冷しゃぶもつけようかな…
うん、それいいかも！」
findings.todokanai: "Oh, right! Since we already have pork, let's add it to the noodles cold… Yeah, that sounds great!"

findings.highlight: Then I prepared dinner while Haruki-kun was taking a bath.
findings.evidenceJa: そして、夕食が済んだら当然後片付け
findings.explanation: After laundry, room cleaning, bath cleaning, his bath, and dinner preparation, Setsuna naturally cleans up after the meal. Todokanai TL omits the final chore, weakening the intentionally exhaustive account of her keeping herself in motion.
findings.japanese:
洗濯と部屋の掃除が終わったら、お風呂の掃除。
春希くんに入浴してもらってる間に夕食の仕度。
そして、夕食が済んだら当然後片付け。
findings.todokanai: Once the laundry and the cleaning was done, I started cleaning the bathroom. Then I prepared dinner while Haruki-kun was taking a bath.

findings.highlight: in the end there'd be nowhere left to run away to.
findings.evidenceJa: 命ごと壊れてたかもしれない
findings.explanation: Haruki says that without Setsuna he might ultimately have broken not only psychologically but in his very life. Todokanai TL drops that climactic consequence and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「もし、雪菜がいなかったらさ…
俺は、何もかもから逃げて、結局、逃げ場を失って、
命ごと壊れてたかもしれない」
findings.todokanai: "If you weren't there for me, Setsuna… I would've ran away from everything, and in the end there'd be nowhere left to run away to.

findings.highlight: I did it, I did it, I did it!
findings.evidenceJa: 報われた、報われた、報われた！
findings.explanation: Setsuna repeats that she has been rewarded three times, receiving Haruki's gratitude as recompense for her suffering. 'I did it' recasts the moment as her own achievement and changes the passively received validation that makes the reversal so brutal.
findings.japanese: 報われた、報われた、報われた！
findings.todokanai: I did it, I did it, I did it!

findings.highlight: "The truth is, I wanted to send you home the moment you arrived here."
findings.evidenceJa:
「本当は、雪菜が来たとき、
すぐに帰ってもらうはずだった」
findings.explanation: Haruki was supposed to send Setsuna home immediately but says he wanted to — The later confession of reluctance supplies the difference between intention and obligation, and the immediate plan is still clear.
findings.japanese:
「本当は、雪菜が来たとき、
すぐに帰ってもらうはずだった」
findings.todokanai: "The truth is, I wanted to send you home the moment you arrived here."

findings.highlight: But I kept quiet about it until now.
findings.evidenceJa: それでも、雪菜を帰すのが今まで嫌で黙ってた
findings.explanation: Haruki kept silent because until now he could not bear to send Setsuna home. Todokanai TL omits his reluctance, leaving cowardice without the attachment that made him postpone the necessary separation.
findings.japanese:
「それでも、雪菜を帰すのが今まで嫌で黙ってた。
勇気のない、意気地のない俺でごめんな」
findings.todokanai: "But I kept quiet about it until now. I'm sorry for being such a spineless coward."

findings.highlight: he's just going to cast me aside?
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が良くなってきたら、わたしは用済みなの？
findings.explanation: Setsuna wonders whether Haruki's improvement means she has outlived her usefulness. Todokanai TL turns that fear of being no longer needed into an accusation that he is actively discarding her.
findings.japanese: 自分が良くなってきたら、わたしは用済みなの？
findings.todokanai: Now that he's gotten better, he's just going to cast me aside?

findings.highlight: What is it about me you don't like!?
findings.evidenceJa: わたしの、何がいけないの！？
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks what about her is wrong or at fault. Todokanai TL changes moral or behavioral failure into something Haruki simply dislikes, shifting the question from correction to personal preference.
findings.japanese:
「どうして？　どうしてなの…？
わたしの、何がいけないの！？」
findings.todokanai: "Why? Why would you…? What is it about me you don't like!?"

findings.highlight: It's not just my forehead he's touching, but the pouring sweat as well…
findings.evidenceJa: 本当に触れたのは、額じゃなくて、そこから噴き出す、大量の汗
findings.explanation: Setsuna corrects herself: what Haruki truly touched was not her forehead but the mass of sweat pouring from it. Todokanai TL makes the sweat an additional object, flattening the correction that reveals what he diagnosed at a glance.
findings.japanese:
本当に触れたのは、額じゃなくて、
そこから噴き出す、大量の汗…
findings.todokanai: It's not just my forehead he's touching, but the pouring sweat as well…

findings.highlight: It's getting harder for you to wake up in the mornings, isn't it?
findings.evidenceJa: それで、昨日も来れなかったし、今日も遅くなったんじゃないか？
findings.explanation: Haruki connects her worsening mornings to her failure to come yesterday and her late arrival today. Todokanai TL omits both concrete observations and leaves his diagnosis open.
findings.japanese:
「朝、起きるのが辛くなってるだろ？
それで、昨日も来れなかったし、
今日も遅くなったんじゃないか？」
findings.todokanai: "It's getting harder for you to wake up in the mornings, isn't it?

findings.highlight: everything I knew he would say
findings.evidenceJa: その思い込みでしかなかった確信は、一字一句違わず、わたしの耳に正しく刻み込まれた
findings.explanation: Her 'certainty' had until then been nothing more than an assumption; Haruki's exact words now confirm it. Todokanai TL says she simply knew what he would say, deleting the crucial movement from fearful supposition to word-for-word confirmation.
findings.japanese:
そして、その思い込みでしかなかった確信は、
一字一句違わず、わたしの耳に正しく刻み込まれた。
findings.todokanai: And everything I knew he would say, he engraved in my mind word for word.

findings.highlight: I ended up making a mess of it all.
findings.evidenceJa: わたしが、冷水を浴びせてしまったからだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna believes she poured cold water over Haruki's improving state, a concrete idiom/image of abruptly extinguishing it. Todokanai TL replaces the action with a generic mess and loses the causal force of her self-blame.
findings.japanese:
わたしが、冷水を浴びせてしまったからだ。
全部、わたしのせいなんだ。
findings.todokanai: I ended up making a mess of it all. This is all my fault.

findings.highlight: whatever courage remains in his broken self
findings.evidenceJa: 壊れかけの勇気を振り絞って
findings.explanation: Haruki wrings out courage that is itself on the verge of breaking. Todokanai TL says his self is already broken and the courage merely remains, changing the object and stage of collapse at the decision to separate them.
findings.japanese:
壊れかけの勇気を振り絞って、
春希くんは…わたしを切り離す。
findings.todokanai: Mustering up whatever courage remains in his broken self, Haruki-kun… cuts me away from him.

findings.highlight: without any regard for the fact that he's fallen apart.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分が壊れることも厭わずに
findings.explanation: Haruki chooses to protect Setsuna even if doing so causes him to break. Todokanai TL treats his collapse as an accomplished fact, losing the deliberate future risk he accepts.
findings.japanese:
自分が壊れることも厭わずに、
躊躇なくわたしを護る選択肢を選ぶ。
findings.todokanai: Without hesitation, he's choosing to protect me without any regard for the fact that he's fallen apart.

findings.highlight: Never come back.
findings.evidenceJa: いや………来るな
findings.explanation: After saying she absolutely must not come for a while, Haruki strips the sentence down to 'No… don't come.' Todokanai TL invents 'never,' turning the immediate separation into an explicit permanent ban the Japanese does not state.
findings.japanese: 「いや………来るな」
findings.todokanai: "No… Never come back."

findings.highlight: he was prepared to bring Kazusa down to hell with him.
findings.evidenceJa: かずさとは、堕ちていこうとしたくせに
findings.explanation: Setsuna bitterly notes that Haruki tried to fall together with Kazusa. Todokanai TL makes him the agent who would bring Kazusa down, damaging the contrast between the mutually chosen fall with Kazusa and his unilateral protection of Setsuna.
findings.japanese: かずさとは、堕ちていこうとしたくせに。
findings.todokanai: Even though he was prepared to bring Kazusa down to hell with him.

findings.highlight: From the top!
findings.evidenceJa: もう一度！
findings.explanation: Dupre orders them to do it once more, continuing the same passage identified on line 1. Todokanai TL changes that into starting from the top of the entire work, a materially different rehearsal instruction.
findings.japanese: 「もう一度！」
findings.todokanai: "From the top!"

findings.highlight: You're completely useless…
findings.evidenceJa: なんだその腑抜けたピアノは
findings.explanation: Dupre attacks Kazusa's piano as spineless or lifeless. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa herself completely useless, changing a severe musical criticism into a broader judgment of the person.
findings.japanese:
「なんだその腑抜けたピアノは…
若手ナンバーワンの成長株だという触れ込みだったが、
とんだ期待はずれだ」
findings.todokanai: "You're completely useless… I heard you were the peerless up and coming pianist, young and full of promise, but this is so far from what I expected."

findings.highlight: my long awaited meeting with the orchestra
findings.evidenceJa: 待望の初合わせ
findings.explanation: Kazusa has finally reached the first joint ensemble rehearsal, not an introductory meeting. The next lines describe exactly which instruments were allowed to play during that run-through.
findings.japanese:
そして今日、やっとメンバーが揃ったということで、
待望の初合わせ…
findings.todokanai: And today, when my long awaited meeting with the orchestra finally arrived…

findings.highlight: There's nothing concrete about what is happening yet
findings.evidenceJa: 今すぐどうこうということはないという説明
findings.explanation: The doctor says no immediate crisis is expected, although Youko is certainly weakening and eating little. Todokanai TL changes temporal reassurance into uncertainty about what is happening at all.
findings.japanese:
別に、今すぐどうこうということはないという説明だけど、
それでも衰弱しているのは確かで、
食事もあまり摂れていないらしい。
findings.todokanai: There's nothing concrete about what is happening yet, but we do know that her condition is deteriorating, and that she's not been eating well.

findings.highlight: The performance that disgusting conductor called a "faux-concert."
findings.evidenceJa: 日本での、最後のコンサート
findings.explanation: Kazusa recalls her final concert in Japan. Todokanai TL omits 'last,' weakening the connection between that farewell performance and the later separations replayed in her dream.
findings.japanese:
あのクソ指揮者に『お遊戯会』と称された、
日本での、最後のコンサート。
findings.todokanai: The performance that disgusting conductor called a "faux-concert."

findings.highlight: the requiem Mom is waiting for
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんにとっては、引導になってしまう可能性
findings.explanation: Kazusa fears performing Cloture may become the decisive final send-off that allows Youko to die without regrets. Todokanai TL calls the concerto itself a requiem, assigning it a musical genre and saying Youko is waiting for death rather than questioning the performance's effect.
findings.japanese:
あたしがｃｌｏｔｕｒｅを弾くことって、
母さんにとっては、
引導になってしまう可能性、本当にないのかな…？
findings.todokanai: Can I say for certain that Cloture isn't the requiem Mom is waiting for?

findings.highlight: how much I excelled in playing the piano, almost like a recruiter.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分がどれだけ秀でたパフォーマンスを披露できるか…それ以外にはあまり興味のない、探求者のような冬馬曜子
findings.explanation: The younger Youko cared chiefly about how outstanding a performance she herself could present, living like a seeker or explorer. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa's ability the object of Youko's interest and turns 探求者 into a recruiter, reversing the subject and inventing the role.
findings.japanese:
自分がどれだけ秀でたパフォーマンスを披露できるか…
それ以外にはあまり興味のない、探求者のような冬馬曜子。
findings.todokanai: Someone who was completely uninterested in anything other than how much I excelled in playing the piano, almost like a recruiter.

findings.highlight: I went to school for no other reason than the unreliable intel that he might be there.
findings.evidenceJa: 炎天下、死ぬ思いをして学校まで来て、話しかけるタイミングを、必死で探って
findings.explanation: Kazusa came to school through deadly heat and desperately searched for a chance to speak to Haruki. Todokanai TL omits both actions after the uncertain information, weakening the evidence from which she recognizes she was already in love.
findings.japanese:
ただ、あいつがいるかもって不確かな情報だけを頼りに、
炎天下、死ぬ思いをして学校まで来て、
話しかけるタイミングを、必死で探って…
findings.todokanai: Despite the scorching heat, I went to school for no other reason than the unreliable intel that he might be there.

findings.highlight: someone had to lose, and I knew the winner couldn't get away without their share of pain either.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かが引かないといけないって。けれど、誰かが引いても痛みはおさまらないって
findings.explanation: Kazusa knew somebody had to withdraw, yet even somebody withdrawing would not make the pain subside. Todokanai TL invents a winner/loser structure and relocates the continuing pain specifically onto the winner.
findings.japanese:
誰かが引かないといけないって。
けれど、誰かが引いても痛みはおさまらないって。
findings.todokanai: I knew someone had to lose, and I knew the winner couldn't get away without their share of pain either.

findings.highlight: Always keeping me at arm's length, but never letting me reach you.
findings.evidenceJa: 手が届かないくせに、ずっと近くにいろなんて、そんな拷問を思いついたのもお前だろ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki was out of her reach yet told her to remain close forever, thereby inventing that torture. Todokanai TL instead makes him actively hold her at arm's length and prevent her from reaching him, altering the mechanism and agency of the complaint.
findings.japanese:
「手が届かないくせに、ずっと近くにいろなんて、
そんな拷問を思いついたのもお前だろ！」
findings.todokanai: "Always keeping me at arm's length, but never letting me reach you. Wasn't that torture your idea!?"

findings.highlight: I backed away, but then I forced myself upon him.
findings.evidenceJa: 引いて、押した
findings.explanation: Kazusa describes pulling back and then pushing, the contradictory actions by which she broke the trio. 'Forced myself upon him' adds a sexual or coercive action not stated by the compact push-pull image.
findings.japanese:
引いて、押した。
三人を、壊した。
かけがえのない仲間を、めちゃめちゃにした。
findings.todokanai: I backed away, but then I forced myself upon him. I broke the three of us. I made a mess of our irreplaceable friendship.

findings.highlight: the person who was my friend
findings.evidenceJa: 親友を傷つけて
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she hurt her best friend. Todokanai TL demotes Setsuna to somebody who merely was her friend, weakening both intimacy and the guilt central to the confession.
findings.japanese:
好きなひとを傷つけて、
親友を傷つけて、
ただひとり、逃げ出して…
findings.todokanai: I hurt the person I loved. I hurt the person who was my friend. Then I ran away by myself…

findings.highlight: Everything will be solved if you just pull your hand away.
findings.evidenceJa: お前が手を引けば、すぐに解ける
findings.explanation: Haruki is not gripping her: if Kazusa withdraws her own hand, their interlaced contact will immediately come apart. Todokanai TL says everything will be solved, inflating a precise physical fact into a promise that their emotional crisis has a solution.
findings.japanese:
「お前が手を引けば、すぐに解ける。
お前は、どこへでも行ける」
findings.todokanai: "Everything will be solved if you just pull your hand away. You'll be able to go anywhere."

findings.highlight: I had even erased him from the phone's memory.
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶からだって、消した、はずだ
findings.explanation: After confirming the number is absent from her contacts, Kazusa says she was supposed to have erased it even from her own memory. Todokanai TL redundantly returns to the phone's memory and deletes the claim about trying to forget him herself.
findings.japanese:
携帯のアドレスを確かめる。
もちろん、そこにはもう、あいつの番号なんかない。
記憶からだって、消した、はずだ。
findings.todokanai: I look at my phone contacts, and his number is of course no longer there. I had even erased him from the phone's memory.

findings.highlight: he was simply waiting for me to bring it up
findings.evidenceJa: …それほどまでに、その頃のわたしの様子はただごとじゃなかったのかもしれない。
findings.explanation: The supervisor accepts Setsuna's leave because her condition was plainly extraordinary. Todokanai TL invents the further motive that he had been waiting for her to mention it.
findings.japanese:
…それほどまでに、その頃のわたしの様子は
ただごとじゃなかったのかもしれない。
findings.todokanai: …Maybe that's just how terrible of a state I was in, and he was simply waiting for me to bring it up.

findings.highlight: So there's no problem anymore. Everything's back to normal.
findings.evidenceJa: だからもう、全く問題ない。何もかも元通り。まずは今までの平日を取り戻し、すぐに今までの週末も取り戻す。
findings.explanation: Setsuna specifies the recovery program: first reclaim her former weekdays, then soon reclaim her former weekends. Todokanai TL stops at a generic return to normal and omits both stages.
findings.japanese:
だからもう、全く問題ない。何もかも元通り。
まずは今までの平日を取り戻し、
すぐに今までの週末も取り戻す。
findings.todokanai: So there's no problem anymore. Everything's back to normal.

findings.highlight: I woke up late at night one day feeling thirsty, so I went downstairs for a drink.
findings.evidenceJa: 真夜中に喉が渇いて目が覚め、階下に降りたとき、真っ暗な台所で、力なく静かに涙するお母さんの姿を。
findings.explanation: The sentence culminates in Setsuna seeing her mother quietly and weakly crying alone in the pitch-dark kitchen. Todokanai TL translates only the trip downstairs and deletes the image that changes Setsuna's understanding of her family.
findings.japanese:
真夜中に喉が渇いて目が覚め、階下に降りたとき、
真っ暗な台所で、力なく静かに涙するお母さんの姿を。
findings.todokanai: I woke up late at night one day feeling thirsty, so I went downstairs for a drink.

findings.highlight: blow at the barley tea
findings.evidenceJa: テーブルに座り、コップに注いだ麦茶を一気にあおる。
findings.explanation: Setsuna gulps the barley tea down in one go. Todokanai TL has her blow on the cold drink instead.
findings.japanese: テーブルに座り、コップに注いだ麦茶を一気にあおる。
findings.todokanai: I sit down by the table and blow at the barley tea in my cup.

findings.highlight: a jealous woman like me
findings.evidenceJa: …こんな、猜疑心の強い女の子、彼に相応しくないのかな。
findings.explanation: Setsuna calls herself distrustful or excessively suspicious. Todokanai TL substitutes jealousy, changing the specific fault she fears makes her unworthy of Haruki.
findings.japanese:
…こんな、猜疑心の強い女の子、
彼に相応しくないのかな。
findings.todokanai: …Is a jealous woman like me even a good match for him?

findings.highlight: taking on the world again
findings.evidenceJa: 「冬馬かずさ、新たな世界への挑戦」
findings.explanation: The headline frames Kazusa as challenging a new world. Todokanai TL adds 'again' and turns the new-world threshold into a repeated attempt to take on the existing world.
findings.japanese: 「冬馬かずさ、新たな世界への挑戦」
findings.todokanai: "Touma Kazusa, taking on the world again."

findings.highlight: Guess who I just saw on the news
findings.evidenceJa: 『それとさっきニュースでさ…』
findings.explanation: Setsuna recalls the earlier words 'and earlier, on the news.' Todokanai TL rewrites the quotation as a reveal about seeing a person, damaging an exact callback and inventing suspense absent from the source.
findings.japanese: 『それとさっきニュースでさ…』
findings.todokanai: "Guess who I just saw on the news…"

findings.highlight: European branch
findings.evidenceJa: 「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。電話番号は…」
findings.explanation: The recorded message names the Touma Youko Office's European headquarters. Todokanai TL calls it a branch, reversing the organization's hierarchy.
findings.japanese:
「お急ぎのご用がありましたら、
冬馬曜子オフィス欧州本部に連絡をお願いします。
電話番号は…」
findings.todokanai: "If you have urgent business, please contact the European branch of Touma Youko Office. The number to them is…"

findings.highlight: online games on their smartphones
findings.evidenceJa: 金管は相変わらずカードに興じ、木管はもう少し近代的に、日本の携帯ゲーム機で通信対戦を楽しみ始めた。
findings.explanation: The woodwinds use Japanese handheld game consoles for local wireless competitive play. Todokanai TL changes both the devices and the play mode to smartphones and online games.
findings.japanese:
金管は相変わらずカードに興じ、
木管はもう少し近代的に、
日本の携帯ゲーム機で通信対戦を楽しみ始めた。
findings.todokanai: The brass crew were still playing cards in the back, while the woodwinds, slightly more modern, were playing online games on their smartphones instead.

findings.highlight: In truth, no one could complain if they got angry instead and left the project.
findings.evidenceJa: 本来なら、彼らの方が怒って来なくなっても当然なのに、あたしの途切れ途切れのピアノと、粘着指揮者の罵倒をさらりと聞き流しつつ日々無駄な時間を消費している。
findings.explanation: The sentence continues that the musicians nevertheless waste their days casually ignoring Kazusa's broken playing and the obsessive conductor's abuse. Todokanai TL omits the entire action that demonstrates their patience.
findings.japanese:
本来なら、彼らの方が怒って来なくなっても当然なのに、
あたしの途切れ途切れのピアノと、粘着指揮者の罵倒を
さらりと聞き流しつつ日々無駄な時間を消費している。
findings.todokanai: In truth, no one could complain if they got angry instead and left the project.

findings.highlight: The moment that piece of news reached his ears
findings.evidenceJa: そして、そんなふうに黒字が保証された途端、奴の態度は豹変した。
findings.explanation: The impresario's attitude changes precisely once the concert's profitability is guaranteed. Todokanai TL replaces the financial cause with the mere arrival of unspecified news.
findings.japanese:
そして、そんなふうに黒字が保証された途端、
奴の態度は豹変した。
findings.todokanai: The moment that piece of news reached his ears, his attitude fully altered course.

findings.highlight: To think there are companies willing to throw a fortune down the drain for a mediocre pianist like you…
findings.evidenceJa: 「こんな下手なピアニストのために大金をドブに捨てる企業があるとは…私も日本人に生まれたかったね、実に残念だ」
findings.explanation: Dupre continues that he wishes he had been born Japanese and finds that fact truly regrettable. Todokanai TL omits the nationality punchline and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「こんな下手なピアニストのために
大金をドブに捨てる企業があるとは…
私も日本人に生まれたかったね、実に残念だ」
findings.todokanai: "To think there are companies willing to throw a fortune down the drain for a mediocre pianist like you…

findings.highlight: why do I have to deal with this guy
findings.evidenceJa: 本当にさ…なんで一時期とは言え、あんな奴と…
findings.explanation: Kazusa is incredulously addressing Youko's former involvement with Dupre: why, even for a time, was her mother with a man like that? Todokanai TL instead complains that Kazusa herself must deal with him once.
findings.japanese:
本当にさ…
なんで一時期とは言え、あんな奴と…
findings.todokanai: Seriously… I know it's only this one time, but why do I have to deal with this guy…?

findings.highlight: Do I really look that unserious
findings.evidenceJa: 『なぁ、母さん…あたしのピアノって、やっぱりお遊戯なのかな？』
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks whether her piano is really no more than a children's amusement or recital. Todokanai TL turns the artistic judgment into a question about whether she looks unserious while playing.
findings.japanese:
『なぁ、母さん…
あたしのピアノって、やっぱりお遊戯なのかな？』
findings.todokanai: "Tell me, Mom… Do I really look that unserious when I'm playing the piano?"

findings.highlight: it can only play along with the violins
findings.evidenceJa: 『本物のオケの音に跳ね返される。…まだヴァイオリンしか相手にしてないのに』
findings.explanation: Kazusa says the real orchestra's sound repels her piano even though she has faced only the violins so far. Todokanai TL changes her being overwhelmed into a limitation on what her piano can accompany.
findings.japanese:
『本物のオケの音に跳ね返される。
…まだヴァイオリンしか相手にしてないのに』
findings.todokanai: "The sound of a real orchestra is repelling it… So far, it can only play along with the violins."

findings.highlight: Tell me I'm fine. Tell me I'll succeed. Tell me Mom will get better.
findings.evidenceJa: あたしは大丈夫だって、絶対に成功するって、母さんは元気になるって、嘘でもいいから、言ってよ…
findings.explanation: Kazusa explicitly begs Youko to say these reassurances even if they are lies. Todokanai TL omits that condition, which is the measure of her desperation.
findings.japanese:
あたしは大丈夫だって、
絶対に成功するって、母さんは元気になるって、
嘘でもいいから、言ってよ…
findings.todokanai: Tell me I'm fine. Tell me I'll succeed. Tell me Mom will get better.

findings.highlight: becoming unable to comfort him
findings.evidenceJa: そしてわたしが、折れてしまいそうな今。彼を、支えきれなくなってしまいそうな、今…
findings.explanation: Setsuna fears she is becoming unable to keep supporting Haruki as she approaches collapse. Todokanai TL narrows that sustained practical and emotional support to comforting him.
findings.japanese:
そしてわたしが、折れてしまいそうな今。
彼を、支えきれなくなってしまいそうな、今…
findings.todokanai: And… now when I'm nearing my breaking point. Now when I'm becoming unable to comfort him…

findings.highlight: the excitement in my voice is slipping out
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の浮き立つ声が、あからさまに滑ってるのがわかる。
findings.explanation: Setsuna hears her deliberately buoyant voice falling conspicuously flat. Todokanai TL instead says genuine excitement is escaping into her voice, reversing the failure of her performance.
findings.japanese: 自分の浮き立つ声が、あからさまに滑ってるのがわかる。
findings.todokanai: I know how clearly the excitement in my voice is slipping out.

findings.highlight: It's absurd that I'm doing this, when I shouldn't even have the right to call you.
findings.evidenceJa: 「あたし、お前に電話できる資格なんかないのに。なのに、こんな厚かましい真似…」
findings.explanation: Kazusa continues that despite lacking any right to call, she is committing an act this shameless. Todokanai TL drops the self-indicting second movement.
findings.japanese:
「あたし、お前に電話できる資格なんかないのに。
なのに、こんな厚かましい真似…」
findings.todokanai: "It's absurd that I'm doing this, when I shouldn't even have the right to call you."

findings.highlight: my defeat was certain from the start
findings.evidenceJa: 彼のことを話すために、かずさと連絡を取ろうとしてたのに。…最初から、負けるつもり、だったのに。
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she had intended to lose from the beginning. Todokanai TL changes a deliberate self-sacrificial plan into a prediction that defeat was inevitable.
findings.japanese:
彼のことを話すために、
かずさと連絡を取ろうとしてたのに。
…最初から、負けるつもり、だったのに。
findings.todokanai: Even though that was the reason I called her in the first place… Even though my defeat was certain from the start.

findings.highlight: He was in Houjou High all this time yet he couldn't get a single recommendation.
findings.evidenceJa: 「優秀だなんて全然。せっかく付属にいたのに推薦すら取れなくて一般入試でギリギリだったんだから」
findings.explanation: Setsuna adds that Haruki only barely passed through the ordinary entrance examination. Todokanai TL omits the concrete academic calibration and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「優秀だなんて全然。
せっかく付属にいたのに推薦すら取れなくて
一般入試でギリギリだったんだから」
findings.todokanai: "He's not exemplary at all. He was in Houjou High all this time yet he couldn't get a single recommendation.

findings.highlight: What are you talking about
findings.evidenceJa: 「なんでそんなことになってんだよ！？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa asks how things came to be this way. Todokanai TL instead asks what Setsuna is talking about, changing shock at the situation into failure to understand her words.
findings.japanese: 「なんでそんなことになってんだよ！？」
findings.todokanai: "What are you talking about!?"

findings.highlight: having the time of your life in Europe
findings.evidenceJa: 「何言ってるのよ！そっちはヨーロッパでも大活躍してるくせに！」
findings.explanation: Setsuna says Kazusa is thriving or achieving greatly in Europe. Todokanai TL turns professional success into personal enjoyment.
findings.japanese:
「何言ってるのよ！
そっちはヨーロッパでも大活躍してるくせに！」
findings.todokanai: "What are you saying!? You're having the time of your life in Europe!"

findings.highlight: I don't care!
findings.evidenceJa: 「知らないよ！そんなの、全部背負いきれないよ！わたしは春希くんだけだよ！」
findings.explanation: Setsuna cries that she does not know how to answer or carry all of this. Todokanai TL says she does not care, making her reject concerns she is actually overwhelmed by.
findings.japanese:
「知らないよ！
そんなの、全部背負いきれないよ！
わたしは春希くんだけだよ！」
findings.todokanai: "I don't care! I can't take responsibility for everything! The only one who matters to me is Haruki-kun!"

findings.highlight: shifting responsibility,
findings.evidenceJa: 自己正当化、理不尽な罵倒、聞こえないふり、大泣き、責任転嫁、悲劇のヒロイン気取り…
findings.explanation: The list continues through outright sobbing and ends with playing the tragic heroine. Todokanai TL weakens the sobbing to whining, omits the tragic-heroine item, and leaves the sentence open.
findings.japanese:
自己正当化、理不尽な罵倒、聞こえないふり、
大泣き、責任転嫁、悲劇のヒロイン気取り…
findings.todokanai: We're justifying ourselves, we're unreasonably lashing out at each other, we're whining, we're pretending not to hear one another, shifting responsibility,

findings.highlight: I'm suffering many times more than you are
findings.evidenceJa: 「もうすぐコンサートなんだぞ？それに母さんだって…雪菜なんかより数倍苦しい思いしてるんだぞ？」
findings.explanation: Kazusa says her mother is suffering several times more than Setsuna. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa herself the comparative sufferer.
findings.japanese:
「もうすぐコンサートなんだぞ？
それに母さんだって…
雪菜なんかより数倍苦しい思いしてるんだぞ？」
findings.todokanai: "My concert is right around the corner, and my mom… I'm suffering many times more than you are, Setsuna."

findings.highlight: Setsuna isn't holding back
findings.evidenceJa: だから雪菜も、いつも通りに引き留めない。
findings.explanation: Setsuna does not try to hold Kazusa back, as usual. Todokanai TL says Setsuna herself is not holding back, assigning the verb to the wrong participant and action.
findings.japanese: だから雪菜も、いつも通りに引き留めない。
findings.todokanai: That's why Setsuna isn't holding back like she usually does.

findings.highlight: then go past the main gate of Houjou University and Houjou High from there,
findings.evidenceJa: マンションから、南末次の駅を通り過ぎ、峰城大の正門や、付属の正門も通り過ぎ、その先にある、川沿いの土手。
findings.explanation: The destination is the riverbank embankment beyond both gates. Todokanai TL omits the destination, leaves the sentence at a comma, and deprives the next paragraph of its named setting.
findings.japanese:
マンションから、南末次の駅を通り過ぎ、
峰城大の正門や、付属の正門も通り過ぎ、
その先にある、川沿いの土手。
findings.todokanai: If you go past Minami-Suetsugu station from the apartment, then go past the main gate of Houjou University and Houjou High from there,

findings.highlight: Takeya would take naps here when he was skipping class.
findings.evidenceJa: 「ここさ、付属の正門から近いだろ？武也がよく学校サボって昼寝してたんだよな。ま、俺は帰りにあいつを起こす役だったけど」
findings.explanation: Haruki adds that he was the one assigned to wake Takeya on his way home. Todokanai TL omits the role that completes their school-days anecdote and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「ここさ、付属の正門から近いだろ？
武也がよく学校サボって昼寝してたんだよな。
ま、俺は帰りにあいつを起こす役だったけど」
findings.todokanai: "This place is close to the main gate of Houjou High. Takeya would take naps here when he was skipping class.

findings.highlight: Don't push yourself to the edge for my sake ever again.
findings.evidenceJa: 「じゃあ、普段の俺っぽい説教も一つ。…二度と、俺のために壊れるまで我慢するな。どうせ大した意味はないんだから」
findings.explanation: Haruki adds that destroying herself for him will not accomplish much anyway. Todokanai TL drops the deliberately harsh conclusion that provokes Setsuna's reply and leaves the quotation open.
findings.japanese:
「じゃあ、普段の俺っぽい説教も一つ。
…二度と、俺のために壊れるまで我慢するな。
どうせ大した意味はないんだから」
findings.todokanai: "Then let me give you a piece of my mind like my usual self would: …Don't push yourself to the edge for my sake ever again.

findings.highlight: I've done all this of my own volition
findings.evidenceJa: その、押し隠した表情で確信できた。自分が、自分の言動をできているって。
findings.explanation: Haruki recognizes from Setsuna's reaction that he is once again able to speak and behave as himself; the next line names remaining Kitahara Haruki. Todokanai TL changes recovered identity into merely having acted voluntarily.
findings.japanese:
その、押し隠した表情で確信できた。
自分が、自分の言動をできているって。
findings.todokanai: And it's that concealed expression that's allowed me to be sureーbe sure of the fact that I've done all this of my own volition.

findings.highlight: the ability to muster my own effort
findings.evidenceJa: 薬に診療、周囲の理解、尽力、そして、時間の経過。
findings.explanation: The list credits the understanding and efforts of the people around Haruki. Todokanai TL reassigns those efforts to Haruki himself.
findings.japanese:
薬に診療、
周囲の理解、尽力、
そして、時間の経過。
findings.todokanai: I needed medication, understanding from my surroundings, the ability to muster my own effort, as well as the passage of time.

findings.highlight: My symptoms didn't get worse when Setsuna disappeared from my life,
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜がいなくなったから症状が悪化したとか、あるいは逆に、雪菜が潰れかけたことを責任に感じて、今まで以上に頑張って克服したとか、そんなことはなく。
findings.explanation: Haruki denies two dramatic explanations: Setsuna's departure did not worsen him, and guilt over her near-collapse did not make him strive harder than before. Todokanai TL keeps only the first denial and leaves the sentence open.
findings.japanese:
雪菜がいなくなったから症状が悪化したとか、
あるいは逆に、雪菜が潰れかけたことを責任に感じて、
今まで以上に頑張って克服したとか、そんなことはなく。
findings.todokanai: My symptoms didn't get worse when Setsuna disappeared from my life,

findings.highlight: I needed Setsuna's understanding and support, but it wasn't the deciding factor;
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の理解や支えは必要だったけれど必須ではなく、雪菜の無理や離脱は痛恨だったけれど致命的ではなく。
findings.explanation: Haruki continues that Setsuna's overexertion and withdrawal were deeply painful but not fatal to his recovery. Todokanai TL omits the second half of the paired argument.
findings.japanese:
雪菜の理解や支えは必要だったけれど必須ではなく、
雪菜の無理や離脱は痛恨だったけれど致命的ではなく。
findings.todokanai: I needed Setsuna's understanding and support, but it wasn't the deciding factor;

findings.highlight: you should consider some counseling yourself
